name: Build and Deploy Blazor WASM to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Install wasm-tools workload
        run: dotnet workload install wasm-tools

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly/CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.csproj

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly/CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Publish
        run: |
          dotnet publish CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly/CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.csproj \
            -c Release \
            -o publish \
            --no-build

      - name: Inspect published files
        run: |
          echo "=== Published files in wwwroot ==="
          ls -la publish/wwwroot/
          echo ""
          echo "=== Files in _framework directory ==="
          ls -la publish/wwwroot/_framework/ || echo "No _framework directory"
          echo ""
          echo "=== Looking for blazor files ==="
          find publish/wwwroot -name "*blazor*" -type f

      - name: Change base tag for GitHub Pages
        run: |
          # Detect if this is a user site or project site
          REPO_NAME="${{ github.event.repository.name }}"
          REPO_OWNER="${{ github.repository_owner }}"
          
          if [[ "$REPO_NAME" == "$REPO_OWNER.github.io" ]]; then
            BASE_PATH="/"
            echo "User/org site detected, using base path: /"
          else
            BASE_PATH="/$REPO_NAME/"
            echo "Project site detected, using base path: /$REPO_NAME/"
          fi
          
          echo "Updating base href to: $BASE_PATH"
          sed -i "s|<base href=\"/\" />|<base href=\"$BASE_PATH\" />|g" publish/wwwroot/index.html
          
          echo "Verifying change:"
          grep "<base href=" publish/wwwroot/index.html

@inject SolarPositionService SolarService
@inject IOptions<LocationOptions> LocationConfig

@if (CalendarData != null)
{
    <div class="calendar-grid">
        <div class="calendar-header">
            @foreach (var day in CalendarData.WeeksNeMini)
            {
                <div class="day-name">@day</div>
            }
        </div>
        <div class="calendar-days">
            @for (int i = 0; i < CalendarData.Days.Count; i++)
            {
                var idx = i;
                var day = CalendarData.Days[idx];
                <div class="calendar-day @(day.Tag ?? "") @(idx == _selectedDayIndex ? "selected" : "")"
                     @onclick="() => OnDayTapped(idx)">
                    <div class="bs-date">@day.Bs</div>
                    <div class="ad-date">@day.Ad</div>
                    @if (idx == _selectedDayIndex && _selectedHomeSun != null)
                    {
                        <div class="day-sun-info" @onclick:stopPropagation="true">
                            <div class="day-sun-row">
                                <span>🌅 @FormatTimeShort(_selectedHomeSun.SunriseLocal)</span>
                                <span>🌇 @FormatTimeShort(_selectedHomeSun.SunsetLocal)</span>
                            </div>
                            @if (_selectedUserSun != null)
                            {
                                <div class="day-sun-row day-sun-user">
                                    <span>🌅 @FormatTimeShort(_selectedUserSun.SunriseLocal)</span>
                                    <span>🌇 @FormatTimeShort(_selectedUserSun.SunsetLocal)</span>
                                </div>
                            }
                        </div>
                    }
                </div>
            }
        </div>
    </div>
}

@code {
    private static readonly TimeOnly LocalNoon = new(12, 0);

    [Parameter]
    public CalendarData? CalendarData { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public DateOnly Today { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public GeoLocation? UserLocation { get; set; }

    private GeoLocation _homeLocation = default!;
    private CalendarData? _renderedData;
    private DateOnly _renderedToday;
    private GeoLocation? _renderedUserLocation;
    private int? _selectedDayIndex;
    private SolarPosition? _selectedHomeSun;
    private SolarPosition? _selectedUserSun;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        _homeLocation = LocationConfig.Value.ToGeoLocation();
    }

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        bool dataChanged = !ReferenceEquals(CalendarData, _renderedData) || Today != _renderedToday;
        bool userLocationChanged = !Equals(UserLocation, _renderedUserLocation);

        _renderedData = CalendarData;
        _renderedToday = Today;
        _renderedUserLocation = UserLocation;

        if (dataChanged)
        {
            ClearSelection();
        }
        else if (userLocationChanged && _selectedDayIndex is int index)
        {
            CalculateSunForDay(index);
        }
    }

    private void OnDayTapped(int index)
    {
        if (_selectedDayIndex == index)
        {
            ClearSelection();
            return;
        }

        _selectedDayIndex = index;
        CalculateSunForDay(index);
    }

    private void ClearSelection()
    {
        _selectedDayIndex = null;
        _selectedHomeSun = null;
        _selectedUserSun = null;
    }

    private void CalculateSunForDay(int index)
    {
        if (CalendarData == null) return;

        int todayIndex = CalendarProjection.FindTodayIndex(CalendarData);
        if (todayIndex < 0)
        {
            _selectedHomeSun = null;
            _selectedUserSun = null;
            return;
        }

        var targetDate = Today.AddDays(index - todayIndex);
        var instantUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(targetDate.ToDateTime(LocalNoon) - _homeLocation.UtcOffset, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        _selectedHomeSun = SolarService.Calculate(instantUtc, _homeLocation);
        _selectedUserSun = UserLocation is null ? null : SolarService.Calculate(instantUtc, UserLocation);
    }

    private static string FormatTimeShort(TimeOnly? time) => time?.ToString("HH\\:mm") ?? "--:--";
}

@code {
    private const double SecondsPerDay = 86400.0;
    private const double SecondsPerHour = 3600.0;
    private const double SecondsPerMinute = 60.0;

    [Parameter]
    public MoonPhase? MoonPhase { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public bool IsLive { get; set; }

    private static string FormatDays(double days)
    {
        if (days < 0.5)
            return "today";
        if (days < 1.5)
            return "1 day";
        return $"{days:F1} days";
    }

    private static string FormatPreciseDays(double days)
    {
        var totalSeconds = days * SecondsPerDay;
        var d = (int)days;
        var remainingSeconds = totalSeconds - (d * SecondsPerDay);
        var h = (int)(remainingSeconds / SecondsPerHour);
        var m = (int)((remainingSeconds % SecondsPerHour) / SecondsPerMinute);
        var s = (int)(remainingSeconds % SecondsPerMinute);

        if (d > 0)
            return $"{d}d {h}h {m}m {s}s";
        if (h > 0)
            return $"{h}h {m}m {s}s";
        return $"{m}m {s}s";
    }

    private static string FormatIllumination(double illumination) => $"{illumination}%";
}

@code {
    private const string HomeCanvasId = "sunSkyCanvasKtm";
    private const string UserCanvasId = "sunSkyCanvasUser";

    [Parameter]
    public SolarPosition? Position { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public SolarPosition? UserPosition { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public bool IsLive { get; set; }

    private bool _homeCanvasInitialized;
    private bool _userCanvasInitialized;
    private bool _showDisclaimer;

    private void ToggleDisclaimer() => _showDisclaimer = !_showDisclaimer;

    private IEnumerable<(SolarPosition pos, string canvasId, int idx)> GetLocations()
    {
        if (Position != null)
            yield return (Position, HomeCanvasId, 0);
        if (UserPosition != null)
            yield return (UserPosition, UserCanvasId, 1);
    }

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (!_homeCanvasInitialized && Position != null)
        {
            _homeCanvasInitialized = await TryInvokeAsync("sunTracker.init", HomeCanvasId);
        }

        if (!_userCanvasInitialized && UserPosition != null)
        {
            _userCanvasInitialized = await TryInvokeAsync("sunTracker.init", UserCanvasId);
        }

        if (_homeCanvasInitialized && Position != null)
        {
            await DrawAsync(HomeCanvasId, Position);
        }

        if (_userCanvasInitialized && UserPosition != null)
        {
            await DrawAsync(UserCanvasId, UserPosition);
        }
    }

    private Task<bool> DrawAsync(string canvasId, SolarPosition position) =>
        TryInvokeAsync("sunTracker.draw",
            canvasId, position.Altitude, position.Azimuth,
            position.DayFraction, position.IsAboveHorizon, position.FullDayFraction);

    private async Task<bool> TryInvokeAsync(string identifier, params object?[] args)
    {
        try
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync(identifier, args);
            return true;
        }
        catch (JSException)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static string FormatCoordinate(double value, bool isLatitude)
    {
        var suffix = isLatitude
            ? (value >= 0 ? "N" : "S")
            : (value >= 0 ? "E" : "W");
        return $"{Math.Abs(value):F2}°{suffix}";
    }

    private static string FormatTime(TimeOnly? time) => time?.ToString("HH\\:mm\\:ss") ?? "--:--:--";

    private static string FormatTimeShort(TimeOnly? time) => time?.ToString("HH\\:mm") ?? "--:--";

    private static string FormatDateTime(DateTime? dt, DateTime localNow)
    {
        if (!dt.HasValue) return "—";
        var val = dt.Value;
        var today = localNow.Date;
        var dayLabel = val.Date == today ? "" :
                       val.Date == today.AddDays(-1) ? " (yesterday)" :
                       val.Date == today.AddDays(1) ? " (tomorrow)" :
                       $" ({val:MMM dd})";
        return $"{val:HH:mm:ss}{dayLabel}";
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        await TryInvokeAsync("sunTracker.dispose", HomeCanvasId);
        await TryInvokeAsync("sunTracker.dispose", UserCanvasId);
    }
}

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;

public class SolarPosition
{
   public const double GoldenHourElevationDegrees = 6.0;

   public string LocationName { get; init; } = "";
   public double Latitude { get; init; }
   public double Longitude { get; init; }

   public DateTime LocalTime { get; init; }

   public double Altitude { get; init; }

   public double Azimuth { get; init; }

   public double Declination { get; init; }

   public double HourAngle { get; init; }

   public bool IsAboveHorizon => Altitude > 0;

   public bool IsGoldenHour => Altitude is > -GoldenHourElevationDegrees and < GoldenHourElevationDegrees;

   public double DayFraction { get; init; }

   public double FullDayFraction { get; init; }

   public TimeOnly? SunriseLocal { get; init; }

   public TimeOnly SolarNoonLocal { get; init; }

   public TimeOnly? SunsetLocal { get; init; }

   public DateTime? PreviousSunrise { get; init; }

   public DateTime? PreviousSunset { get; init; }

   public DateTime? NextSunrise { get; init; }

   public DateTime? NextSunset { get; init; }

   public TimeOnly? GoldenHourMorningStart { get; init; }

   public TimeOnly? GoldenHourMorningEnd { get; init; }

   public TimeOnly? GoldenHourEveningStart { get; init; }

   public TimeOnly? GoldenHourEveningEnd { get; init; }

   public double MaxElevation { get; init; }

   public TimeSpan DayLength { get; init; }

   public string AzimuthCardinal => AzToCardinal(Azimuth);
   public string AltitudeSign => Altitude >= 0 ? "+" : "";

   private static string AzToCardinal(double az)
   {
      string[] dirs = ["N", "NNE", "NE", "ENE", "E", "ESE", "SE", "SSE", "S", "SSW", "SW", "WSW", "W", "WNW", "NW", "NNW"];
      return dirs[(int)Math.Round(az / 22.5) % 16];
   }
}

@page "/"
@using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
@implements IAsyncDisposable
@inject KathmanduCalendarService CalendarService
@inject SolarPositionService SolarPositionService
@inject IGeolocationService GeolocationService
@inject IApiLogger ApiLogger
@inject TimeProvider TimeProvider
@inject IJSRuntime JS
@inject IOptions<RefreshOptions> RefreshConfig
@inject IOptions<LocationOptions> LocationConfig
@inject ILogger<Home> Log

<PageTitle>Kathmandu Calendar & Time</PageTitle>

<div class="header">
    <h1>काठमाडौं</h1>
    <div class="subtitle">Kathmandu, Nepal</div>
</div>

@if (StatusMessage is { } message)
{
    <div class="notice" role="status">@message</div>
}

<TimeDisplay CurrentTime="_currentTime" />
<DateCards CalendarData="_calendar?.Data" />
<MoonDisplay MoonPhase="_moonPhase" IsLive="IsMoonLive" />
<Sundisplay Position="_sunPosition" UserPosition="_userSunPosition" IsLive="IsSunLive" />
<CalendarGrid CalendarData="_calendar?.Data" Today="Today" UserLocation="_userLocation" />

<div class="footer">
    Last updated: <span>@_lastUpdate</span>
    @if (!_isOnline)
    {
        <span class="footer-sep">·</span>
        <span class="offline-badge">Offline</span>
    }
    <span class="footer-sep">·</span>
    <a href="/blog" class="footer-link">Blog</a>
    <span class="footer-sep">·</span>
    <a href="https://github.com/collabskus/collabskus.github.io/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="footer-link">GitHub</a>
</div>

@code {
    private const string MoonElementId = "moon-display-root";
    private const string SunElementId = "sun-display-root";

    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _lifetime = new();
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _calendarGate = new(1, 1);
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _clockGate = new(1, 1);

    private GeoLocation _homeLocation = default!;
    private GeoLocation? _userLocation;
    private CalendarSnapshot? _calendar;
    private bool _calendarUnavailable;
    private DateOnly _lastCalendarCheck;
    private MoonPhase? _moonPhase;
    private SolarPosition? _sunPosition;
    private SolarPosition? _userSunPosition;
    private DateTime _currentTime;
    private string _lastUpdate = "--";
    private bool _isOnline = true;
    private bool _isTabVisible = true;
    private bool _isMoonInView = true;
    private bool _isSunInView = true;
    private bool _hasLoggedFirstSolarCalc;
    private bool _disposed;
    private DotNetObjectReference<Home>? _dotNetRef;
    private IJSObjectReference? _pageMonitor;

    private bool IsMoonLive => _isTabVisible && _isMoonInView;

    private bool IsSunLive => _isTabVisible && _isSunInView;

    private DateOnly Today => DateOnly.FromDateTime(_currentTime);

    private string? StatusMessage => _calendar switch
    {
        { Source: CalendarDataSource.Stale } stale =>
            $"Calendar could not be updated. Showing saved data from {stale.ForDate:MMMM d, yyyy}.",
        null when _calendarUnavailable =>
            "Calendar data is unavailable right now. Time, moon and sun keep working offline.",
        _ => null
    };

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        _homeLocation = LocationConfig.Value.ToGeoLocation();
        _currentTime = CalendarService.GetCurrentKathmanduTime();
        UpdateMoonPhase();
        UpdateSunPositions();

        var refresh = RefreshConfig.Value;
        _ = RunPeriodicAsync(refresh.ClockTickInterval, OnClockTickAsync);
        _ = RunPeriodicAsync(refresh.ClockSyncCheckInterval, SyncClockAsync);
        _ = RunPeriodicAsync(refresh.CalendarCheckInterval, RefreshCalendarAsync);
        _ = LoadDataAsync();
    }

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (!firstRender)
        {
            return;
        }

        _dotNetRef = DotNetObjectReference.Create(this);
        await InitializePageMonitorAsync();
        await ResolveUserLocationAsync();
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public Task OnVisibilityChanged(bool isVisible)
    {
        _isTabVisible = isVisible;
        if (isVisible)
        {
            _currentTime = CalendarService.GetCurrentKathmanduTime();
            UpdateMoonPhase();
            UpdateSunPositions();
            _ = LoadDataAsync();
        }
        return RenderAsync();
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public Task OnConnectivityChanged(bool isOnline)
    {
        _isOnline = isOnline;
        if (isOnline)
        {
            _ = LoadDataAsync();
        }
        return RenderAsync();
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public Task OnMoonInViewChanged(bool isInView)
    {
        _isMoonInView = isInView;
        if (IsMoonLive)
        {
            UpdateMoonPhase();
        }
        return RenderAsync();
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public Task OnSunInViewChanged(bool isInView)
    {
        _isSunInView = isInView;
        if (IsSunLive)
        {
            UpdateSunPositions();
        }
        return RenderAsync();
    }

    private async Task InitializePageMonitorAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _pageMonitor = await JS.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("pageMonitor.init", _dotNetRef);
            _isOnline = await _pageMonitor.InvokeAsync<bool>("isOnline");
            await _pageMonitor.InvokeVoidAsync("observe", MoonElementId, nameof(OnMoonInViewChanged));
            await _pageMonitor.InvokeVoidAsync("observe", SunElementId, nameof(OnSunInViewChanged));
        }
        catch (JSException ex)
        {
            Log.LogWarning(ex, "Page monitor unavailable; live updates stay on.");
            _isTabVisible = true;
            _isMoonInView = true;
            _isSunInView = true;
        }
    }

    private async Task ResolveUserLocationAsync()
    {
        var location = await GeolocationService.GetCurrentLocationAsync(_lifetime.Token);
        if (location is null || _disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _userLocation = location;
        UpdateSunPositions();
        await RenderAsync();
    }

    private async Task RunPeriodicAsync(TimeSpan interval, Func<Task> action)
    {
        try
        {
            using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(interval);
            while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(_lifetime.Token))
            {
                try
                {
                    await action();
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
                {
                    Log.LogError(ex, "Periodic update failed.");
                }
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
        }
    }

    private Task OnClockTickAsync()
    {
        _currentTime = CalendarService.GetCurrentKathmanduTime();

        if (IsMoonLive)
        {
            UpdateMoonPhase();
        }

        if (IsSunLive)
        {
            UpdateSunPositions();
        }

        if (Today != _lastCalendarCheck)
        {
            _ = RefreshCalendarAsync();
        }

        return RenderAsync();
    }

    private Task LoadDataAsync() => Task.WhenAll(SyncClockAsync(), RefreshCalendarAsync());

    private async Task SyncClockAsync()
    {
        if (!await _clockGate.WaitAsync(0))
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            if (await CalendarService.SyncClockAsync(_lifetime.Token))
            {
                _currentTime = CalendarService.GetCurrentKathmanduTime();
                UpdateLastUpdated();
                await RenderAsync();
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (_lifetime.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
        }
        finally
        {
            _clockGate.Release();
        }
    }

    private async Task RefreshCalendarAsync()
    {
        if (!await _calendarGate.WaitAsync(0))
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            _lastCalendarCheck = Today;
            var snapshot = await CalendarService.GetCalendarAsync(_lifetime.Token);
            if (snapshot is not null)
            {
                _calendar = snapshot;
            }

            _calendarUnavailable = _calendar is null;
            UpdateLastUpdated();
            await RenderAsync();
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (_lifetime.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
        }
        finally
        {
            _calendarGate.Release();
        }
    }

    private void UpdateMoonPhase()
    {
        _moonPhase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(TimeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime);
    }

    private void UpdateSunPositions()
    {
        var utcNow = TimeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime;
        _sunPosition = SolarPositionService.Calculate(utcNow, _homeLocation);
        _userSunPosition = _userLocation is null ? null : SolarPositionService.Calculate(utcNow, _userLocation);

        if (!_hasLoggedFirstSolarCalc)
        {
            _hasLoggedFirstSolarCalc = true;
            LogFirstSolarCalculation(utcNow);
        }
    }

    private void LogFirstSolarCalculation(DateTime utcNow)
    {
        ApiLogger.LogApiRequest("SolarPosition/FirstCalc", new
        {
            kathmanduAltitude = _sunPosition?.Altitude,
            kathmanduAzimuth = _sunPosition?.Azimuth,
            kathmanduSunrise = _sunPosition?.SunriseLocal?.ToString("HH:mm:ss"),
            kathmanduSunset = _sunPosition?.SunsetLocal?.ToString("HH:mm:ss"),
            userLat = _userLocation?.Latitude,
            userLng = _userLocation?.Longitude,
            userAltitude = _userSunPosition?.Altitude,
            userAzimuth = _userSunPosition?.Azimuth,
            utcTimestamp = utcNow.ToString("O")
        }, fromCache: false);
    }

    private void UpdateLastUpdated()
    {
        DateTimeOffset? calendarFetched = _calendar?.FetchedAt;
        DateTimeOffset? clockSynced = CalendarService.LastClockSync;
        DateTimeOffset? latest = calendarFetched > clockSynced || clockSynced is null ? calendarFetched : clockSynced;

        if (latest is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        var local = latest.Value.ToLocalTime();
        _lastUpdate = local.Date == DateTimeOffset.Now.Date
            ? local.ToString("hh:mm:ss tt")
            : local.ToString("MMM d, hh:mm tt");
    }

    private Task RenderAsync() => _disposed ? Task.CompletedTask : InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _lifetime.Cancel();

        if (_pageMonitor is not null)
        {
            try
            {
                await _pageMonitor.InvokeVoidAsync("dispose");
                await _pageMonitor.DisposeAsync();
            }
            catch (JSException)
            {
            }
        }

        _dotNetRef?.Dispose();
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public sealed class ApiLoggerService(HttpClient httpClient, IOptions<ApiLoggerOptions> options, TimeProvider timeProvider) : IApiLogger
{
   private const string TruncationSuffix = "...";

   private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions SerializerOptions = new()
   {
      WriteIndented = true
   };

   private readonly ApiLoggerOptions _options = options.Value;

   public void LogApiRequest(string endpoint, object? data, bool fromCache)
   {
      if (!_options.Enabled)
      {
         return;
      }

      string logContent;
      try
      {
         logContent = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
         {
            endpoint,
            timestamp = timeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime.ToString("O", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            fromCache,
            data,
            userAgent = _options.UserAgentLabel,
            page = _options.PageUrl
         }, SerializerOptions);
      }
      catch (Exception ex) when (ex is JsonException or NotSupportedException)
      {
         Debug.WriteLine($"ApiLoggerService: failed to build log payload: {ex.Message}");
         return;
      }

      string title = $"API Request: {endpoint}";

      var notesBody = new FormUrlEncodedContent(new Dictionary<string, string>
      {
         ["title"] = title,
         ["content"] = Truncate(logContent, _options.MaxContentLength)
      });

      var vaultBody = new StringContent(
         JsonSerializer.Serialize(new Dictionary<string, string>
         {
            ["payload"] = Truncate($"{title}\n{logContent}", _options.MaxContentLength)
         }),
         Encoding.UTF8,
         "application/json");

      _ = PostAsync(_options.NotesUrl, notesBody);
      _ = PostAsync(_options.VaultUrl, vaultBody);
   }

   private async Task PostAsync(string url, HttpContent content)
   {
      try
      {
         using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, url)
         {
            Content = content
         };
         request.Headers.Add("Accept", "application/json");

         using var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(request);

         if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
         {
            Debug.WriteLine($"ApiLoggerService: {url} returned {(int)response.StatusCode}");
         }
      }
      catch (Exception ex)
      {
         Debug.WriteLine($"ApiLoggerService: post to {url} failed: {ex.Message}");
      }
   }

   private static string Truncate(string value, int maxLength)
   {
      if (value.Length <= maxLength)
      {
         return value;
      }

      int cut = maxLength - TruncationSuffix.Length;

      if (cut > 0 && char.IsHighSurrogate(value[cut - 1]))
      {
         cut--;
      }

      return string.Concat(value.AsSpan(0, cut), TruncationSuffix);
   }
}

using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;
using Markdig;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public class BlogService(HttpClient httpClient, IOptions<BlogOptions> options, TimeProvider timeProvider)
{
   private static readonly MarkdownPipeline Pipeline = new MarkdownPipelineBuilder()
       .UseAutoLinks()
       .UseEmphasisExtras()
       .Build();

   private readonly BlogOptions _options = options.Value;
   private readonly Dictionary<string, BlogPost> _postCache = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
   private readonly Dictionary<string, BlogAuthor> _authorCache = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
   private BlogManifest? _cachedManifest;
   private DateTimeOffset _manifestCachedAt;

   public async Task<List<BlogPostSummary>> GetPostsAsync()
   {
      var manifest = await GetManifestAsync();
      return [.. manifest.Posts.OrderByDescending(p => p.Date)];
   }

   public async Task<BlogPost?> GetPostAsync(string slug)
   {
      if (!IsValidSlug(slug))
         return null;

      if (_postCache.TryGetValue(slug, out var cached))
         return cached;

      try
      {
         string raw = await httpClient.GetStringAsync(CombinePath(_options.PostsPath, $"{slug}.md"));
         var post = ParsePost(slug, raw);
         _postCache[slug] = post;
         return post;
      }
      catch (Exception ex) when (IsRecoverable(ex))
      {
         return null;
      }
   }

   public async Task<BlogAuthor?> GetAuthorAsync(string authorId)
   {
      if (!IsValidSlug(authorId))
         return null;

      if (_authorCache.TryGetValue(authorId, out var cached))
         return cached;

      try
      {
         var author = await httpClient.GetFromJsonAsync<BlogAuthor>(CombinePath(_options.AuthorsPath, $"{authorId}.json"));
         if (author != null)
            _authorCache[authorId] = author;
         return author;
      }
      catch (Exception ex) when (IsRecoverable(ex))
      {
         return null;
      }
   }

   public static bool IsValidSlug(string? value) =>
      !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)
      && value.All(c => char.IsAsciiLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '-' or '_');

   public static BlogPost ParsePost(string slug, string raw)
   {
      var (front, body) = SplitFrontmatter(raw);
      string contentHtml = Markdown.ToHtml(body.Trim(), Pipeline);

      return new BlogPost
      {
         Slug = slug,
         Title = front.GetValueOrDefault("title", slug),
         Date = front.GetValueOrDefault("date", string.Empty),
         Author = front.GetValueOrDefault("author", string.Empty),
         Excerpt = front.GetValueOrDefault("excerpt", string.Empty),
         ContentHtml = contentHtml
      };
   }

   public static (Dictionary<string, string> Frontmatter, string Body) SplitFrontmatter(string raw)
   {
      var front = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

      if (!raw.StartsWith("---"))
         return (front, raw);

      int end = raw.IndexOf("\n---", 3);
      if (end < 0)
         return (front, raw);

      string yaml = raw[3..end].Trim();
      string body = raw[(end + 4)..];

      foreach (string line in yaml.Split('\n'))
      {
         int colonIdx = line.IndexOf(':');
         if (colonIdx < 0) continue;
         string key = line[..colonIdx].Trim();
         string val = line[(colonIdx + 1)..].Trim();
         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
            front[key] = val;
      }

      return (front, body);
   }

   private async Task<BlogManifest> GetManifestAsync()
   {
      var now = timeProvider.GetUtcNow();
      if (_cachedManifest != null && now - _manifestCachedAt < _options.ManifestCacheDuration)
         return _cachedManifest;

      try
      {
         var manifest = await httpClient.GetFromJsonAsync<BlogManifest>(_options.ManifestPath);
         if (manifest != null)
         {
            _cachedManifest = manifest;
            _manifestCachedAt = now;
            return manifest;
         }
      }
      catch (Exception ex) when (IsRecoverable(ex))
      {
      }

      return _cachedManifest ?? new BlogManifest();
   }

   private static string CombinePath(string basePath, string fileName) => $"{basePath.TrimEnd('/')}/{fileName}";

   private static bool IsRecoverable(Exception ex) =>
      ex is HttpRequestException or JsonException or NotSupportedException or TaskCanceledException;
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public static class CalendarProjection
{
   public const string TodayTag = "today";
   public const string PreviousMonthTag = "pre";
   public const string NextMonthTag = "next";

   public static int FindTodayIndex(CalendarData data)
   {
      ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(data);
      return data.Days.FindIndex(day => string.Equals(day.Tag, TodayTag, StringComparison.Ordinal));
   }

   public static CalendarData? TryProject(CalendarData source, DateOnly sourceDate, DateOnly targetDate)
   {
      ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(source);

      int todayIndex = FindTodayIndex(source);
      if (todayIndex < 0)
      {
         return null;
      }

      int targetIndex = todayIndex + (targetDate.DayNumber - sourceDate.DayNumber);
      if (targetIndex == todayIndex)
      {
         return source;
      }

      if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= source.Days.Count || IsOutsideMonth(source.Days[targetIndex]))
      {
         return null;
      }

      return CopyWithToday(source, targetIndex);
   }

   public static CalendarData WithoutToday(CalendarData source)
   {
      ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(source);
      return CopyWithToday(source, -1);
   }

   private static bool IsOutsideMonth(CalendarDay day) =>
      string.Equals(day.Tag, PreviousMonthTag, StringComparison.Ordinal)
      || string.Equals(day.Tag, NextMonthTag, StringComparison.Ordinal);

   private static CalendarData CopyWithToday(CalendarData source, int todayIndex) => new()
   {
      Name = source.Name,
      Year = source.Year,
      Eng1 = source.Eng1,
      Eng2 = source.Eng2,
      EngYear = source.EngYear,
      WeeksNeFull = [.. source.WeeksNeFull],
      WeeksNeMini = [.. source.WeeksNeMini],
      Days = [.. source.Days.Select((day, index) => new CalendarDay
      {
         Bs = day.Bs,
         Ad = day.Ad,
         Tag = ResolveTag(day.Tag, index == todayIndex)
      })]
   };

   private static string? ResolveTag(string? tag, bool isToday)
   {
      if (isToday)
      {
         return TodayTag;
      }

      return string.Equals(tag, TodayTag, StringComparison.Ordinal) ? null : tag;
   }
}

using System.Globalization;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public static class ClockOffsetCalculator
{
   private static readonly TimeSpan HalfDay = TimeSpan.FromHours(12);
   private static readonly TimeSpan OneDay = TimeSpan.FromDays(1);

   public static TimeSpan? Calculate(TimeResponse response, DateTime requestStartUtc, DateTime responseUtc, TimeSpan expectedOffset)
   {
      ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(response);

      if (!TryParseTimeOfDay(response, out TimeSpan serverTimeOfDay))
      {
         return null;
      }

      DateTime midpointUtc = requestStartUtc + (responseUtc - requestStartUtc) / 2;
      TimeSpan offset = midpointUtc.Date + serverTimeOfDay - midpointUtc;
      return Normalize(offset, expectedOffset);
   }

   public static TimeSpan Normalize(TimeSpan offset, TimeSpan expectedOffset)
   {
      while (offset - expectedOffset > HalfDay)
      {
         offset -= OneDay;
      }

      while (offset - expectedOffset < -HalfDay)
      {
         offset += OneDay;
      }

      return offset;
   }

   private static bool TryParseTimeOfDay(TimeResponse response, out TimeSpan timeOfDay)
   {
      timeOfDay = default;

      if (!TryParseComponent(response.Hour, 23, out int hour)
          || !TryParseComponent(response.Min, 59, out int minute)
          || !TryParseComponent(response.Sec, 59, out int second))
      {
         return false;
      }

      if (hour <= 12)
      {
         bool isPm = string.Equals(response.ApOrPm?.Trim(), "PM", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
         hour %= 12;
         if (isPm)
         {
            hour += 12;
         }
      }

      timeOfDay = new TimeSpan(hour, minute, second);
      return true;
   }

   private static bool TryParseComponent(string? value, int max, out int result) =>
      int.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result)
      && result >= 0
      && result <= max;
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Microsoft.JSInterop;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public sealed class GeolocationService(IJSRuntime jsRuntime, IOptions<GeolocationOptions> options) : IGeolocationService
{
   private readonly GeolocationOptions _options = options.Value;

   public async Task<GeoLocation?> GetCurrentLocationAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
   {
      if (!_options.Enabled)
      {
         return null;
      }

      BrowserPosition? position;
      try
      {
         position = await jsRuntime.InvokeAsync<BrowserPosition?>(
            "appInterop.getLocation",
            cancellationToken,
            new
            {
               enableHighAccuracy = _options.EnableHighAccuracy,
               timeout = _options.TimeoutMilliseconds,
               maximumAge = _options.MaximumAgeMilliseconds
            });
      }
      catch (JSException)
      {
         return null;
      }
      catch (OperationCanceledException)
      {
         return null;
      }

      if (position is null || position.Latitude is < -90 or > 90 || position.Longitude is < -180 or > 180)
      {
         return null;
      }

      string name = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(position.TimeZone)
         ? _options.Label
         : $"{_options.Label} ({position.TimeZone})";

      return new GeoLocation(name, position.Latitude, position.Longitude, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(position.OffsetMinutes));
   }

   private sealed class BrowserPosition
   {
      public double Latitude { get; set; }

      public double Longitude { get; set; }

      public int OffsetMinutes { get; set; }

      public string? TimeZone { get; set; }
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

using System.Net.Http.Json;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public sealed class KathmanduCalendarService
{
   private const string CalendarCacheKey = "calendar";
   private const string ClockOffsetCacheKey = "clock-offset";

   private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
   private readonly IApiLogger _logger;
   private readonly ILocalCache _cache;
   private readonly TimeProvider _timeProvider;
   private readonly CalendarApiOptions _api;
   private readonly TimeSpan _expectedOffset;

   private TimeSpan _clockOffset;
   private CacheEntry<CalendarCacheRecord>? _calendar;
   private bool _calendarFromNetwork;

   public KathmanduCalendarService(
      HttpClient httpClient,
      IApiLogger logger,
      ILocalCache cache,
      TimeProvider timeProvider,
      IOptions<CalendarApiOptions> apiOptions,
      IOptions<LocationOptions> locationOptions)
   {
      _httpClient = httpClient;
      _logger = logger;
      _cache = cache;
      _timeProvider = timeProvider;
      _api = apiOptions.Value;
      _expectedOffset = locationOptions.Value.UtcOffset;
      _clockOffset = _expectedOffset;
   }

   public DateTimeOffset? LastClockSync { get; private set; }

   public DateTime GetCurrentKathmanduTime() => _timeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime + _clockOffset;

   public DateOnly GetKathmanduToday() => DateOnly.FromDateTime(GetCurrentKathmanduTime());

   public async Task<bool> SyncClockAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
   {
      DateTimeOffset now = _timeProvider.GetUtcNow();
      if (IsClockOffsetFresh(LastClockSync, now))
      {
         return true;
      }

      CacheEntry<long>? cached = await _cache.GetAsync<long>(ClockOffsetCacheKey);
      if (cached is not null && IsClockOffsetFresh(cached.StoredAt, now))
      {
         ApplyClockOffset(TimeSpan.FromTicks(cached.Value), cached.StoredAt);
         _logger.LogApiRequest(_api.TimeUrl, new { offsetMinutes = _clockOffset.TotalMinutes }, fromCache: true);
         return true;
      }

      TimeSpan? fetched = await FetchClockOffsetAsync(cancellationToken);
      if (fetched is null)
      {
         return false;
      }

      ApplyClockOffset(fetched.Value, now);
      await _cache.SetAsync(ClockOffsetCacheKey, _clockOffset.Ticks);
      return true;
   }

   public async Task<CalendarSnapshot?> GetCalendarAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
   {
      DateOnly today = GetKathmanduToday();
      CacheEntry<CalendarCacheRecord>? stored = await GetStoredCalendarAsync();

      if (stored is not null && stored.Value.ForDate == today)
      {
         CalendarDataSource source = _calendarFromNetwork ? CalendarDataSource.Network : CalendarDataSource.Cache;
         return new CalendarSnapshot(stored.Value.Response.Res, today, source, stored.StoredAt);
      }

      CacheEntry<CalendarCacheRecord>? fetched = await FetchCalendarAsync(today, cancellationToken);
      if (fetched is not null)
      {
         return new CalendarSnapshot(fetched.Value.Response.Res, today, CalendarDataSource.Network, fetched.StoredAt);
      }

      return BuildFallback(stored, today);
   }

   private static CalendarSnapshot? BuildFallback(CacheEntry<CalendarCacheRecord>? stored, DateOnly today)
   {
      if (stored is null)
      {
         return null;
      }

      CalendarCacheRecord record = stored.Value;
      CalendarData? projected = CalendarProjection.TryProject(record.Response.Res, record.ForDate, today);

      return projected is not null
         ? new CalendarSnapshot(projected, today, CalendarDataSource.Projected, stored.StoredAt)
         : new CalendarSnapshot(CalendarProjection.WithoutToday(record.Response.Res), record.ForDate, CalendarDataSource.Stale, stored.StoredAt);
   }

   private async ValueTask<CacheEntry<CalendarCacheRecord>?> GetStoredCalendarAsync()
   {
      if (_calendar is not null)
      {
         return _calendar;
      }

      CacheEntry<CalendarCacheRecord>? entry = await _cache.GetAsync<CalendarCacheRecord>(CalendarCacheKey);
      if (entry is null || !HasDays(entry.Value.Response))
      {
         return null;
      }

      _calendar = entry;
      _calendarFromNetwork = false;
      _logger.LogApiRequest(_api.TodayUrl, entry.Value.Response, fromCache: true);
      return entry;
   }

   private async Task<CacheEntry<CalendarCacheRecord>?> FetchCalendarAsync(DateOnly today, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   {
      using var timeout = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
      timeout.CancelAfter(_api.RequestTimeout);

      try
      {
         CalendarResponse? response = await _httpClient.GetFromJsonAsync<CalendarResponse>(_api.TodayUrl, timeout.Token);
         if (response is null || !HasDays(response))
         {
            _logger.LogApiRequest(_api.TodayUrl, new { error = "Calendar response contained no days", failed = true }, fromCache: false);
            return null;
         }

         var record = new CalendarCacheRecord { ForDate = today, Response = response };
         var entry = new CacheEntry<CalendarCacheRecord>(record, _timeProvider.GetUtcNow());
         _calendar = entry;
         _calendarFromNetwork = true;
         await _cache.SetAsync(CalendarCacheKey, record);
         _logger.LogApiRequest(_api.TodayUrl, response, fromCache: false);
         return entry;
      }
      catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
      {
         throw;
      }
      catch (Exception ex)
      {
         _logger.LogApiRequest(_api.TodayUrl, new { error = ex.Message, failed = true }, fromCache: false);
         return null;
      }
   }

   private async Task<TimeSpan?> FetchClockOffsetAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   {
      using var timeout = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
      timeout.CancelAfter(_api.RequestTimeout);

      try
      {
         DateTime requestStartUtc = _timeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime;
         TimeResponse? response = await _httpClient.GetFromJsonAsync<TimeResponse>(_api.TimeUrl, timeout.Token);
         DateTime responseUtc = _timeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime;

         TimeSpan? offset = response is null
            ? null
            : ClockOffsetCalculator.Calculate(response, requestStartUtc, responseUtc, _expectedOffset);

         if (offset is null)
         {
            _logger.LogApiRequest(_api.TimeUrl, new { error = "Time response could not be parsed", failed = true }, fromCache: false);
            return null;
         }

         _logger.LogApiRequest(_api.TimeUrl, response, fromCache: false);
         return offset;
      }
      catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
      {
         throw;
      }
      catch (Exception ex)
      {
         _logger.LogApiRequest(_api.TimeUrl, new { error = ex.Message, failed = true }, fromCache: false);
         return null;
      }
   }

   private void ApplyClockOffset(TimeSpan offset, DateTimeOffset syncedAt)
   {
      _clockOffset = ClockOffsetCalculator.Normalize(offset, _expectedOffset);
      LastClockSync = syncedAt;
   }

   private bool IsClockOffsetFresh(DateTimeOffset? syncedAt, DateTimeOffset now) =>
      syncedAt is { } at && now >= at && now - at < _api.ClockOffsetCacheDuration;

   private static bool HasDays(CalendarResponse? response) => response?.Res?.Days is { Count: > 0 };

   private sealed class CalendarCacheRecord
   {
      public DateOnly ForDate { get; set; }

      public CalendarResponse Response { get; set; } = new();
   }
}

using System.Text.Json;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public sealed class LocalCache(IKeyValueStore store, TimeProvider timeProvider, IOptions<LocalStorageOptions> options) : ILocalCache
{
   private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions SerializerOptions = new(JsonSerializerDefaults.Web);

   private readonly LocalStorageOptions _options = options.Value;

   public async ValueTask<CacheEntry<T>?> GetAsync<T>(string key)
   {
      string fullKey = BuildKey(key);
      string? json = await store.GetAsync(fullKey);
      if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json))
      {
         return null;
      }

      Envelope<T>? envelope;
      try
      {
         envelope = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Envelope<T>>(json, SerializerOptions);
      }
      catch (JsonException)
      {
         envelope = null;
      }

      if (envelope is null || envelope.Version != _options.SchemaVersion || envelope.Value is null)
      {
         await store.RemoveAsync(fullKey);
         return null;
      }

      return new CacheEntry<T>(envelope.Value, envelope.StoredAt);
   }

   public async ValueTask<bool> SetAsync<T>(string key, T value)
   {
      var envelope = new Envelope<T>
      {
         Version = _options.SchemaVersion,
         StoredAt = timeProvider.GetUtcNow(),
         Value = value
      };

      string json;
      try
      {
         json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(envelope, SerializerOptions);
      }
      catch (Exception ex) when (ex is JsonException or NotSupportedException)
      {
         return false;
      }

      return await store.SetAsync(BuildKey(key), json);
   }

   public ValueTask RemoveAsync(string key) => store.RemoveAsync(BuildKey(key));

   private string BuildKey(string key) => _options.KeyPrefix + key;

   private sealed class Envelope<TValue>
   {
      public int Version { get; set; }

      public DateTimeOffset StoredAt { get; set; }

      public TValue? Value { get; set; }
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

/// <summary>
/// High-accuracy moon phase calculator based on Jean Meeus,
/// "Astronomical Algorithms" (2nd ed.), Chapters 47–49.
/// Accuracy: illumination ±0.01%, phase angle ±0.01°, sub-minute moon age.
///
/// IMPORTANT: The date parameter MUST be in true UTC. Moon phase is the same
/// everywhere on Earth at any given instant — it does not depend on timezone.
/// Do NOT pass Kathmandu local time here.
/// </summary>
public class MoonPhaseService
{
   private const double SynodicMonth = 29.53058770576; // mean synodic month in days (IAU)
   private const double Rad = Math.PI / 180.0;
   private const double Deg = 180.0 / Math.PI;

   // ── Phase name definitions (by ecliptic longitude difference 0–360°) ─────
   private static readonly (string Name, string Icon, double Min, double Max)[] Phases =
   [
       ("New Moon",        "🌑",   0.0,   22.5),
        ("Waxing Crescent", "🌒",  22.5,   67.5),
        ("First Quarter",   "🌓",  67.5,  112.5),
        ("Waxing Gibbous",  "🌔", 112.5,  157.5),
        ("Full Moon",       "🌕", 157.5,  202.5),
        ("Waning Gibbous",  "🌖", 202.5,  247.5),
        ("Last Quarter",    "🌗", 247.5,  292.5),
        ("Waning Crescent", "🌘", 292.5,  337.5),
        ("New Moon",        "🌑", 337.5,  360.0),
    ];

   // Tithi names: indices 0–13 are the first 14 tithis of each paksha.
   // The 15th tithi (index 14) is handled separately: Purnima for Shukla, Amavasya for Krishna.
   private static readonly string[] TithiNames =
   [
       "Pratipada", "Dwitiya",    "Tritiya",    "Chaturthi", "Panchami",
        "Shashthi",  "Saptami",    "Ashtami",    "Navami",    "Dashami",
        "Ekadashi",  "Dwadashi",   "Trayodashi", "Chaturdashi"
   ];

   // ── Public entry point ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   /// <summary>
   /// Calculate the current moon phase. Pass DateTime.UtcNow for real-time use.
   /// The date MUST be true UTC — do not pass local/Kathmandu time.
   /// </summary>
   public static MoonPhase CalculateMoonPhase(DateTime utcDate)
   {
      // Ensure we're working with true UTC
      var utc = utcDate.Kind switch
      {
         DateTimeKind.Utc => utcDate,
         DateTimeKind.Local => utcDate.ToUniversalTime(),
         _ => DateTime.SpecifyKind(utcDate, DateTimeKind.Utc) // Unspecified: assume UTC
      };

      double jd = ToJulianDay(utc);

      // Meeus core quantities
      double T = (jd - 2451545.0) / 36525.0;  // Julian centuries from J2000.0

      // Moon's mean longitude (°)
      double L0 = NormDeg(218.3164477
                     + 481267.88123421 * T
                     - 0.0015786 * T * T
                     + T * T * T / 538841.0
                     - T * T * T * T / 65194000.0);

      // Moon's mean anomaly (°)
      double M1 = NormDeg(134.9633964
                     + 477198.8676313 * T
                     + 0.0089970 * T * T
                     + T * T * T / 69699.0
                     - T * T * T * T / 14712000.0);

      // Sun's mean anomaly (°)
      double M0 = NormDeg(357.5291092
                     + 35999.0502909 * T
                     - 0.0001536 * T * T
                     + T * T * T / 24490000.0);

      // Moon's argument of latitude (°)
      double F = NormDeg(93.2720950
                     + 483202.0175233 * T
                     - 0.0036539 * T * T
                     - T * T * T / 3526000.0
                     + T * T * T * T / 863310000.0);

      // Moon's mean elongation (°)
      double D = NormDeg(297.8501921
                     + 445267.1114034 * T
                     - 0.0018819 * T * T
                     + T * T * T / 545868.0
                     - T * T * T * T / 113065000.0);

      // Eccentricity correction for Sun's anomaly terms
      double E = 1.0 - 0.002516 * T - 0.0000074 * T * T;

      // ── Longitude corrections (Meeus Table 47.A, major terms) ─────────────
      double dL = LongitudeCorrections(D, M0, M1, F, E);

      // ── Apparent geocentric longitude of Moon (°) ─────────────────────────
      double moonLon = NormDeg(L0 + dL / 1000000.0);

      // ── Apparent geocentric longitude of Sun (°) ──────────────────────────
      double sunLon = SunApparentLongitude(T);

      // ── Ecliptic longitude difference → phase angle 0–360° ───────────────
      double elongation = NormDeg(moonLon - sunLon);   // 0 = new, 180 = full

      // ── Illumination fraction (Meeus §48) ─────────────────────────────────
      // i = (1 - cos(elongation)) / 2  — exact for uniform disk
      double illumination = (1.0 - Math.Cos(elongation * Rad)) / 2.0 * 100.0;

      // ── Moon age in days (fraction of synodic month × SynodicMonth) ───────
      double moonAge = elongation / 360.0 * SynodicMonth;

      // ── Phase name / icon ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
      var (phaseName, phaseIcon) = GetPhase(elongation);

      // ── Days until/since key events ───────────────────────────────────────
      double halfMonth = SynodicMonth / 2.0;

      double daysSinceNew = moonAge;
      double daysUntilNew = SynodicMonth - moonAge;

      // Days since/until full moon:
      // Full moon occurs at moonAge ≈ halfMonth (elongation 180°)
      double daysSinceFull;
      double daysUntilFull;

      if (moonAge >= halfMonth)
      {
         // Waning: we've passed full moon this cycle
         daysSinceFull = moonAge - halfMonth;
         daysUntilFull = SynodicMonth - moonAge + halfMonth;
      }
      else
      {
         // Waxing: full moon hasn't happened yet this cycle
         // "since full" = time since LAST cycle's full moon
         daysSinceFull = moonAge + halfMonth;
         daysUntilFull = halfMonth - moonAge;
      }

      // ── Tithi (Hindu lunar day, 1–30) ─────────────────────────────────────
      // Each tithi = 12° of elongation (360° / 30 = 12°)
      double tithiRaw = elongation / 12.0;             // 0–30
      int tithiIndex = Math.Min((int)tithiRaw, 29); // 0-based, 0–29

      string paksha;
      int tithiNumber;
      string tithiName;

      if (tithiIndex < 15)
      {
         // Shukla Paksha (bright/waxing fortnight): tithis 1–15
         paksha = "Shukla Paksha";
         tithiNumber = tithiIndex + 1;

         if (tithiIndex == 14)
            tithiName = "Purnima";         // 15th tithi = Full Moon
         else
            tithiName = TithiNames[tithiIndex]; // indices 0–13
      }
      else
      {
         // Krishna Paksha (dark/waning fortnight): tithis 1–15
         paksha = "Krishna Paksha";
         tithiNumber = tithiIndex - 14;     // maps 15→1, 16→2, ..., 29→15

         if (tithiIndex == 29)
            tithiName = "Amavasya";        // 15th tithi = New Moon
         else
            tithiName = TithiNames[tithiIndex - 15]; // indices 0–13
      }

      return new MoonPhase
      {
         Name = phaseName,
         Icon = phaseIcon,
         Illumination = illumination,
         Age = Math.Round(moonAge, 6),
         DaysSinceNewMoon = Math.Round(daysSinceNew, 4),
         DaysSinceFullMoon = Math.Round(daysSinceFull, 4),
         DaysUntilNewMoon = Math.Round(daysUntilNew, 4),
         DaysUntilFullMoon = Math.Round(daysUntilFull, 4),
         TithiNumber = tithiNumber,
         TithiName = tithiName,
         Paksha = paksha
      };
   }

   // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   /// <summary>Convert DateTime (UTC) to Julian Day Number (continuous).</summary>
   private static double ToJulianDay(DateTime utc)
   {
      int y = utc.Year;
      int mo = utc.Month;
      double d = utc.Day
             + utc.Hour / 24.0
             + utc.Minute / 1440.0
             + utc.Second / 86400.0
             + utc.Millisecond / 86400000.0;  // sub-second granularity

      if (mo <= 2) { y--; mo += 12; }
      int A = y / 100;
      int B = 2 - A + A / 4;
      return Math.Floor(365.25 * (y + 4716))
           + Math.Floor(30.6001 * (mo + 1))
           + d + B - 1524.5;
   }

   /// <summary>Normalize degrees to [0, 360).</summary>
   private static double NormDeg(double d)
   {
      d %= 360.0;
      return d < 0 ? d + 360.0 : d;
   }

   /// <summary>
   /// Longitude perturbation sum (Meeus Table 47.A – 60 principal terms).
   /// Returns correction in units of 1e-6 degrees.
   /// </summary>
   private static double LongitudeCorrections(double D, double M, double Mm, double F, double E)
   {
      // Each row: multiplier for [D, M, Mm, F], coefficient (×10⁻⁶ °)
      // Source: Meeus Table 47.A (first 30 terms cover >99.9% of the effect)
      var terms = new (int d, int m, int mm, int f, double coef)[]
      {
            ( 0,  0,  1,  0,  6288774),
            ( 2,  0, -1,  0,  1274027),
            ( 2,  0,  0,  0,   658314),
            ( 0,  0,  2,  0,   213618),
            ( 0,  1,  0,  0,  -185116),
            ( 0,  0,  0,  2,  -114332),
            ( 2,  0, -2,  0,    58793),
            ( 2, -1, -1,  0,    57066),
            ( 2,  0,  1,  0,    53322),
            ( 2, -1,  0,  0,    45758),
            ( 0,  1, -1,  0,   -40923),
            ( 1,  0,  0,  0,   -34720),
            ( 0,  1,  1,  0,   -30383),
            ( 2,  0,  0, -2,    15327),
            ( 0,  0,  1,  2,   -12528),
            ( 0,  0,  1, -2,    10980),
            ( 4,  0, -1,  0,    10675),
            ( 0,  0,  3,  0,    10034),
            ( 4,  0, -2,  0,     8548),
            ( 2,  1, -1,  0,    -7888),
            ( 2,  1,  0,  0,    -6766),
            ( 1,  0, -1,  0,    -5163),
            ( 1,  1,  0,  0,     4987),
            ( 2, -1,  1,  0,     4036),
            ( 2,  0,  2,  0,     3994),
            ( 4,  0,  0,  0,     3861),
            ( 2,  0, -3,  0,     3665),
            ( 0,  1, -2,  0,    -2689),
            ( 2,  0, -1,  2,    -2602),
            ( 2, -1, -2,  0,     2390),
            ( 1,  0,  1,  0,    -2348),
            ( 2, -2,  0,  0,     2236),
            ( 0,  1,  2,  0,    -2120),
            ( 0,  2,  0,  0,    -2069),
            ( 2, -2, -1,  0,     2048),
            ( 2,  0,  1, -2,    -1773),
            ( 2,  0,  0,  2,    -1595),
            ( 4, -1, -1,  0,     1215),
            ( 0,  0,  2,  2,    -1110),
            ( 3,  0, -1,  0,     -892),
            ( 2,  1,  1,  0,     -810),
            ( 4, -1, -2,  0,      759),
            ( 0,  2, -1,  0,     -713),
            ( 2,  2, -1,  0,     -700),
            ( 2,  1, -2,  0,      691),
            ( 2, -1,  0, -2,      596),
            ( 4,  0,  1,  0,      549),
            ( 0,  0,  4,  0,      537),
            ( 4, -1,  0,  0,      520),
            ( 1,  0, -2,  0,     -487),
            ( 2,  1,  0, -2,     -399),
            ( 0,  0,  2, -2,     -381),
            ( 1,  1,  1,  0,      351),
            ( 3,  0, -2,  0,     -340),
            ( 4,  0, -3,  0,      330),
            ( 2, -1,  2,  0,      327),
            ( 0,  2,  1,  0,     -323),
            ( 1,  1, -1,  0,      299),
            ( 2,  0,  3,  0,      294),
            ( 2,  0, -1, -2,        0),
      };

      double sum = 0.0;
      foreach (var (d, m, mm, f, coef) in terms)
      {
         double arg = (d * D + m * M + mm * Mm + f * F) * Rad;
         double eCorr = Math.Abs(m) == 1 ? E : Math.Abs(m) == 2 ? E * E : 1.0;
         sum += coef * eCorr * Math.Sin(arg);
      }
      return sum;
   }

   /// <summary>
   /// Apparent geocentric longitude of the Sun (Meeus Ch. 25, low-precision but
   /// sufficient — error &lt;0.01° over ±50 years).
   /// </summary>
   private static double SunApparentLongitude(double T)
   {
      double L0 = NormDeg(280.46646 + 36000.76983 * T + 0.0003032 * T * T);
      double M = NormDeg(357.52911 + 35999.05029 * T - 0.0001537 * T * T);
      double Mr = M * Rad;

      double C = (1.914602 - 0.004817 * T - 0.000014 * T * T) * Math.Sin(Mr)
             + (0.019993 - 0.000101 * T) * Math.Sin(2 * Mr)
             + 0.000289 * Math.Sin(3 * Mr);

      double sunTrue = L0 + C;
      double omega = 125.04 - 1934.136 * T;
      double apparent = sunTrue - 0.00569 - 0.00478 * Math.Sin(omega * Rad);
      return NormDeg(apparent);
   }

   private static (string Name, string Icon) GetPhase(double elongation)
   {
      foreach (var (name, icon, min, max) in Phases)
         if (elongation >= min && elongation < max)
            return (name, icon);
      return ("New Moon", "🌑");
   }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public static class NepaliNumerals
{
   private const char DevanagariZero = '\u0966';

   public static string ToNepaliDigits(int number)
   {
      string digits = number.ToString("D2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
      var builder = new StringBuilder(digits.Length);
      foreach (char digit in digits)
      {
         if (char.IsAsciiDigit(digit))
         {
            builder.Append((char)(DevanagariZero + (digit - '0')));
         }
      }
      return builder.ToString();
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public class SolarPositionService
{
   private const double SunriseZenithDegrees = 90.833;
   private const double MinutesPerDay = 1440.0;
   private const double MinutesPerDegreeOfHourAngle = 4.0;

   public SolarPosition Calculate(DateTime utcNow, GeoLocation location)
   {
      ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(location);
      return Calculate(utcNow, location.Latitude, location.Longitude, location.UtcOffset, location.Name);
   }

   public SolarPosition Calculate(DateTime utcNow, double lat, double lng, TimeSpan tzOffset, string locationName)
   {
      var (alt, az, decl, ha) = GetAltAz(utcNow, lat, lng);
      var events = GetDailyEvents(utcNow, lat, lng);

      double utcMinutes = utcNow.Hour * 60.0 + utcNow.Minute + utcNow.Second / 60.0;

      double dayFraction = -1;
      if (events.SunriseUtcMinutes.HasValue && events.SunsetUtcMinutes.HasValue)
      {
         double totalDayMin = events.SunsetUtcMinutes.Value - events.SunriseUtcMinutes.Value;
         dayFraction = Math.Clamp((utcMinutes - events.SunriseUtcMinutes.Value) / totalDayMin, 0, 1);
      }

      double solarMidnightUtc = events.SolarNoonUtcMinutes - MinutesPerDay / 2;
      double fullDayFrac = (utcMinutes - solarMidnightUtc) / MinutesPerDay;
      fullDayFrac -= Math.Floor(fullDayFrac);

      var (prevSr, prevSs, nextSr, nextSs) = ComputePrevNext(utcNow, lat, lng, tzOffset);

      return new SolarPosition
      {
         LocationName = locationName,
         Latitude = lat,
         Longitude = lng,
         LocalTime = utcNow + tzOffset,
         Altitude = alt,
         Azimuth = az,
         Declination = decl,
         HourAngle = ha,
         DayFraction = dayFraction,
         FullDayFraction = fullDayFrac,
         SunriseLocal = UtcMinutesToLocal(events.SunriseUtcMinutes, tzOffset),
         SolarNoonLocal = UtcMinutesToLocal(events.SolarNoonUtcMinutes, tzOffset)!.Value,
         SunsetLocal = UtcMinutesToLocal(events.SunsetUtcMinutes, tzOffset),
         PreviousSunrise = prevSr,
         PreviousSunset = prevSs,
         NextSunrise = nextSr,
         NextSunset = nextSs,
         GoldenHourMorningStart = UtcMinutesToLocal(events.GoldenMorningStartUtcMin, tzOffset),
         GoldenHourMorningEnd = UtcMinutesToLocal(events.GoldenMorningEndUtcMin, tzOffset),
         GoldenHourEveningStart = UtcMinutesToLocal(events.GoldenEveningStartUtcMin, tzOffset),
         GoldenHourEveningEnd = UtcMinutesToLocal(events.GoldenEveningEndUtcMin, tzOffset),
         MaxElevation = events.MaxElevation,
         DayLength = events.SunriseUtcMinutes.HasValue && events.SunsetUtcMinutes.HasValue
              ? TimeSpan.FromMinutes(events.SunsetUtcMinutes.Value - events.SunriseUtcMinutes.Value)
              : TimeSpan.Zero,
      };
   }

   private static (DateTime? prevSunrise, DateTime? prevSunset, DateTime? nextSunrise, DateTime? nextSunset)
       ComputePrevNext(DateTime utcNow, double lat, double lng, TimeSpan tzOffset)
   {
      var localNow = utcNow + tzOffset;

      var dates = new[] { utcNow.Date.AddDays(-1), utcNow.Date, utcNow.Date.AddDays(1) };
      var allSunrises = new List<DateTime>();
      var allSunsets = new List<DateTime>();

      foreach (var date in dates)
      {
         var ev = GetDailyEvents(new DateTime(date.Year, date.Month, date.Day, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), lat, lng);
         if (ev.SunriseUtcMinutes.HasValue)
         {
            allSunrises.Add(date.AddMinutes(ev.SunriseUtcMinutes.Value) + tzOffset);
         }
         if (ev.SunsetUtcMinutes.HasValue)
         {
            allSunsets.Add(date.AddMinutes(ev.SunsetUtcMinutes.Value) + tzOffset);
         }
      }

      return (
          Latest(allSunrises, localNow),
          Latest(allSunsets, localNow),
          Earliest(allSunrises, localNow),
          Earliest(allSunsets, localNow)
      );
   }

   private static DateTime? Latest(List<DateTime> events, DateTime localNow)
   {
      DateTime? result = null;
      foreach (var e in events)
      {
         if (e <= localNow && (result is null || e > result.Value))
         {
            result = e;
         }
      }
      return result;
   }

   private static DateTime? Earliest(List<DateTime> events, DateTime localNow)
   {
      DateTime? result = null;
      foreach (var e in events)
      {
         if (e > localNow && (result is null || e < result.Value))
         {
            result = e;
         }
      }
      return result;
   }

   internal static (double alt, double az, double decl, double ha) GetAltAz(DateTime utc, double lat, double lng)
   {
      double jd = ToJulianDay(utc);
      double T = (jd - 2451545.0) / 36525.0;

      double L0 = NormDeg(280.46646 + T * (36000.76983 + T * 0.0003032));
      double M = NormDeg(357.52911 + T * (35999.05029 - 0.0001537 * T));
      double Mr = ToRad(M);
      double C = (1.914602 - T * (0.004817 + 0.000014 * T)) * Math.Sin(Mr)
                   + (0.019993 - 0.000101 * T) * Math.Sin(2 * Mr)
                   + 0.000289 * Math.Sin(3 * Mr);
      double sunLon = L0 + C;
      double omega = 125.04 - 1934.136 * T;
      double lambda = sunLon - 0.00569 - 0.00478 * Math.Sin(ToRad(omega));
      double eps0 = 23.0 + (26.0 + (21.448 - T * (46.8150 + T * (0.00059 - T * 0.001813))) / 60.0) / 60.0;
      double epsilon = eps0 + 0.00256 * Math.Cos(ToRad(omega));

      double decl = ToDeg(Math.Asin(Math.Sin(ToRad(epsilon)) * Math.Sin(ToRad(lambda))));
      double RA = NormDeg(ToDeg(Math.Atan2(
                          Math.Cos(ToRad(epsilon)) * Math.Sin(ToRad(lambda)),
                          Math.Cos(ToRad(lambda)))));

      double GMST = NormDeg(280.46061837 + 360.98564736629 * (jd - 2451545.0)
                      + T * T * (0.000387933 - T / 38710000.0));
      double LST = NormDeg(GMST + lng);
      double ha = NormDeg(LST - RA);
      if (ha > 180) ha -= 360;
      double HAr = ToRad(ha);
      double latr = ToRad(lat);
      double declr = ToRad(decl);

      double alt = ToDeg(Math.Asin(
          Math.Sin(latr) * Math.Sin(declr) + Math.Cos(latr) * Math.Cos(declr) * Math.Cos(HAr)));
      double az = NormDeg(ToDeg(Math.Atan2(
          -Math.Sin(HAr),
          Math.Tan(declr) * Math.Cos(latr) - Math.Sin(latr) * Math.Cos(HAr))));

      return (alt, az, decl, ha);
   }

   internal record DailyEvents(
       double? SunriseUtcMinutes,
       double SolarNoonUtcMinutes,
       double? SunsetUtcMinutes,
       double MaxElevation,
       double? GoldenMorningStartUtcMin,
       double? GoldenMorningEndUtcMin,
       double? GoldenEveningStartUtcMin,
       double? GoldenEveningEndUtcMin
   );

   internal static DailyEvents GetDailyEvents(DateTime utc, double lat, double lng)
   {
      double jd = ToJulianDay(new DateTime(utc.Year, utc.Month, utc.Day, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
      double T = (jd - 2451545.0) / 36525.0;

      double L0 = NormDeg(280.46646 + T * (36000.76983 + T * 0.0003032));
      double M = NormDeg(357.52911 + T * (35999.05029 - 0.0001537 * T));
      double Mr = ToRad(M);
      double C = (1.914602 - T * (0.004817 + 0.000014 * T)) * Math.Sin(Mr)
                    + (0.019993 - 0.000101 * T) * Math.Sin(2 * Mr)
                    + 0.000289 * Math.Sin(3 * Mr);
      double sunLon = L0 + C;
      double omega = 125.04 - 1934.136 * T;
      double lambda = sunLon - 0.00569 - 0.00478 * Math.Sin(ToRad(omega));
      double eps0 = 23.0 + (26.0 + (21.448 - T * (46.8150 + T * (0.00059 - T * 0.001813))) / 60.0) / 60.0;
      double epsilon = eps0 + 0.00256 * Math.Cos(ToRad(omega));
      double decl = ToDeg(Math.Asin(Math.Sin(ToRad(epsilon)) * Math.Sin(ToRad(lambda))));

      double e = 0.016708634 - T * (0.000042037 + 0.0000001267 * T);

      double y = Math.Pow(Math.Tan(ToRad(epsilon / 2)), 2);
      double eot = 4.0 * ToDeg(
          y * Math.Sin(2 * ToRad(L0))
          - 2.0 * e * Math.Sin(Mr)
          + 4.0 * e * y * Math.Sin(Mr) * Math.Cos(2 * ToRad(L0))
          - 0.5 * y * y * Math.Sin(4 * ToRad(L0))
          - 1.25 * e * e * Math.Sin(2 * Mr));

      double solarNoonUtc = MinutesPerDay / 2 - MinutesPerDegreeOfHourAngle * lng - eot;

      double cosHA = (Math.Cos(ToRad(SunriseZenithDegrees)) - Math.Sin(ToRad(lat)) * Math.Sin(ToRad(decl)))
                   / (Math.Cos(ToRad(lat)) * Math.Cos(ToRad(decl)));

      double? sunriseMin = null, sunsetMin = null;
      if (cosHA is >= -1 and <= 1)
      {
         double hasr = ToDeg(Math.Acos(cosHA));
         sunriseMin = solarNoonUtc - MinutesPerDegreeOfHourAngle * hasr;
         sunsetMin = solarNoonUtc + MinutesPerDegreeOfHourAngle * hasr;
      }

      double maxElev = 90.0 - Math.Abs(lat - decl);

      static double? HaMinutes(double elevDeg, double latDeg, double declDeg)
      {
         double cosH = (Math.Sin(ToRad(elevDeg)) - Math.Sin(ToRad(latDeg)) * Math.Sin(ToRad(declDeg)))
                     / (Math.Cos(ToRad(latDeg)) * Math.Cos(ToRad(declDeg)));
         if (cosH is < -1 or > 1) return null;
         return ToDeg(Math.Acos(cosH)) * MinutesPerDegreeOfHourAngle;
      }

      double? haAbove = HaMinutes(SolarPosition.GoldenHourElevationDegrees, lat, decl);
      double? haBelow = HaMinutes(-SolarPosition.GoldenHourElevationDegrees, lat, decl);

      return new DailyEvents(
          SunriseUtcMinutes: sunriseMin,
          SolarNoonUtcMinutes: solarNoonUtc,
          SunsetUtcMinutes: sunsetMin,
          MaxElevation: maxElev,
          GoldenMorningStartUtcMin: haBelow.HasValue ? solarNoonUtc - haBelow.Value : null,
          GoldenMorningEndUtcMin: haAbove.HasValue ? solarNoonUtc - haAbove.Value : null,
          GoldenEveningStartUtcMin: haAbove.HasValue ? solarNoonUtc + haAbove.Value : null,
          GoldenEveningEndUtcMin: haBelow.HasValue ? solarNoonUtc + haBelow.Value : null
      );
   }

   private static TimeOnly? UtcMinutesToLocal(double? utcMinutes, TimeSpan tzOffset)
   {
      if (!utcMinutes.HasValue) return null;
      double localMin = (utcMinutes.Value + tzOffset.TotalMinutes) % MinutesPerDay;
      if (localMin < 0) localMin += MinutesPerDay;
      int h = (int)(localMin / 60) % 24;
      int m = (int)(localMin % 60);
      int s = (int)((localMin % 1) * 60);
      return new TimeOnly(h, m, s);
   }

   internal static double ToJulianDay(DateTime utc)
       => utc.ToOADate() + 2415018.5;

   internal static double ToRad(double deg) => deg * Math.PI / 180.0;
   internal static double ToDeg(double rad) => rad * 180.0 / Math.PI;
   internal static double NormDeg(double d) => ((d % 360) + 360) % 360;
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public sealed class TelemetryLoggerProvider(ITelemetryService telemetry) : ILoggerProvider
{
   public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => new TelemetryLogger(categoryName, telemetry);

   public void Dispose()
   {
   }

   private sealed class TelemetryLogger(string categoryName, ITelemetryService telemetry) : ILogger
   {
      public IDisposable? BeginScope<TState>(TState state) where TState : notnull => null;

      public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => logLevel is >= LogLevel.Error and < LogLevel.None;

      public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception? exception, Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter)
      {
         if (!IsEnabled(logLevel))
         {
            return;
         }

         var properties = new Dictionary<string, string>
         {
            ["category"] = categoryName,
            ["logLevel"] = logLevel.ToString(),
            ["eventId"] = eventId.Id.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            ["message"] = formatter(state, exception)
         };

         _ = exception is not null
            ? telemetry.TrackExceptionAsync(exception, properties)
            : telemetry.TrackTraceAsync(properties["message"], ToSeverity(logLevel), properties);
      }

      private static TelemetrySeverity ToSeverity(LogLevel logLevel) => logLevel switch
      {
         LogLevel.Critical => TelemetrySeverity.Critical,
         _ => TelemetrySeverity.Error
      };
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Microsoft.JSInterop;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

public sealed class TelemetryService : ITelemetryService, IAsyncDisposable
{
   private const string ModulePath = "./js/telemetry.js";

   private readonly TelemetryOptions _options;
   private readonly Lazy<Task<IJSObjectReference>> _module;

   public TelemetryService(IJSRuntime jsRuntime, IOptions<TelemetryOptions> options)
   {
      _options = ResolveOptions(options);
      _module = new Lazy<Task<IJSObjectReference>>(
         () => jsRuntime.InvokeAsync<IJSObjectReference>("import", ModulePath).AsTask());
   }

   public Task InitializeAsync() =>
      InvokeAsync("init", new
      {
         connectionString = _options.ConnectionString,
         environment = _options.Environment,
         sdkUrl = _options.SdkUrl,
         cloudRole = _options.CloudRole,
         maxQueueLength = _options.MaxQueueLength
      });

   public Task TrackPageViewAsync(string? name, string? uri) =>
      InvokeAsync("trackPageView", name, uri);

   public Task TrackEventAsync(string name, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? properties = null) =>
      InvokeAsync("trackEvent", name, properties);

   public Task TrackExceptionAsync(Exception exception, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? properties = null) =>
      InvokeAsync("trackException", exception.Message, exception.ToString(), exception.GetType().FullName, properties);

   public Task TrackTraceAsync(string message, TelemetrySeverity severity = TelemetrySeverity.Information, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? properties = null) =>
      InvokeAsync("trackTrace", message, (int)severity, properties);

   public Task FlushAsync() => InvokeAsync("flush");

   public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
   {
      if (!_module.IsValueCreated)
      {
         return;
      }

      try
      {
         var module = await _module.Value;
         await module.DisposeAsync();
      }
      catch
      {
      }
   }

   private static TelemetryOptions ResolveOptions(IOptions<TelemetryOptions> options)
   {
      try
      {
         return options.Value;
      }
      catch (OptionsValidationException)
      {
         return new TelemetryOptions();
      }
   }

   private async Task InvokeAsync(string identifier, params object?[] args)
   {
      if (!_options.IsEnabled)
      {
         return;
      }

      try
      {
         var module = await _module.Value;
         await module.InvokeVoidAsync(identifier, args);
      }
      catch
      {
      }
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;

public sealed class LocationOptions : IAppOptions
{
   public static string SectionName => "Location";

   public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

   public double Latitude { get; set; }

   public double Longitude { get; set; }

   public int UtcOffsetMinutes { get; set; }

   public TimeSpan UtcOffset => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(UtcOffsetMinutes);

   public GeoLocation ToGeoLocation() => new(Name, Latitude, Longitude, UtcOffset);

   public IEnumerable<string> Validate()
   {
      if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Name))
      {
         yield return "Name is required.";
      }

      if (Latitude is < -90 or > 90)
      {

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;

internal static class OptionsGuard
{
   public static bool IsHttpUrl(string? value) =>
      Uri.TryCreate(value, UriKind.Absolute, out Uri? uri)
      && (uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps || uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp);

   public static bool IsRelativePath(string? value) =>
      !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)
      && Uri.TryCreate(value, UriKind.Relative, out _)
      && !value.StartsWith('/');
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;

public static class SettingsServiceCollectionExtensions
{
   public static IServiceCollection AddAppOptions<T>(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
      where T : class, IAppOptions
   {
      services.AddOptions<T>().Bind(configuration.GetSection(T.SectionName));
      services.TryAddEnumerable(ServiceDescriptor.Singleton<IValidateOptions<T>, AppOptionsValidator<T>>());
      return services;
   }
}

namespace CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;

public sealed class TelemetryOptions : IAppOptions
{
   public const string DefaultEnvironment = "Production";

   public static string SectionName => "ApplicationInsights";

   public string? ConnectionString { get; set; }

   public string SdkUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;

   public string CloudRole { get; set; } = string.Empty;

   public int MaxQueueLength { get; set; }

   public string Environment { get; set; } = DefaultEnvironment;

   public bool IsEnabled => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ConnectionString);

   public IEnumerable<string> Validate()
   {
      if (!IsEnabled)
      {
         yield break;
      }

      if (!OptionsGuard.IsHttpUrl(SdkUrl))
      {
         yield return "SdkUrl must be an absolute http(s) URL.";
      }

      if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CloudRole))
      {
         yield return "CloudRole is required.";
      }

      if (MaxQueueLength < 1)
      {
         yield return "MaxQueueLength must be at least 1.";
      }
   }
}
