(function () {
    'use strict';

    function notify(dotNetRef, method, value) {
        if (!dotNetRef) {
            return;
        }
        dotNetRef.invokeMethodAsync(method, value).catch(function () { });
    }

    window.pageMonitor = {
        init: function (dotNetRef) {
            var observers = {};
            var ref = dotNetRef;

            var onVisibility = function () { notify(ref, 'OnVisibilityChanged', !document.hidden); };
            var onOnline = function () { notify(ref, 'OnConnectivityChanged', true); };
            var onOffline = function () { notify(ref, 'OnConnectivityChanged', false); };

            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
            window.addEventListener('online', onOnline);
            window.addEventListener('offline', onOffline);

            return {
                isOnline: function () {
                    return navigator.onLine !== false;
                },

                observe: function (elementId, callbackName) {
                    var target = document.getElementById(elementId);
                    if (!target || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
                        return;
                    }
                    if (observers[elementId]) {
                        observers[elementId].disconnect();
                    }
                    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
                        notify(ref, callbackName, entries[0].isIntersecting);
                    }, { threshold: 0.0 });
                    observer.observe(target);
                    observers[elementId] = observer;
                },

                dispose: function () {
                    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
                    window.removeEventListener('online', onOnline);
                    window.removeEventListener('offline', onOffline);
                    Object.keys(observers).forEach(function (id) {
                        observers[id].disconnect();
                    });
                    observers = {};
                    ref = null;
                }
            };
        }
    };

    window.appInterop = {
        getLocation: function (options) {
            return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                if (!navigator.geolocation) {
                    resolve(null);
                    return;
                }
                navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                    function (pos) {
                        var timeZone = '';
                        try {
                            timeZone = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || '';
                        } catch (e) {
                            timeZone = '';
                        }
                        resolve({
                            latitude: pos.coords.latitude,
                            longitude: pos.coords.longitude,
                            offsetMinutes: -new Date().getTimezoneOffset(),
                            timeZone: timeZone
                        });
                    },
                    function () {
                        resolve(null);
                    },
                    options || undefined
                );
            });
        }
    };

    window.appStorage = {
        get: function (key) {
            try {
                return window.localStorage.getItem(key);
            } catch (e) {
                return null;
            }
        },

        set: function (key, value) {
            try {
                window.localStorage.setItem(key, value);
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                return false;
            }
        },

        remove: function (key) {
            try {
                window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
            } catch (e) {
            }
        }
    };

    function lerpHex(c1, c2, t) {
        var r1 = parseInt(c1.slice(1, 3), 16), g1 = parseInt(c1.slice(3, 5), 16), b1 = parseInt(c1.slice(5, 7), 16);
        var r2 = parseInt(c2.slice(1, 3), 16), g2 = parseInt(c2.slice(3, 5), 16), b2 = parseInt(c2.slice(5, 7), 16);
        var r = Math.round(r1 + (r2 - r1) * t), g = Math.round(g1 + (g2 - g1) * t), b = Math.round(b1 + (b2 - b1) * t);
        return 'rgb(' + r + ',' + g + ',' + b + ')';
    }

    window.sunTracker = {
        _canvases: {},

        init: function (canvasId) {
            if (this._canvases[canvasId]) {
                window.removeEventListener('resize', this._canvases[canvasId].resize);
                delete this._canvases[canvasId];
            }

            var canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
            if (!canvas) return;
            var resize = function () {
                canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
                canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 300;
            };
            resize();
            window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
            this._canvases[canvasId] = { canvas: canvas, resize: resize };
        },

        draw: function (canvasId, altitude, azimuth, dayFraction, isAboveHorizon, fullDayFraction) {
            var entry = this._canvases[canvasId];
            if (!entry) return;
            var canvas = entry.canvas;
            var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            var W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
            var cx = W / 2;
            var horizY = H * 0.55;
            var arcRx = W * 0.44;
            var arcRyDay = horizY - 15;
            var arcRyNight = (H - horizY) * 0.6;

            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

            var skyTop, skyBot;
            if (altitude > 15) { skyTop = '#061228'; skyBot = '#0d2040'; }
            else if (altitude > 0) { var t = altitude / 15; skyTop = lerpHex('#0f2050', '#061228', t); skyBot = lerpHex('#3a1a08', '#0d2040', t); }
            else if (altitude > -6) { var t2 = (altitude + 6) / 6; skyTop = lerpHex('#0a0e18', '#0f2050', t2); skyBot = lerpHex('#1a0e04', '#3a1a08', t2); }
            else { skyTop = '#04080f'; skyBot = '#080c16'; }

            var skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, horizY);
            skyGrad.addColorStop(0, skyTop); skyGrad.addColorStop(1, skyBot);
            ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, horizY);

            var gnd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, horizY, 0, H);
            gnd.addColorStop(0, '#0e180e'); gnd.addColorStop(1, '#060c06');
            ctx.fillStyle = gnd;
            ctx.fillRect(0, horizY, W, H - horizY);

            if (altitude > -8 && altitude < 20) {
                var tg = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(altitude) / 20);
                var glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, horizY, 0, cx, horizY, W * 0.5);
                glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,120,40,' + (0.38 * tg) + ')');
                glow.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255,80,20,' + (0.15 * tg) + ')');
                glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = glow;
                ctx.fillRect(0, horizY - H * 0.3, W, H * 0.4);
            }

            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, horizY); ctx.lineTo(W, horizY);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,165,0,0.22)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(cx, horizY, arcRx, arcRyDay, 0, Math.PI, 0, false);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,165,0,0.10)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.setLineDash([4, 7]);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(cx, horizY, arcRx, arcRyNight, 0, 0, Math.PI, false);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,140,220,0.06)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.setLineDash([3, 9]);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);

            var fdf = (fullDayFraction !== undefined && fullDayFraction !== null) ? fullDayFraction : 0.5;
            var theta = 1.5 * Math.PI - fdf * 2 * Math.PI;
            var sinT = Math.sin(theta);
            var cosT = Math.cos(theta);
            var sunX = cx + arcRx * cosT;
            var sunY;
            if (sinT >= 0) {
                sunY = horizY - arcRyDay * sinT;
            } else {
                sunY = horizY - arcRyNight * sinT;
            }

            if (isAboveHorizon) {
                var corona = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, 2, sunX, sunY, 42);
                corona.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,220,80,0.92)');
                corona.addColorStop(0.2, 'rgba(255,180,40,0.5)');
                corona.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(255,140,20,0.14)');
                corona.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = corona;
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 42, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe060'; ctx.fill();
            } else {
                var nightGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, 1, sunX, sunY, 20);
                nightGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,160,60,0.20)');
                nightGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = nightGlow;
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,160,60,0.35)'; ctx.fill();
            }

            ctx.font = '10px "Courier New", monospace';
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(240,165,0,0.55)';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.fillText('ALT ' + (altitude >= 0 ? '+' : '') + altitude.toFixed(1) + '\u00B0', 12, H - 10);
            ctx.textAlign = 'right';
            ctx.fillText('AZ ' + azimuth.toFixed(1) + '\u00B0', W - 12, H - 10);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.fillText('E', 12, horizY - 5);
            ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.fillText('W', W - 12, horizY - 5);
            ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('S', cx, horizY - 5);
        },

        dispose: function (canvasId) {
            var entry = this._canvases[canvasId];
            if (!entry) return;
            window.removeEventListener('resize', entry.resize);
            delete this._canvases[canvasId];
        }
    };

(function () {
    'use strict';

    if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) {
        return;
    }

    var hadController = !!navigator.serviceWorker.controller;
    var reloading = false;

    function showUpdatePrompt(worker) {
        var banner = document.getElementById('app-update');
        var button = document.getElementById('app-update-reload');
        if (!banner || !button) {
            return;
        }
        button.onclick = function () {
            button.disabled = true;
            worker.postMessage({ type: 'SKIP_WAITING' });
        };
        banner.hidden = false;
    }

    function trackInstalling(registration) {
        var installing = registration.installing;
        if (!installing) {
            return;
        }
        installing.addEventListener('statechange', function () {
            if (installing.state === 'installed' && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
                showUpdatePrompt(installing);
            }
        });
    }

    navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('controllerchange', function () {
        if (!hadController || reloading) {
            return;
        }
        reloading = true;
        window.location.reload();
    });

    window.addEventListener('load', function () {
        navigator.serviceWorker.register('service-worker.js', { updateViaCache: 'none' })
            .then(function (registration) {
                if (registration.waiting && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
                    showUpdatePrompt(registration.waiting);
                }
                registration.addEventListener('updatefound', function () {
                    trackInstalling(registration);
                });
                document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
                    if (!document.hidden && navigator.onLine !== false) {
                        registration.update().catch(function () { });
                    }
                });
            })
            .catch(function (error) {
                console.warn('Service worker registration failed', error);
            });
    });
}());

const State = Object.freeze({ Idle: "idle", Loading: "loading", Ready: "ready", Disabled: "disabled" });

let state = State.Idle;
let sdk = null;
let queue = [];
let maxQueueLength = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

function loadScript(src) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const script = document.createElement("script");
        script.src = src;
        script.async = true;
        script.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
        script.onload = () => resolve();
        script.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Failed to load ${src}`));
        document.head.appendChild(script);
    });
}

function disable(reason) {
    state = State.Disabled;
    queue = [];
    console.warn(`Telemetry disabled: ${reason}`);
}

function execute(action) {
    try {
        action(sdk);
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn("Telemetry call failed", error);
    }
}

function enqueue(action) {
    if (state === State.Ready) {
        execute(action);
    } else if (state !== State.Disabled && queue.length < maxQueueLength) {
        queue.push(action);
    }
}

async function start(config) {
    try {
        await loadScript(config.sdkUrl);
        const ns = window.Microsoft && window.Microsoft.ApplicationInsights;
        if (!ns || typeof ns.ApplicationInsights !== "function") {
            throw new Error("Application Insights SDK namespace not found");
        }
        sdk = new ns.ApplicationInsights({
            config: {
                connectionString: config.connectionString,
                enableAutoRouteTracking: false
            }
        });
        sdk.addTelemetryInitializer(envelope => {
            envelope.tags = envelope.tags || {};
            envelope.tags["ai.cloud.role"] = config.cloudRole;
            envelope.data = envelope.data || {};
            envelope.data.environment = config.environment;
        });
        sdk.loadAppInsights();
        sdk.trackPageView();
        state = State.Ready;
        const pending = queue;
        queue = [];
        pending.forEach(execute);
    } catch (error) {
        disable(error.message);
    }
}

export function init(config) {
    if (state !== State.Idle) {
        return;
    }
    if (!config || !config.connectionString) {
        disable("no connection string configured");
        return;
    }
    if (!config.sdkUrl) {
        disable("no SDK URL configured");
        return;
    }
    if (navigator.onLine === false) {
        disable("browser is offline");
        return;
    }
    maxQueueLength = config.maxQueueLength > 0 ? config.maxQueueLength : 0;
    queue = queue.slice(0, maxQueueLength);
    state = State.Loading;
    start({
        connectionString: config.connectionString,
        environment: config.environment || "Production",
        sdkUrl: config.sdkUrl,
        cloudRole: config.cloudRole || ""
    });
}

export function trackPageView(name, uri) {
    enqueue(s => {
        const pageView = {};
        if (name) pageView.name = name;
        if (uri) pageView.uri = uri;
        s.trackPageView(pageView);
    });
}

export function trackEvent(name, properties) {
    enqueue(s => s.trackEvent({ name: name }, properties || undefined));
}

export function trackException(message, stack, typeName, properties) {
    enqueue(s => {
        const error = new Error(message || "Unknown error");
        if (typeName) error.name = typeName;
        if (stack) error.stack = stack;
        s.trackException({ exception: error, severityLevel: 3 }, properties || undefined);
    });
}

export function trackTrace(message, severityLevel, properties) {
    enqueue(s => s.trackTrace({ message: message, severityLevel: severityLevel }, properties || undefined));
}

export function flush() {
    enqueue(s => s.flush());
}

self.importScripts('./service-worker-assets.js');
self.addEventListener('install', event => event.waitUntil(onInstall(event)));
self.addEventListener('activate', event => event.waitUntil(onActivate(event)));
self.addEventListener('fetch', event => event.respondWith(onFetch(event)));
self.addEventListener('message', event => {
    if (event.data && event.data.type === 'SKIP_WAITING') {
        self.skipWaiting();
    }
});

const cacheNamePrefix = 'offline-cache-';
const cacheName = `${cacheNamePrefix}${self.assetsManifest.version}`;
const offlineAssetsInclude = [/\.dll$/, /\.pdb$/, /\.wasm/, /\.html/, /\.js$/, /\.json$/, /\.css$/, /\.woff2?$/, /\.png$/, /\.jpe?g$/, /\.gif$/, /\.svg$/, /\.ico$/, /\.blat$/, /\.dat$/, /\.webmanifest$/, /\.md$/];
const offlineAssetsExclude = [/^service-worker\.js$/];
const unverifiedAssets = [/\.html$/];

const baseUrl = new URL(self.registration.scope);
const manifestUrlList = self.assetsManifest.assets.map(asset => new URL(asset.url, baseUrl).href);
const indexUrl = new URL('index.html', baseUrl).href;

async function onInstall(event) {
    const assetsRequests = self.assetsManifest.assets
        .filter(asset => offlineAssetsInclude.some(pattern => pattern.test(asset.url)))
        .filter(asset => !offlineAssetsExclude.some(pattern => pattern.test(asset.url)))
        .map(asset => new Request(new URL(asset.url, baseUrl).href, {
            integrity: unverifiedAssets.some(pattern => pattern.test(asset.url)) ? '' : asset.hash,
            cache: 'no-cache'
        }));
    const cache = await caches.open(cacheName);
    await cache.addAll(assetsRequests);
}

async function onActivate(event) {
    const cacheKeys = await caches.keys();
    await Promise.all(cacheKeys
        .filter(key => key.startsWith(cacheNamePrefix) && key !== cacheName)
        .map(key => caches.delete(key)));
    await self.clients.claim();
}

async function onFetch(event) {
    if (event.request.method !== 'GET') {
        return fetch(event.request);
    }

    const shouldServeIndexHtml = event.request.mode === 'navigate'
        && !manifestUrlList.some(url => url === event.request.url);

    const cache = await caches.open(cacheName);
    const cachedResponse = await cache.match(shouldServeIndexHtml ? indexUrl : event.request);
    if (cachedResponse) {
        return cachedResponse;
    }

    return fetch(event.request);
}

namespace CollabsKus.PlaywrightTests;

public class BlogTests
{
   private static readonly bool ShouldManageServer =
       string.IsNullOrEmpty(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("BASE_URL"));

   private static string BaseUrl =>
       Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("BASE_URL") ?? TestServerManager.DefaultBaseUrl;

   // 60s ceiling for the first cold-start navigation (WASM download + bootstrap).
   // Once the shared context's HTTP cache is warm — after the first test in the
   // class — every navigation completes in a second or so. The previous 30s
   // value was sometimes too tight on slower CI runners during the cold start
   // and was the root cause of the persistent BlogTests timeouts.
   private const int TimeoutMs = 60_000;

   private static IPlaywright _playwright = null!;
   private static IBrowser _browser = null!;

   // See HomePageTests for the rationale on shared contexts. Reusing one
   // IBrowserContext across all tests in this class lets Chromium reuse the
   // WASM/ICU download cache so only the first test pays the full cold-start
   // cost; the rest navigate near-instantly.
   private static IBrowserContext _sharedContext = null!;

   private IPage _page = null!;

   public static async Task StartInfrastructure()
   {

         await TestServerManager.AcquireAsync();

      _playwright = await Playwright.CreateAsync();
      _browser = await _playwright.Chromium.LaunchAsync(new BrowserTypeLaunchOptions { Headless = true });

   {

         Timeout = TimeoutMs

      {
         State = WaitForSelectorState.Visible
      });
      // Wait for either the post list or the empty state to appear — the
      // initial render shows "Loading..." until BlogService.GetPostsAsync resolves.
      await _page.WaitForFunctionAsync(
          "() => document.querySelector('.post-list') || document.querySelector('.no-posts')",
          null,
          new PageWaitForFunctionOptions { Timeout = TimeoutMs }
      );
   }

   {
      await _page.GotoAsync($"{BaseUrl}/blog/{slug}", new PageGotoOptions
      {

         Timeout = TimeoutMs
      });
      await _page.Locator(".blog-post, .not-found").WaitForAsync(new LocatorWaitForOptions
      {
         State = WaitForSelectorState.Visible
      });
   }

namespace CollabsKus.PlaywrightTests;

public class HomePageTests
{
   private static readonly bool ShouldManageServer =
       string.IsNullOrEmpty(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("BASE_URL"));

   private static string BaseUrl =>
       Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("BASE_URL") ?? TestServerManager.DefaultBaseUrl;

   // Blazor WASM downloads the .NET runtime then bootstraps before rendering —
   // allow enough time for the first cold-start navigation. After the first
   // test in this class warms the shared browser context's cache, subsequent
   // navigations finish in well under a second.
   private const int AppReadyTimeoutMs = 60_000;

   private static IPlaywright _playwright = null!;
   private static IBrowser _browser = null!;

   // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   // A single IBrowserContext is shared across every test in this class. Each
   // test previously created a fresh context, which gave it an empty HTTP
   // cache and forced Chromium to re-download ~5-15 MB of WASM + ICU data on
   // every single test. That cold-start cost — multiplied across ~14 tests —
   // was the root cause of the timeouts observed on slower machines / CI.
   //
   // Reusing the context preserves the HTTP cache so only the first test
   // pays the cold-start cost; the rest navigate almost instantly. The page
   // (and its DOM, JS state, etc.) is still recreated per test so tests
   // remain isolated.
   //
   // The geolocation test creates its own ephemeral context because it needs
   // different permissions than this shared one.
   // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   private static IBrowserContext _sharedContext = null!;

   private IPage _page = null!;

   // ── Class lifecycle: server + browser + shared context ─────────────────

   [Before(Class)]
   public static async Task StartInfrastructure()
   {
      if (ShouldManageServer)
         await TestServerManager.AcquireAsync();

      _playwright = await Playwright.CreateAsync();
      _browser = await _playwright.Chromium.LaunchAsync(new BrowserTypeLaunchOptions { Headless = true });

      _sharedContext = await _browser.NewContextAsync(new BrowserNewContextOptions
      {
         Permissions = []   // deny geolocation → Kathmandu-only mode
      });
   }

   [After(Class)]
   public static async Task StopInfrastructure()
   {
      await _sharedContext.CloseAsync();
      await _browser.CloseAsync();
      _playwright.Dispose();

      if (ShouldManageServer)
         await TestServerManager.ReleaseAsync();
   }

   // ── Test lifecycle: fresh page per test, shared context ────────────────

   [Before(Test)]
   public async Task SetupPage()
   {
      _page = await _sharedContext.NewPageAsync();
      _page.SetDefaultTimeout(AppReadyTimeoutMs);
   }

   [After(Test)]
   public async Task TeardownPage()
   {
      await _page.CloseAsync();
   }

   // ── Navigation helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

   // WaitUntilState.DOMContentLoaded (not Load or NetworkIdle):
   //   - NetworkIdle never fires reliably: the page makes background calls to
   //     an external calendar service and sends telemetry to Cloudflare Workers.
   //   - Load waits for every sub-resource (CSS, fonts, the full Blazor WASM
   //     payload, every dynamically-imported assembly) which adds noticeable
   //     latency without adding correctness.
   //   - DOMContentLoaded fires as soon as the HTML shell is parsed. After
   //     that, we explicitly wait for .time-display, which means "Blazor is
   //     bootstrapped and the Home component has rendered". That is the real
   //     signal that the app is ready, regardless of how long any external
   //     resource takes.
   //
   // .time-display renders as soon as the Home component initializes — it no
   // longer waits on the external calendar API.
   private async Task NavigateAsync()
   {
      await _page.GotoAsync(BaseUrl, new PageGotoOptions
      {
         WaitUntil = WaitUntilState.DOMContentLoaded,
         Timeout = AppReadyTimeoutMs
      });
      await _page.Locator(".time-display").WaitForAsync(new LocatorWaitForOptions
      {
         State = WaitForSelectorState.Visible
      });
   }

   // ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   [Test]
   public async Task Page_HasCorrectTitle()
   {
      await _page.GotoAsync(BaseUrl, new PageGotoOptions
      {
         WaitUntil = WaitUntilState.DOMContentLoaded,
         Timeout = AppReadyTimeoutMs
      });
      await Assert.That(await _page.TitleAsync()).IsEqualTo("Kathmandu Calendar & Time");
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Header_ShowsKathmanduInNepali()
   {
      await _page.GotoAsync(BaseUrl, new PageGotoOptions
      {
         WaitUntil = WaitUntilState.DOMContentLoaded,
         Timeout = AppReadyTimeoutMs
      });
      // Wait for Blazor to render the <h1> before reading it — it lives inside
      // the Home component, not in the static index.html shell.
      var h1Locator = _page.Locator("h1");
      await h1Locator.WaitForAsync(new LocatorWaitForOptions { State = WaitForSelectorState.Visible });
      string? h1 = await h1Locator.TextContentAsync();
      await Assert.That(h1).IsEqualTo("काठमाडौं");
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task TimeDisplay_IsVisible()
   {
      await NavigateAsync();
      await Assert.That(await _page.Locator(".time-display").IsVisibleAsync()).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task MoonDisplay_ShowsPhaseInfo()
   {
      await NavigateAsync();

      string? moonIcon = await _page.Locator(".moon-icon").TextContentAsync();
      await Assert.That(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(moonIcon)).IsFalse();

      string? phaseName = await _page.Locator(".moon-phase-name").TextContentAsync();
      await Assert.That(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(phaseName)).IsFalse();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task SunDisplay_IsRendered()
   {
      await NavigateAsync();
      await Assert.That(await _page.Locator("#sun-display-root").IsVisibleAsync()).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task SunDisplay_ShowsKathmanduLocation()
   {
      await NavigateAsync();
      string? header = await _page.Locator(".sun-location-header").First.TextContentAsync();
      await Assert.That(header!.Contains("Kathmandu")).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task DateCards_ShowBikramSambat()
   {
      await NavigateAsync();
      int cards = await _page.Locator(".date-card").CountAsync();
      await Assert.That(cards).IsGreaterThanOrEqualTo(2);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task CalendarGrid_RendersSevenDayColumns()
   {
      await NavigateAsync();
      // CalendarGrid renders only after the external calendar API has returned
      // (it gates on CalendarData != null). Auto-wait on the locator handles
      // that latency; in practice the API responds well within our timeout.
      var dayNameLocator = _page.Locator(".calendar-header .day-name");
      await dayNameLocator.First.WaitForAsync(new LocatorWaitForOptions
      {
         State = WaitForSelectorState.Visible
      });
      int dayNames = await dayNameLocator.CountAsync();

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Net.NetworkInformation;

namespace CollabsKus.PlaywrightTests;

/// <summary>
/// Shared dev server lifecycle for Playwright test classes.
/// Uses ref-counting so multiple classes can call Acquire/Release
/// independently; the process starts on first Acquire and stops
/// on the last Release.
/// </summary>
internal static class TestServerManager
{
   internal const string DefaultBaseUrl = "http://localhost:5267";
   private const int Port = 5267;

   private static Process? _process;
   private static int _refCount;
   private static readonly SemaphoreSlim _semaphore = new(1, 1);

   public static async Task AcquireAsync()
   {
      await _semaphore.WaitAsync();
      try
      {
         _refCount++;
         if (_refCount > 1) return;
         await StartAsync();
      }
      finally
      {
         _semaphore.Release();
      }
   }

   public static async Task ReleaseAsync()
   {
      await _semaphore.WaitAsync();
      try
      {
         _refCount--;
         if (_refCount > 0) return;
         await StopAsync();
      }
      finally
      {
         _semaphore.Release();
      }
   }

   private static async Task StartAsync()
   {
      // Kill any stale server left over from a previous aborted test run so it
      // doesn't accept our port-poll and serve a different version of the app.
      KillPortOccupant();

      string baseDir = AppContext.BaseDirectory;
      string projectRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(baseDir, "..", "..", "..", ".."));
      string blazorProject = Path.Combine(
          projectRoot, "CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly", "CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.csproj");

      if (!File.Exists(blazorProject))
         throw new FileNotFoundException(
             $"Blazor project not found at: {blazorProject} (resolved from {baseDir})");

      _process = new Process
      {
         StartInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
         {
            FileName = "dotnet",
            // --no-hot-reload prevents the server from restarting when source
            // files change during a test run, which would cause intermittent failures.
            Arguments = $"run --project \"{blazorProject}\" --urls {DefaultBaseUrl} --no-launch-profile --no-hot-reload",
            UseShellExecute = false,
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true,
            CreateNoWindow = true
         }
      };
      _process.Start();
      _process.BeginOutputReadLine();
      _process.BeginErrorReadLine();

      using var httpClient = new HttpClient { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5) };
      var deadline = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(120);

      while (DateTime.UtcNow < deadline)
      {
         try
         {
            var response = await httpClient.GetAsync(DefaultBaseUrl);
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode) return;
         }
         catch { }

         if (_process.HasExited)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Dev server exited with code {_process.ExitCode} before becoming ready.");

         await Task.Delay(1000);
      }

      throw new TimeoutException($"Dev server did not respond at {DefaultBaseUrl} within 120 s.");
   }

   private static async Task StopAsync()
   {
      if (_process == null || _process.HasExited) return;
      try
      {
         _process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true);
         await _process.WaitForExitAsync();
      }
      catch { }
      finally
      {
         _process.Dispose();
         _process = null;
      }
   }

   /// <summary>
   /// Kills any process currently listening on the server port.
   /// Prevents a stale dotnet run from a previous test run from
   /// masquerading as a healthy server.
   /// </summary>
   private static void KillPortOccupant()
   {
      try
      {
         // Use IPGlobalProperties to find the TCP listener PID on our port.
         // On Linux/macOS this works via /proc; on Windows it uses Win32 APIs.
         var listeners = IPGlobalProperties.GetIPGlobalProperties()
             .GetActiveTcpListeners();

         bool isOccupied = listeners.Any(ep => ep.Port == Port);
         if (!isOccupied) return;

         // Fall back to netstat-style process enumeration via dotnet Process API.
         // We can't get the PID from IPGlobalProperties directly, so look for
         // any dotnet process that owns the port using platform commands.
         KillPortOccupantViaPlatformCommand();
      }
      catch
      {
         // Non-fatal — if we can't kill the occupant the server start will fail
         // with a clear "address in use" error.
      }
   }

   private static void KillPortOccupantViaPlatformCommand()
   {
      string? cmd;
      string args;

      if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
      {
         // netstat -ano on Windows lists PID for each connection
         cmd = "cmd.exe";
         args = $"/c for /f \"tokens=5\" %a in ('netstat -ano ^| findstr :{Port}.*LISTENING') do taskkill /PID %a /F";
      }
      else
      {
         cmd = "/bin/sh";
         args = $"-c \"fuser -k {Port}/tcp 2>/dev/null || true\"";
      }

      using var p = Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
      {
         FileName = cmd,
         Arguments = args,
         UseShellExecute = false,
         CreateNoWindow = true
      });
      p?.WaitForExit(5000);

      // Give the OS a moment to release the port.
      Thread.Sleep(500);
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Models;

public class MoonPhaseTests
{
   private const double SynodicMonth = 29.53058770576;

   [Test]
   public async Task IsWaxing_MatchesFirstHalfOfCycle()
   {
      var baseDate = new DateTime(2025, 6, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      for (int hours = 0; hours < 24 * 30; hours += 7)
      {
         var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(baseDate.AddHours(hours));
         await Assert.That(phase.IsWaxing).IsEqualTo(phase.Age < SynodicMonth / 2);
      }
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task IsWaxing_TrueWhenFullMoonIsNearer()
   {
      var phase = new MoonPhase { DaysUntilFullMoon = 3, DaysUntilNewMoon = 18 };
      await Assert.That(phase.IsWaxing).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task IsWaxing_FalseWhenNewMoonIsNearer()
   {
      var phase = new MoonPhase { DaysUntilFullMoon = 25, DaysUntilNewMoon = 10 };
      await Assert.That(phase.IsWaxing).IsFalse();
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;
using CollabsKus.Tests.Support;

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Services;

public class CalendarProjectionTests
{
   private static readonly DateOnly SourceDate = new(2026, 4, 20);
   private const int TodayIndex = 10;

   [Test]
   public async Task TryProject_SameDate_ReturnsSameInstance()
   {
      var source = CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(TodayIndex).Res;
      var projected = CalendarProjection.TryProject(source, SourceDate, SourceDate);
      await Assert.That(ReferenceEquals(projected, source)).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task TryProject_NextDay_MovesTodayForward()
   {
      var source = CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(TodayIndex).Res;
      var projected = CalendarProjection.TryProject(source, SourceDate, SourceDate.AddDays(1));
      await Assert.That(projected is null).IsFalse();
      await Assert.That(CalendarProjection.FindTodayIndex(projected!)).IsEqualTo(TodayIndex + 1);
      await Assert.That(projected!.Days[TodayIndex].Tag is null).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task TryProject_PreviousDay_MovesTodayBackward()
   {
      var source = CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(TodayIndex).Res;
      var projected = CalendarProjection.TryProject(source, SourceDate, SourceDate.AddDays(-2));
      await Assert.That(CalendarProjection.FindTodayIndex(projected!)).IsEqualTo(TodayIndex - 2);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task TryProject_DoesNotMutateSource()
   {
      var source = CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(TodayIndex).Res;
      CalendarProjection.TryProject(source, SourceDate, SourceDate.AddDays(3));
      await Assert.That(CalendarProjection.FindTodayIndex(source)).IsEqualTo(TodayIndex);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task TryProject_IntoNextMonthDays_ReturnsNull()
   {
      int lastDayIndex = CalendarFixtures.PreviousMonthDays + CalendarFixtures.MonthDays - 1;
      var source = CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(lastDayIndex).Res;
      var projected = CalendarProjection.TryProject(source, SourceDate, SourceDate.AddDays(1));
      await Assert.That(projected is null).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task TryProject_IntoPreviousMonthDays_ReturnsNull()
   {
      var source = CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(CalendarFixtures.PreviousMonthDays).Res;
      var projected = CalendarProjection.TryProject(source, SourceDate, SourceDate.AddDays(-1));
      await Assert.That(projected is null).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task TryProject_BeyondGrid_ReturnsNull()
   {
      var source = CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(TodayIndex).Res;
      var projected = CalendarProjection.TryProject(source, SourceDate, SourceDate.AddDays(400));
      await Assert.That(projected is null).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task TryProject_NoTodayTag_ReturnsNull()
   {
      var source = CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(-1).Res;
      var projected = CalendarProjection.TryProject(source, SourceDate, SourceDate.AddDays(1));
      await Assert.That(projected is null).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task WithoutToday_RemovesTodayAndKeepsMonthTags()
   {
      var source = CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(TodayIndex).Res;
      var stale = CalendarProjection.WithoutToday(source);
      await Assert.That(CalendarProjection.FindTodayIndex(stale)).IsEqualTo(-1);
      await Assert.That(stale.Days[0].Tag).IsEqualTo(CalendarProjection.PreviousMonthTag);
      await Assert.That(stale.Days[^1].Tag).IsEqualTo(CalendarProjection.NextMonthTag);
      await Assert.That(stale.Name).IsEqualTo(source.Name);
   }
}

   {
      var value = TimeSpan.FromHours(7);
      await Assert.That(ClockOffsetCalculator.Normalize(value, Nepal)).IsEqualTo(value);
   }

   private static TimeResponse Response(string hour, string minute, string second, string amPm) => new()
   {
      Hour = hour,
      Min = minute,
      Sec = second,
      ApOrPm = amPm
   };
}

   public async Task SyncClockAsync_Online_AppliesServerOffset()
   {
      var time = new ManualTimeProvider(Start);
      var service = CreateService(OnlineHandler(time), new InMemoryKeyValueStore(), time);

      bool synced = await service.SyncClockAsync();

      await Assert.That(synced).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(service.GetCurrentKathmanduTime()).IsEqualTo(Start.UtcDateTime + TestLocations.NepalOffset + Skew);
      await Assert.That(service.LastClockSync).IsEqualTo(Start);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task SyncClockAsync_FreshStoredOffset_DoesNotCallNetwork()
   {
      var time = new ManualTimeProvider(Start);
      var store = new InMemoryKeyValueStore();
      await CreateService(OnlineHandler(time), store, time).SyncClockAsync();

      time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10));
      var handler = StubHttpMessageHandler.Offline();
      var service = CreateService(handler, store, time);
      bool synced = await service.SyncClockAsync();

      await Assert.That(synced).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(handler.Requests.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
      await Assert.That(service.GetCurrentKathmanduTime()).IsEqualTo(time.UtcNow.UtcDateTime + TestLocations.NepalOffset + Skew);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task SyncClockAsync_ExpiredStoredOffsetAndOffline_FallsBackToConfiguredOffset()
   {
      var time = new ManualTimeProvider(Start);
      var store = new InMemoryKeyValueStore();
      await CreateService(OnlineHandler(time), store, time).SyncClockAsync();

      time.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(61));
      var handler = StubHttpMessageHandler.Offline();
      var service = CreateService(handler, store, time);
      bool synced = await service.SyncClockAsync();

      await Assert.That(synced).IsFalse();
      await Assert.That(handler.Requests.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
      await Assert.That(service.GetCurrentKathmanduTime()).IsEqualTo(time.UtcNow.UtcDateTime + TestLocations.NepalOffset);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task SyncClockAsync_UnparseableResponse_ReturnsFalse()
   {
      var time = new ManualTimeProvider(Start);
      var handler = new StubHttpMessageHandler(_ => Json(new TimeResponse { Hour = "??", Min = "00", Sec = "00", ApOrPm = "AM" }));
      var service = CreateService(handler, new InMemoryKeyValueStore(), time);

      await Assert.That(await service.SyncClockAsync()).IsFalse();
      await Assert.That(service.LastClockSync.HasValue).IsFalse();
   }

   private static KathmanduCalendarService CreateService(
      StubHttpMessageHandler handler,
      InMemoryKeyValueStore store,
      ManualTimeProvider time,
      RecordingApiLogger? logger = null)
   {
      var cache = new LocalCache(store, time, Options.Create(new LocalStorageOptions { KeyPrefix = "test:", SchemaVersion = 1 }));
      return new KathmanduCalendarService(
         new HttpClient(handler),
         logger ?? new RecordingApiLogger(),
         cache,
         time,
         Options.Create(new CalendarApiOptions
         {
            TodayUrl = TodayUrl,
            TimeUrl = TimeUrl,
            RequestTimeoutSeconds = 5,
            ClockOffsetCacheMinutes = 60
         }),
         Options.Create(new LocationOptions
         {
            Name = TestLocations.Kathmandu.Name,
            Latitude = TestLocations.Kathmandu.Latitude,
            Longitude = TestLocations.Kathmandu.Longitude,
            UtcOffsetMinutes = (int)TestLocations.NepalOffset.TotalMinutes
         }));
   }

   private static StubHttpMessageHandler OnlineHandler(ManualTimeProvider time) => new(request =>
   {
      string url = request.RequestUri!.ToString();
      if (url == TodayUrl)
      {
         return Json(CalendarFixtures.CreateResponse(TodayIndex));
      }

      if (url == TimeUrl)
      {
         return Json(ToTimeResponse(time.UtcNow.UtcDateTime + TestLocations.NepalOffset + Skew));
      }

      return new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
   });

   private static HttpResponseMessage Json<T>(T value) => new(HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = JsonContent.Create(value) };

   private static TimeResponse ToTimeResponse(DateTime kathmanduTime)
   {
      int hour12 = kathmanduTime.Hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : kathmanduTime.Hour % 12;
      return new TimeResponse
      {
         Hour = hour12.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
         Min = kathmanduTime.Minute.ToString("D2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
         Sec = kathmanduTime.Second.ToString("D2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
         ApOrPm = kathmanduTime.Hour < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"
      };
   }

   private static DateOnly KathmanduDate(ManualTimeProvider time) =>
      DateOnly.FromDateTime(time.UtcNow.UtcDateTime + TestLocations.NepalOffset);
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;
using CollabsKus.Tests.Support;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Services;

public class LocalCacheTests
{
   private const string Prefix = "test:";
   private static readonly DateTimeOffset Now = new(2026, 4, 14, 6, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

   [Test]
   public async Task SetThenGet_ReturnsValueAndTimestamp()
   {
      var store = new InMemoryKeyValueStore();
      var cache = CreateCache(store, new ManualTimeProvider(Now));

      await cache.SetAsync("answer", 42L);
      var entry = await cache.GetAsync<long>("answer");

      await Assert.That(entry is null).IsFalse();
      await Assert.That(entry!.Value).IsEqualTo(42L);
      await Assert.That(entry.StoredAt).IsEqualTo(Now);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Set_UsesConfiguredKeyPrefix()
   {
      var store = new InMemoryKeyValueStore();
      var cache = CreateCache(store, new ManualTimeProvider(Now));

      await cache.SetAsync("key", "value");

      await Assert.That(store.Items.ContainsKey(Prefix + "key")).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Get_MissingKey_ReturnsNull()
   {
      var cache = CreateCache(new InMemoryKeyValueStore(), new ManualTimeProvider(Now));
      var entry = await cache.GetAsync<string>("missing");
      await Assert.That(entry is null).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Get_DifferentSchemaVersion_ReturnsNullAndRemovesEntry()
   {
      var store = new InMemoryKeyValueStore();
      await CreateCache(store, new ManualTimeProvider(Now), schemaVersion: 1).SetAsync("key", "value");

      var entry = await CreateCache(store, new ManualTimeProvider(Now), schemaVersion: 2).GetAsync<string>("key");

      await Assert.That(entry is null).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(store.Items.ContainsKey(Prefix + "key")).IsFalse();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Get_CorruptJson_ReturnsNullAndRemovesEntry()
   {
      var store = new InMemoryKeyValueStore();
      await store.SetAsync(Prefix + "key", "{ not json");

      var entry = await CreateCache(store, new ManualTimeProvider(Now)).GetAsync<string>("key");

      await Assert.That(entry is null).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(store.Items.ContainsKey(Prefix + "key")).IsFalse();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Remove_DeletesEntry()
   {
      var store = new InMemoryKeyValueStore();
      var cache = CreateCache(store, new ManualTimeProvider(Now));
      await cache.SetAsync("key", "value");

      await cache.RemoveAsync("key");

      await Assert.That(store.Items.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
   }

   private static LocalCache CreateCache(InMemoryKeyValueStore store, TimeProvider time, int schemaVersion = 1) =>
      new(store, time, Options.Create(new LocalStorageOptions { KeyPrefix = Prefix, SchemaVersion = schemaVersion }));
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Services;

public class MoonPhaseServiceTests
{
   private const double SynodicMonth = 29.53058770576;

   [Test]
   public async Task Illumination_IsAlways_Between0And100()
   {
      // Test across a full synodic month in 1-day increments
      var baseDate = new DateTime(2025, 6, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
      {
         var date = baseDate.AddDays(i);
         var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(date);
         await Assert.That(phase.Illumination).IsGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0.0);
         await Assert.That(phase.Illumination).IsLessThanOrEqualTo(100.0);
      }
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task MoonAge_IsAlways_WithinSynodicMonth()
   {
      var baseDate = new DateTime(2025, 3, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++)
      {
         var date = baseDate.AddDays(i);
         var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(date);
         await Assert.That(phase.Age).IsGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0.0);
         await Assert.That(phase.Age).IsLessThan(SynodicMonth);
      }
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task PhaseName_IsAlways_OneOfKnownPhases()
   {
      var validNames = new HashSet<string>
        {
            "New Moon", "Waxing Crescent", "First Quarter", "Waxing Gibbous",
            "Full Moon", "Waning Gibbous", "Last Quarter", "Waning Crescent"
        };

      var baseDate = new DateTime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      for (int i = 0; i < 365; i += 3)
      {
         var date = baseDate.AddDays(i);
         var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(date);
         await Assert.That(validNames.Contains(phase.Name)).IsTrue();
      }
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task TithiNumber_IsAlways_Between1And15()
   {
      var baseDate = new DateTime(2025, 4, 1, 6, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
      {
         var date = baseDate.AddDays(i);
         var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(date);
         await Assert.That(phase.TithiNumber).IsGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1);
         await Assert.That(phase.TithiNumber).IsLessThanOrEqualTo(15);
      }
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Paksha_IsAlways_ShuklaOrKrishna()
   {
      var baseDate = new DateTime(2025, 7, 10, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
      {
         var date = baseDate.AddDays(i);
         var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(date);
         bool validPaksha = phase.Paksha == "Shukla Paksha" || phase.Paksha == "Krishna Paksha";
         await Assert.That(validPaksha).IsTrue();
      }
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Icon_IsNeverEmpty()
   {
      var date = new DateTime(2025, 9, 20, 18, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(date);
      await Assert.That(string.IsNullOrEmpty(phase.Icon)).IsFalse();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task DaysSinceNewMoon_EqualsAge()
   {
      var date = new DateTime(2025, 5, 5, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(date);
      // DaysSinceNewMoon should equal Age (both derived from elongation)
      await Assert.That(Math.Abs(phase.DaysSinceNewMoon - phase.Age)).IsLessThan(0.01);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task DaysUntilNewMoon_PlusDaysSince_EqualsSynodicMonth()
   {
      var date = new DateTime(2025, 8, 12, 8, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(date);
      double total = phase.DaysSinceNewMoon + phase.DaysUntilNewMoon;
      await Assert.That(Math.Abs(total - SynodicMonth)).IsLessThan(0.01);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task NewMoon_HasLowIllumination()
   {
      // A known approximate new moon: 2025-01-29 ~12:36 UTC
      var newMoonApprox = new DateTime(2025, 1, 29, 12, 36, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(newMoonApprox);
      await Assert.That(phase.Illumination).IsLessThan(1.0);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task FullMoon_HasHighIllumination()
   {
      // A known approximate full moon: 2025-02-12 ~13:53 UTC
      var fullMoonApprox = new DateTime(2025, 2, 12, 13, 53, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(fullMoonApprox);
      await Assert.That(phase.Illumination).IsGreaterThan(99.0);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task SameUtcInstant_ProducesSameResult()
   {
      var utc = new DateTime(2025, 6, 15, 14, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var phase1 = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(utc);
      var phase2 = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(utc);
      await Assert.That(phase1.Illumination).IsEqualTo(phase2.Illumination);
      await Assert.That(phase1.Age).IsEqualTo(phase2.Age);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task ShuklaLastTithi_IsPurnima()
   {
      // Find a date near full moon where Shukla Paksha tithi 15 occurs
      var fullMoonApprox = new DateTime(2025, 2, 12, 13, 53, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var phase = MoonPhaseService.CalculateMoonPhase(fullMoonApprox);
      if (phase.Paksha == "Shukla Paksha" && phase.TithiNumber == 15)
      {
         await Assert.That(phase.TithiName).IsEqualTo("Purnima");
      }
      // else: the exact moment might land in Krishna Paksha — that's OK, just skip assertion
   }

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;
using CollabsKus.Tests.Support;

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Services;

public class SolarPositionServiceTests
{
   private static readonly GeoLocation Kathmandu = TestLocations.Kathmandu;

   private readonly SolarPositionService _service = new();

   [Test]
   public async Task Kathmandu_MidDay_HasPositiveAltitude()
   {
      var utc = new DateTime(2025, 6, 21, 6, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var pos = _service.Calculate(utc, Kathmandu);
      await Assert.That(pos.Altitude).IsGreaterThan(50.0);
      await Assert.That(pos.IsAboveHorizon).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Kathmandu_MidNight_HasNegativeAltitude()
   {
      var utc = new DateTime(2025, 6, 21, 18, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var pos = _service.Calculate(utc, Kathmandu);
      await Assert.That(pos.Altitude).IsLessThan(0.0);
      await Assert.That(pos.IsAboveHorizon).IsFalse();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Azimuth_IsAlways_Between0And360()
   {
      var baseDate = new DateTime(2025, 3, 20, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      for (int hour = 0; hour < 24; hour++)
      {
         var utc = baseDate.AddHours(hour);
         var pos = _service.Calculate(utc, Kathmandu);
         await Assert.That(pos.Azimuth).IsGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0.0);
         await Assert.That(pos.Azimuth).IsLessThan(360.0);
      }
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task DayLength_InKathmandu_IsBetween10And14Hours()
   {
      var dates = new[]
      {
            new DateTime(2025, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            new DateTime(2025, 3, 21, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            new DateTime(2025, 6, 21, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            new DateTime(2025, 9, 23, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            new DateTime(2025, 12, 21, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
        };

      foreach (var utc in dates)
      {
         var pos = _service.Calculate(utc, Kathmandu);
         await Assert.That(pos.DayLength.TotalHours).IsGreaterThan(10.0);
         await Assert.That(pos.DayLength.TotalHours).IsLessThan(14.0);
      }
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Sunrise_IsBeforeSunset()
   {
      var utc = new DateTime(2025, 4, 10, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var pos = _service.Calculate(utc, Kathmandu);
      await Assert.That(pos.SunriseLocal.HasValue).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(pos.SunsetLocal.HasValue).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(pos.SunriseLocal!.Value < pos.SunsetLocal!.Value).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task SolarNoon_IsBetweenSunriseAndSunset()
   {
      var utc = new DateTime(2025, 7, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var pos = _service.Calculate(utc, Kathmandu);
      await Assert.That(pos.SunriseLocal.HasValue).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(pos.SunsetLocal.HasValue).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(pos.SolarNoonLocal > pos.SunriseLocal!.Value).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(pos.SolarNoonLocal < pos.SunsetLocal!.Value).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task MaxElevation_IsReasonableForKathmandu()
   {
      var summerUtc = new DateTime(2025, 6, 21, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
      var winterUtc = new DateTime(2025, 12, 21, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Services;

public class TelemetryLoggerProviderTests
{
   [Test]
   [Arguments(LogLevel.Trace)]
   [Arguments(LogLevel.Debug)]
   [Arguments(LogLevel.Information)]
   [Arguments(LogLevel.Warning)]
   [Arguments(LogLevel.None)]
   public async Task IsEnabled_BelowError_ReturnsFalse(LogLevel level)
   {
      var logger = new TelemetryLoggerProvider(new RecordingTelemetryService()).CreateLogger("Test");
      await Assert.That(logger.IsEnabled(level)).IsFalse();
   }

   [Test]
   [Arguments(LogLevel.Error)]
   [Arguments(LogLevel.Critical)]
   public async Task IsEnabled_ErrorOrAbove_ReturnsTrue(LogLevel level)
   {
      var logger = new TelemetryLoggerProvider(new RecordingTelemetryService()).CreateLogger("Test");
      await Assert.That(logger.IsEnabled(level)).IsTrue();
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Log_WarningLevel_SendsNothing()
   {
      var telemetry = new RecordingTelemetryService();
      var logger = new TelemetryLoggerProvider(telemetry).CreateLogger("Test");

      logger.LogWarning("ignored");

      await Assert.That(telemetry.Exceptions.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
      await Assert.That(telemetry.Traces.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Log_ErrorWithException_TracksException()
   {
      var telemetry = new RecordingTelemetryService();
      var logger = new TelemetryLoggerProvider(telemetry).CreateLogger("Some.Category");
      var exception = new InvalidOperationException("boom");

      logger.LogError(exception, "failed");

      await Assert.That(telemetry.Exceptions.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
      await Assert.That(telemetry.Traces.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
      await Assert.That(ReferenceEquals(telemetry.Exceptions[0].Exception, exception)).IsTrue();
      await Assert.That(telemetry.Exceptions[0].Properties!["category"]).IsEqualTo("Some.Category");
      await Assert.That(telemetry.Exceptions[0].Properties!["logLevel"]).IsEqualTo("Error");
      await Assert.That(telemetry.Exceptions[0].Properties!["message"]).IsEqualTo("failed");
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Log_CriticalWithoutException_TracksCriticalTrace()
   {
      var telemetry = new RecordingTelemetryService();
      var logger = new TelemetryLoggerProvider(telemetry).CreateLogger("Test");

      logger.LogCritical("fatal");

      await Assert.That(telemetry.Exceptions.Count).IsEqualTo(0);
      await Assert.That(telemetry.Traces.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
      await Assert.That(telemetry.Traces[0].Message).IsEqualTo("fatal");
      await Assert.That(telemetry.Traces[0].Severity).IsEqualTo(TelemetrySeverity.Critical);
   }

   [Test]
   public async Task Log_ErrorWithoutException_TracksErrorTrace()
   {
      var telemetry = new RecordingTelemetryService();
      var logger = new TelemetryLoggerProvider(telemetry).CreateLogger("Test");

      logger.LogError("bad");

      await Assert.That(telemetry.Traces.Count).IsEqualTo(1);
      await Assert.That(telemetry.Traces[0].Severity).IsEqualTo(TelemetrySeverity.Error);
   }

   private sealed class RecordingTelemetryService : ITelemetryService
   {
      public List<(Exception Exception, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? Properties)> Exceptions { get; } = [];

      public List<(string Message, TelemetrySeverity Severity)> Traces { get; } = [];

      public Task InitializeAsync() => Task.CompletedTask;

      public Task TrackPageViewAsync(string? name, string? uri) => Task.CompletedTask;

      public Task TrackEventAsync(string name, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? properties = null) => Task.CompletedTask;

      public Task TrackExceptionAsync(Exception exception, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? properties = null)
      {
         Exceptions.Add((exception, properties));
         return Task.CompletedTask;
      }

      public Task TrackTraceAsync(string message, TelemetrySeverity severity = TelemetrySeverity.Information, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? properties = null)
      {
         Traces.Add((message, severity));
         return Task.CompletedTask;
      }

      public Task FlushAsync() => Task.CompletedTask;
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Settings;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Settings;

public class AppSettingsTests
{
   private static readonly IConfiguration Configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
      .SetBasePath(AppContext.BaseDirectory)
      .AddJsonFile(Path.Combine("TestData", "appsettings.json"), optional: false)
      .Build();

   [Test]
   public async Task Location_IsValid() => await AssertValid<LocationOptions>();

   [Test]
   public async Task CalendarApi_IsValid() => await AssertValid<CalendarApiOptions>();

   [Test]
   public async Task Refresh_IsValid() => await AssertValid<RefreshOptions>();

   [Test]
   public async Task LocalStorage_IsValid() => await AssertValid<LocalStorageOptions>();

   [Test]
   public async Task Geolocation_IsValid() => await AssertValid<GeolocationOptions>();

   [Test]
   public async Task ApiLogger_IsValid() => await AssertValid<ApiLoggerOptions>();

   [Test]
   public async Task Blog_IsValid() => await AssertValid<BlogOptions>();

   [Test]
   public async Task Telemetry_IsValid() => await AssertValid<TelemetryOptions>();

   [Test]
   public async Task Location_IsKathmandu()
   {
      var location = Bind<LocationOptions>();
      await Assert.That(location.UtcOffset).IsEqualTo(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(345));
      await Assert.That(location.Name).IsEqualTo("Kathmandu, Nepal");
   }

   private static T Bind<T>() where T : class, IAppOptions =>
      Configuration.GetSection(T.SectionName).Get<T>()
      ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Section '{T.SectionName}' is missing from appsettings.json.");

   private static async Task AssertValid<T>() where T : class, IAppOptions
   {
      string errors = string.Join("; ", Bind<T>().Validate());
      await Assert.That(errors).IsEqualTo(string.Empty);
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Models;
using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Support;

internal static class CalendarFixtures
{
   public const int PreviousMonthDays = 3;
   public const int MonthDays = 30;
   public const int NextMonthDays = 2;

   public static CalendarResponse CreateResponse(int todayIndex)
   {
      var days = new List<CalendarDay>();

      for (int i = 0; i < PreviousMonthDays; i++)
      {
         days.Add(new CalendarDay { Bs = $"{29 + i}", Ad = $"{10 + i}", Tag = CalendarProjection.PreviousMonthTag });
      }

      for (int i = 0; i < MonthDays; i++)
      {
         int index = PreviousMonthDays + i;
         days.Add(new CalendarDay { Bs = $"{i + 1}", Ad = $"{13 + i}", Tag = index == todayIndex ? CalendarProjection.TodayTag : null });
      }

      for (int i = 0; i < NextMonthDays; i++)
      {
         days.Add(new CalendarDay { Bs = $"{i + 1}", Ad = $"{i + 1}", Tag = CalendarProjection.NextMonthTag });
      }

      return new CalendarResponse
      {
         Message = "ok",
         Res = new CalendarData
         {
            Name = "Baisakh",
            Year = "2083",
            Eng1 = "Apr",
            Eng2 = "May",
            EngYear = 2026,
            WeeksNeFull = ["आइतबार", "सोमबार", "मंगलबार", "बुधबार", "बिहिबार", "शुक्रबार", "शनिबार"],
            WeeksNeMini = ["आ", "सो", "मं", "बु", "बि", "शु", "श"],
            Days = days
         }
      };
   }
}

using CollabsKus.BlazorWebAssembly.Services;

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Support;

internal sealed class InMemoryKeyValueStore : IKeyValueStore
{
   private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _items = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);

   public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Items => _items;

   public ValueTask<string?> GetAsync(string key) =>
      ValueTask.FromResult(_items.TryGetValue(key, out string? value) ? value : null);

   public ValueTask<bool> SetAsync(string key, string value)
   {
      _items[key] = value;
      return ValueTask.FromResult(true);
   }

   public ValueTask RemoveAsync(string key)
   {
      _items.Remove(key);
      return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
   }
}

namespace CollabsKus.Tests.Support;

internal sealed class StubHttpMessageHandler(Func<HttpRequestMessage, HttpResponseMessage> responder) : HttpMessageHandler
{
   public List<Uri> Requests { get; } = [];

   public static StubHttpMessageHandler Offline() =>
      new(_ => throw new HttpRequestException("Network unavailable"));

   protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   {
      Requests.Add(request.RequestUri!);
      try
      {
         return Task.FromResult(responder(request));
      }
      catch (Exception ex)
      {
         return Task.FromException<HttpResponseMessage>(ex);
      }
   }
}

      multi-targeting build phase. In that phase, .csproj-level properties are not yet
      evaluated, so dotnet test falls back to the VSTest path and the error fires.
      Directory.Build.props is imported before everything else and is visible in all phases.
    -->
    <TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport>true</TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport>
  </PropertyGroup>
</Project>

<Project>
  <!--
    Workaround for a bug in microsoft.testing.platform.msbuild 2.1.0 on .NET 10 SDK.

    The package's _MTPBeforeVSTest target (BeforeTargets="VSTest") throws an error for any
    MTP project on .NET 10+ SDK:

        Condition="'$(IsTestingPlatformApplication)'=='true'
                   AND '$(TargetFramework)'!=''
                   AND '$(_SupportsGlobalJsonTestRunner)'=='true'"

    The condition is missing the TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport check. When that property
    is true, the VSTest target is correctly overridden to call InvokeTestingPlatform, so
    VSTest being called is intentional — not an error. But the error fires anyway.

    Directory.Build.targets is imported after all NuGet package targets, so this
    redefinition wins over the one in the package. We reproduce the original logic exactly
    but add the missing AND clause to the error condition.
  -->
  <Target Name="_MTPBeforeVSTest" BeforeTargets="VSTest">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <_SdkMajorVersion>$(NETCoreSdkVersion.Split('.')[0])</_SdkMajorVersion>
      <_SupportsGlobalJsonTestRunner Condition="'$(NETCoreSdkVersion)' != '' AND '$(_SdkMajorVersion)' >= '10'">true</_SupportsGlobalJsonTestRunner>
    </PropertyGroup>

    <Error
      Text="Testing with VSTest target is no longer supported by Microsoft.Testing.Platform on .NET 10 SDK and later. If you use dotnet test, you should opt-in to the new dotnet test experience. For more information, see https://aka.ms/dotnet-test-mtp-error"
      Condition="'$(IsTestingPlatformApplication)'=='true'
                 AND '$(TargetFramework)'!=''
                 AND '$(_SupportsGlobalJsonTestRunner)'=='true'
                 AND '$(TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport)'!='true'" />

    <CallTarget Condition="'$(VSTestNoBuild)' != 'true' AND '$(TargetFramework)'!=''" Targets="BuildProject" />
  </Target>
</Project>

<script type="module">
/* ====================================================================
   TUnit HTML Report — split-pane renderer
   Self-contained. Reads gzipped+base64 JSON from #report-data
   (kept small for large suites); generates sample data when not present
   (e.g. previewing this template).
   ==================================================================== */



/* ---------- bootstrap ---------- */
async function loadReportData() {
  const el = document.getElementById('report-data');
  const raw = el ? el.textContent.trim() : '';
  if (!raw || raw.startsWith('__REPORT')) return { kind: 'preview' };
  if (raw.charAt(0) === '{') {
    try { return { kind: 'ok', report: JSON.parse(raw) }; }
    catch (e) { return { kind: 'error', message: 'Embedded JSON data is corrupt and could not be parsed.' }; }
  }
  if (typeof DecompressionStream === 'undefined') {
    return { kind: 'error', message: 'This browser does not support DecompressionStream, which is required to read the embedded report data. Please open this report in Chrome 80+, Edge 80+, Firefox 113+, or Safari 16.4+.' };
  }
  try {
    const bin = Uint8Array.from(atob(raw), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
    const ds = new DecompressionStream('gzip');
    const text = await new Response(new Blob([bin]).stream().pipeThrough(ds)).text();
    return { kind: 'ok', report: JSON.parse(text) };
  } catch (e) {
    return { kind: 'error', message: 'Failed to decode the embedded report data: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)) };
  }
}
const loaded = await loadReportData();
if (loaded.kind === 'error') {
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.style.cssText = 'max-width:560px;margin:80px auto;padding:24px 28px;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#1c1917;background:#fafaf9;border:1px solid #d6d3d1;border-radius:12px;';
  const h = document.createElement('h1');
  h.style.cssText = 'margin:0 0 10px;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;';
  h.textContent = 'Report could not be loaded';
  const p = document.createElement('p');
  p.style.cssText = 'margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#57534e;';
  p.textContent = loaded.message;
  card.append(h, p);
  document.body.replaceChildren(card);
  throw new Error(loaded.message);
}
let REPORT = loaded.kind === 'ok' ? loaded.report : null;
if (!REPORT) {
  // generateSampleData() is only present when previewing this template standalone;
  // the C# generator strips it from shipped reports. Fall back to an empty run.
  REPORT = (typeof generateSampleData === 'function')
    ? generateSampleData()
    : { project: '', when: '', startMs: 0, wallMs: 0, workers: 1, tests: [] };
}

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const STATE = {
  search: '',
  statuses: new Set(['pass', 'fail', 'skip', 'cancel']),
  categories: new Set(),
  properties: new Map(),
