  view: 'tests',
  openGroups: new Set(),
};

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const $ = sel => document.querySelector(sel);
const $$ = sel => [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)];
function fmtDur(ms) {
  if (ms == null) return '—';
  if (ms < 1) return '<1ms';
  if (ms < 1000) return Math.round(ms) + 'ms';
  return (ms/1000).toFixed(ms < 10000 ? 2 : 1) + 's';
}
function fmtTime(ms, base) { return new Date(base + ms).toISOString().slice(11, 23); }
function pctOf(n, total) { return total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((n / total) * 100); }
function esc(s) { return String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c])); }
function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }

/* ---------- source links & snippet lazy loading ---------- */
// REPORT.sourceLinks holds pre-built URL templates for the detected provider (GitHub/GitLab/
// Bitbucket/...). Server, repo and commit are already baked in; we only fill {path}/{line}/
// {start}/{end} here, so there is zero provider-specific logic in this report.
function canLinkSource(t)  { return !!(t.source && t.source.relativePath && REPORT.sourceLinks && REPORT.sourceLinks.lineUrl); }
function canShowSnippet(t) { return !!(t.source && t.source.relativePath && REPORT.sourceLinks && REPORT.sourceLinks.rawUrl); }
function fillSourceTemplate(tmpl, t) {
  const end = (t.source.endLine && t.source.endLine > t.source.line) ? t.source.endLine : t.source.line;
  // encodeURI keeps '/' as a path separator but escapes spaces and other unsafe chars.
  return tmpl
    .replace('{path}', encodeURI(t.source.relativePath))
    .replace('{line}', t.source.line)
    .replace('{start}', t.source.line)
    .replace('{end}', end);
}
function sourceJumpUrl(t) {
  const sl = REPORT.sourceLinks;
  const tmpl = (t.source.endLine && t.source.endLine > t.source.line && sl.rangeUrl) ? sl.rangeUrl : sl.lineUrl;
  return fillSourceTemplate(tmpl, t);
}
// ── Baked-in "good enough" C# syntax highlighter ──────────────────────────
// A small hand-rolled tokenizer. Not a full C# parser — it deliberately trades
// edge-case accuracy for zero dependencies and a tiny footprint. Output token
// classes map to theme-aware --syn-* colors so highlighting follows the toggle.
const CS_KEYWORDS = new Set((
  'abstract as async await base bool break byte case catch char checked class const ' +
  'continue decimal default delegate do double else enum event explicit extern false ' +
  'finally fixed float for foreach goto if implicit in int interface internal is lock ' +
  'long namespace new null object operator out override params private protected public ' +
  'readonly ref return sbyte sealed short sizeof stackalloc static string struct switch ' +
  'this throw true try typeof uint ulong unchecked unsafe ushort using virtual void ' +
  'volatile while ' +
  // Contextual keywords — limited to ones that are nearly always keywords, so we
  // don't miscolor common identifiers like `value`, `from`, `select`, `on`, `by`.
  'and dynamic file get global init nameof nint not notnull nuint or ' +
  'partial record required scoped set unmanaged var when where with yield'
).split(' '));

function highlightCSharpLines(code) {
  // Tokenize the whole snippet (so multi-line comments / verbatim strings are
  // handled), then split tokens across newlines into one HTML string per line.
  const lines = [[]];
  const push = (cls, text) => {
    const parts = text.split('\n');
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0) lines.push([]);
      if (parts[i] === '') continue;
      const safe = esc(parts[i]);
      lines[lines.length - 1].push(cls ? `<span class="${cls}">${safe}</span>` : safe);
    }
  };
  const n = code.length;
  let i = 0;
  while (i < n) {
    const c = code[i];
    const c2 = code[i + 1];
    // line comment / xml-doc comment
    if (c === '/' && c2 === '/') {
      let j = i + 2; while (j < n && code[j] !== '\n') j++;
      push('tok-comment', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // block comment
    if (c === '/' && c2 === '*') {
      let j = i + 2; while (j < n && !(code[j] === '*' && code[j + 1] === '/')) j++;
      j = Math.min(n, j + 2);
      push('tok-comment', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // raw string literal: """ ... """ (optionally interpolated: $"""), 3+ quotes
    if (c === '"' && c2 === '"' && code[i + 2] === '"') {
      let q = 0; while (code[i + q] === '"') q++;
      const fence = '"'.repeat(q);
      let j = code.indexOf(fence, i + q);
      j = j === -1 ? n : j + q;
      push('tok-string', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // verbatim / interpolated-verbatim string: @"...", $@"...", @$"..."
    if (c === '@' && c2 === '"') { i = readVerbatim(code, i, 1, push); continue; }
    if ((c === '$' && c2 === '@') || (c === '@' && c2 === '$')) {
      if (code[i + 2] === '"') { i = readVerbatim(code, i, 2, push); continue; }
    }
    // regular or interpolated string: "..." / $"..."
    if (c === '"' || (c === '$' && c2 === '"')) {
      const start = c === '$' ? i + 1 : i;
      let j = start + 1;
      while (j < n && code[j] !== '"' && code[j] !== '\n') {
        if (code[j] === '\\') j++;
        j++;
      }
      j = Math.min(n, j + 1);
      push('tok-string', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // char literal
    if (c === "'") {
      let j = i + 1;
      while (j < n && code[j] !== "'" && code[j] !== '\n') {
        if (code[j] === '\\') j++;
        j++;
      }
      j = Math.min(n, j + 1);
      push('tok-string', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // number
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
      const m = /^(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F_]+|0[bB][01_]+|[0-9][0-9_]*(?:\.[0-9_]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?)[fFdDmMuUlL]*/.exec(code.slice(i));
      const tok = m ? m[0] : c;
      push('tok-number', tok); i += tok.length; continue;
    }
    // identifier / keyword (allow leading @ verbatim identifier)
    if (/[A-Za-z_@]/.test(c)) {
      const m = /^@?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*/.exec(code.slice(i));
      const word = m[0];
      const bare = word[0] === '@' ? word.slice(1) : word;
      let k = i + word.length; while (k < n && /\s/.test(code[k])) k++;
      let cls = '';
      if (CS_KEYWORDS.has(bare)) cls = 'tok-keyword';
      else if (code[k] === '(') cls = 'tok-func';             // call / declaration
      else if (/^[A-Z]/.test(bare)) cls = 'tok-type';         // PascalCase ⇒ type
      push(cls, word); i += word.length; continue;
    }
    // anything else (punctuation, operators, whitespace) → plain
    push('', c); i++;
  }
  return lines.map(parts => parts.join(''));
}
function readVerbatim(code, i, prefix, push) {
  // prefix = number of chars before the opening quote (@ ⇒ 1, $@/@$ ⇒ 2).
  // In verbatim strings a quote is escaped by doubling it ("").
  const n = code.length;
  let j = i + prefix + 1;
  while (j < n) {
    if (code[j] === '"') {
      if (code[j + 1] === '"') { j += 2; continue; }
      j++; break;
    }
    j++;
  }
  push('tok-string', code.slice(i, Math.min(n, j)));
  return Math.min(n, j);
}
const _snippetCache = new Map();
const SNIPPET_FALLBACK_LINES = 40;
function loadSourceSnippet(detail) {
  const container = detail.querySelector('.source-snippet-container');
  if (!container || container.dataset.loaded) return;
  container.dataset.loaded = '1';

  const rawUrl = container.dataset.rawUrl;
  const path = container.dataset.path;
  const startLine = parseInt(container.dataset.line, 10) || 1;
  const endLine = parseInt(container.dataset.endLine, 10) || 0;

  const render = (text) => {
    // Strip a UTF-8 BOM (renders as a stray glyph on line 1) and split on both
    // LF and CRLF so Windows-authored files don't keep a trailing \r per line.
    const lines = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').split(/\r?\n/);
    // from: convert 1-based startLine to 0-based index.
    const from = Math.max(0, startLine - 1);
    // Source-gen mode supplies an end line (full method). Reflection mode does not,
    // so fall back to a fixed window starting at the declaration line.
    // endLine is 1-based; slice()'s upper bound is exclusive, so a 1-based endLine
    // is already the correct exclusive index.
    const to = endLine > startLine
      ? Math.min(lines.length, endLine)
      : Math.min(lines.length, from + SNIPPET_FALLBACK_LINES);
    const snippet = lines.slice(from, to);
    const fileName = path.split('/').pop();
    const rangeLabel = `lines ${startLine}–${from + snippet.length}`;
    // Highlight C# files; fall back to plain (escaped) text for anything else.
    const htmlLines = /\.cs$/i.test(fileName)
      ? highlightCSharpLines(snippet.join('\n'))
      : snippet.map(esc);
    container.innerHTML =
      `<div class="source-snippet-header"><span>${esc(fileName)} (${rangeLabel})</span></div>` +
      `<div class="source-snippet-code">${snippet.map((l, i) =>
        `<div class="line"><span class="line-num">${from + i + 1}</span><span class="line-content">${htmlLines[i] || ''}</span></div>`
      ).join('')}</div>`;
  };

  if (_snippetCache.has(rawUrl)) { render(_snippetCache.get(rawUrl)); return; }

  fetch(rawUrl)
    .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.text(); })
    .then(text => { _snippetCache.set(rawUrl, text); render(text); })
    .catch(() => {
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="source-snippet-placeholder">Source unavailable — could not fetch from repository.</div>';
    });
}

const SERVICE_COLORS = {
  'test':        'oklch(0.62 0.20 270)',
  'http.client': 'oklch(0.62 0.18 235)',
  'http.server': 'oklch(0.68 0.14 200)',
  'npgsql':      'oklch(0.60 0.14 150)',
  'cache':       'oklch(0.65 0.22 340)',
  'rabbitmq':    'oklch(0.68 0.18 50)',
  'hook':        'oklch(0.60 0.02 270)',
};

const tests = REPORT.tests;
const counts = { pass: 0, fail: 0, skip: 0, cancel: 0 };
tests.forEach(t => counts[t.status] = (counts[t.status]||0) + 1);
const total = tests.length;
const failed = tests.filter(t => t.status === 'fail');

// ---------- failure clustering ----------
function clusterKey(err) {
  if (!err) return null;
  const msg = (err.message || '').toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\b/g, '<guid>')
    .replace(/0x[0-9a-f]+/g, '#')
    .replace(/\b\d+(\.\d+)?(ms|s|h)?\b/g, '#')
    .replace(/\/[\w\-./]+\.cs(:line \d+)?/g, '<path>')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return err.type + '::' + msg.slice(0, 240);
}
const failureClusters = (() => {
  const m = new Map();
  failed.forEach(t => {
    const k = clusterKey(t.error);
    if (!m.has(k)) m.set(k, { key: k, error: t.error, tests: [] });
    m.get(k).tests.push(t);
  });
  const byTestId = new Map();
  for (const c of m.values()) for (const t of c.tests) byTestId.set(t.id, c);
  const all = [...m.values()].sort((a, b) => b.tests.length - a.tests.length);
  all.forEach((c, i) => c.idx = i);
  return { all, byTestId };
})();

const allCategories = (() => {
  const m = new Map();
  tests.forEach(t => t.categories.forEach(c => m.set(c, (m.get(c)||0) + 1)));
  return [...m.entries()].sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1]);
})();

// Aggregate OTel span data into time-breakdown insights.
// Span IDs (e.g. "s0", "s1") repeat across tests, so we scope the
// parent->children lookup per test before computing self-times.
const INSIGHTS = (() => {
  const services = new Map();
  const endpoints = new Map();
  const dbOps = new Map();
  let totalSpans = 0;
  let cpuSum = 0;

  tests.forEach(t => {
    const ts = t.spans || [];
    if (!ts.length) return;
    const byParent = new Map();
    ts.forEach(s => {
      if (s.parent) {
        const arr = byParent.get(s.parent) || [];
        arr.push(s);
        byParent.set(s.parent, arr);
      }
    });
    ts.forEach(s => {
      totalSpans++;
      const kids = byParent.get(s.id) || [];
      const childDur = kids.reduce((a, c) => a + c.dur, 0);
      const self = Math.max(0, s.dur - childDur);
      cpuSum += self;

      const v = services.get(s.service) || { service: s.service, count: 0, self: 0 };
      v.count++; v.self += self;
      services.set(s.service, v);

      if (s.service === 'http.server') {
        const method = (s.attrs && s.attrs['http.method']) || (s.name.match(/^([A-Z]+)\s/) || [])[1] || '';
        const route = (s.attrs && s.attrs['http.route']) || s.name.replace(/^[A-Z]+\s+/, '');
        const key = `${method} ${route}`.trim();
        const v2 = endpoints.get(key) || { name: key, count: 0, total: 0, tests: new Set() };
        v2.count++; v2.total += s.dur; v2.tests.add(t.id);
        endpoints.set(key, v2);
      } else if (s.service === 'npgsql') {
        const stmt = (s.attrs && (s.attrs['db.operation'] || s.attrs['db.statement'])) || '';
        const m = stmt.match(/^(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|BEGIN|COMMIT|ROLLBACK|CREATE|DROP|ALTER)\b/i);
        const key = m ? m[1].toUpperCase() : 'OTHER';
        const v3 = dbOps.get(key) || { name: key, count: 0, total: 0, tests: new Set() };
        v3.count++; v3.total += s.dur; v3.tests.add(t.id);
        dbOps.set(key, v3);
      }
    });
  });

  return {
    totalSpans,
    cpuSum,
    services: [...services.values()].sort((a, b) => b.self - a.self),
    endpoints: [...endpoints.values()].sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total),
    dbOps: [...dbOps.values()].sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total),
  };
})();

/* ---------- banner ---------- */
function renderBanner() {
  $('#projectName').textContent = REPORT.project;

  const pill = $('#statusPill');
  const icon = $('#statusIcon');
  if (total === 0) {
    pill.classList.remove('fail');
    icon.innerHTML = '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12"/><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/>';
    $('#statusPrimary').textContent = 'No tests';
    $('#statusMeta').innerHTML = `<span class="v">0</span> in this run`;
  } else if (counts.fail > 0) {
    pill.classList.add('fail');
    icon.innerHTML = '<line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>';
    $('#statusPrimary').textContent = `${counts.fail} failed`;
    $('#statusMeta').innerHTML = `<span class="v">${counts.pass}</span> passed <span class="sep">·</span><span class="v">${fmtDur(REPORT.wallMs)}</span>`;
  } else if (counts.pass === 0 && counts.skip > 0) {
    pill.classList.remove('fail');
    icon.innerHTML = '<line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/>';
    $('#statusPrimary').textContent = `All ${counts.skip} skipped`;
    $('#statusMeta').innerHTML = `<span class="v">${fmtDur(REPORT.wallMs)}</span>`;
  } else {
    pill.classList.remove('fail');
    icon.innerHTML = '<polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/>';
    $('#statusPrimary').textContent = 'All passing';
    $('#statusMeta').innerHTML = `<span class="v">${total}</span> tests <span class="sep">·</span><span class="v">${fmtDur(REPORT.wallMs)}</span>`;
  }

  $('#bannerStrip').innerHTML = tests.map(t => `<div class="tick ${t.status}" data-id="${t.id}"></div>`).join('');
  $('#bannerStrip').querySelectorAll('.tick').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', () => { selectTest(el.dataset.id); switchView('tests'); });
  });
}

/* ---------- filters ---------- */
function renderCategoryDropdown() {
  const root = $('#catDropdown');
  if (!root) return;
  const triggerCount = $('#catActiveCount');
  const activeN = STATE.categories.size;
  if (activeN > 0) {
    triggerCount.hidden = false;
    triggerCount.textContent = activeN;
    root.classList.add('has-selection');
  } else {
    triggerCount.hidden = true;
    root.classList.remove('has-selection');
  }
  const list = $('#catDropdownList');
  if (allCategories.length === 0) {
    list.innerHTML = `<div class="dropdown-empty">No categories</div>`;
  } else {
    list.innerHTML = allCategories.map(([name, count]) => {
      const checked = STATE.categories.has(name);
      return `<label class="dropdown-item ${checked?'active':''}">
        <input type="checkbox" data-cat="${esc(name)}" ${checked?'checked':''}>
        <span class="lbl">${esc(name)}</span>
        <span class="cnt">${count}</span>
      </label>`;
    }).join('');
    list.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(inp => inp.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const cat = inp.dataset.cat;
      if (inp.checked) STATE.categories.add(cat); else STATE.categories.delete(cat);
      renderRail();
    }));
  }
  const hint = $('#catSelectedHint');
  hint.textContent = activeN === 0 ? 'None selected' : `${activeN} selected`;
  const clearBtn = $('#catClear');
  clearBtn.disabled = activeN === 0;
}

function renderStatusPills() {
  const order = [
    ['all', 'All', total, ''],
    ['pass', 'Passed', counts.pass, 'pass'],
    ['fail', 'Failed', counts.fail, 'fail'],
    ['skip', 'Skipped', counts.skip, 'skip'],
    ['cancel', 'Cancelled', counts.cancel, 'cancel'],
  ].filter(([k,_,n]) => k === 'all' || n > 0);
  const allOn = STATE.statuses.size === 4;
  $('#statusPills').innerHTML = order.map(([key, label, n, cls]) => {
    const active = key === 'all' ? allOn : STATE.statuses.has(key);
    return `<button class="pill ${cls} ${active?'active':''}" data-status="${key}">
      ${cls ? `<span class="dot" style="background:var(--${cls})"></span>` : ''}
      ${label}<span class="n">${n}</span>
    </button>`;
  }).join('');
  $('#statusPills').querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const k = el.dataset.status;
      if (k === 'all') STATE.statuses = new Set(['pass','fail','skip','cancel']);
      else if (STATE.statuses.size === 4) STATE.statuses = new Set([k]);
      else if (STATE.statuses.has(k)) {
        STATE.statuses.delete(k);
        if (STATE.statuses.size === 0) STATE.statuses = new Set(['pass','fail','skip','cancel']);
      } else STATE.statuses.add(k);
      renderRail();
    });
  });
}

function renderActiveChips() {
  const chips = [];
  if (STATE.search) chips.push({ k: 'search', v: STATE.search, clear: () => { STATE.search = ''; $('#searchInput').value = ''; } });
  STATE.categories.forEach(c => chips.push({ k: 'cat', v: c, clear: () => STATE.categories.delete(c) }));
  STATE.properties.forEach((vals, k) => vals.forEach(v => chips.push({ k: 'prop', v: `${k}=${v}`, clear: () => {
    const s = STATE.properties.get(k); s.delete(v); if (s.size === 0) STATE.properties.delete(k);
  } })));
  const row = $('#activeChipsRow');
  if (chips.length === 0) { row.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  row.style.display = '';
  $('#activeChips').innerHTML = chips.map((c, i) => `
    <span class="chip-removable"><span class="k">${c.k}</span>${esc(c.v)}
      <button data-idx="${i}"><svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="18" x2="18" y2="6"/></svg></button>
    </span>`).join('');
  $('#activeChips').querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b, i) => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { chips[i].clear(); renderRail(); });
  });
}

function renderFailuresOnlyToggle() {
  const host = $('#ffToggleHost');
  if (counts.fail === 0) { host.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  host.innerHTML = `<label class="ff-toggle"><input type="checkbox" ${STATE.failuresOnly?'checked':''}><span class="l">Failures only</span></label>`;
  host.querySelector('input').addEventListener('change', e => {
    STATE.failuresOnly = e.target.checked;
    if (STATE.failuresOnly) STATE.statuses = new Set(['fail']); else STATE.statuses = new Set(['pass','fail','skip','cancel']);
    renderStatusPills(); renderRail();
  });
}

/* ---------- filtering / grouping ---------- */
function filteredTests() {
  const q = STATE.search.trim().toLowerCase();
  return tests.filter(t => {
    if (!STATE.statuses.has(t.status)) return false;
    if (q) {
      const hay = (t.name + ' ' + t.cls + ' ' + t.ns + ' ' + JSON.stringify(t.properties) + ' ' + t.categories.join(' ')).toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
    }
    if (STATE.categories.size > 0) {
      let ok = false;
      for (const c of STATE.categories) if (t.categories.includes(c)) { ok = true; break; }
      if (!ok) return false;
    }
    if (STATE.properties.size > 0) {
      for (const [k, vals] of STATE.properties.entries()) {
        if (!(k in t.properties)) return false;
        if (!vals.has(t.properties[k])) return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  });
}

function groupTests(list) {
  if (STATE.group === 'none') {
    sortTests(list);
    return [{ key: '_all', title: 'All tests', ns: '', tests: list }];
  }
  const buckets = new Map();
  list.forEach(t => {
    if (STATE.group === 'category') {
      const cats = t.categories.length ? t.categories : ['(uncategorised)'];
      cats.forEach(c => {
        if (!buckets.has(c)) buckets.set(c, { key: c, title: c, ns: '', tests: [] });
        buckets.get(c).tests.push(t);
      });
      return;
    }
    let key, title, ns = '';
    if (STATE.group === 'class') { key = t.cls; title = t.cls; ns = t.ns; }
    else if (STATE.group === 'namespace') { key = t.ns; title = t.ns; }
    else if (STATE.group === 'status') {
      const map = { pass: 'Passed', fail: 'Failed', skip: 'Skipped', cancel: 'Cancelled' };
      key = t.status; title = map[t.status];
    }
    if (!buckets.has(key)) buckets.set(key, { key, title, ns, tests: [] });
    buckets.get(key).tests.push(t);
  });
  const groups = [...buckets.values()];
  groups.forEach(g => sortTests(g.tests));
  groups.sort((a, b) => {
    const af = a.tests.filter(t => t.status === 'fail').length;
    const bf = b.tests.filter(t => t.status === 'fail').length;
    if (af !== bf) return bf - af;
    return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
  });
  return groups;
}

function sortTests(list) {
  if (STATE.sort === 'duration') list.sort((a, b) => b.duration - a.duration);
  else if (STATE.sort === 'name') list.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  else if (STATE.sort === 'start') list.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
  else {
    // default: failures first, then by start time
    list.sort((a, b) => {
      const rank = s => s === 'fail' ? 0 : s === 'skip' ? 1 : 2;
      const d = rank(a.status) - rank(b.status);
      return d !== 0 ? d : a.start - b.start;
    });
  }
}

/* ---------- rail (virtualized) ---------- */
const RAIL = {
  groups: [],
  layout: [],
  total: 0,
  lastRangeKey: null,
  scrollHooked: false,
  clickHooked: false,
};

function rowH() {
  const coarse = window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches;
  return { group: coarse ? 44 : 40, item: coarse ? 36 : 28 };
}

function buildLayout(groups) {
  const H = rowH();
  const layout = [];
  let top = 0;
  groups.forEach(g => {
    layout.push({ kind: 'group', g, top, h: H.group });
    top += H.group;
    if (STATE.openGroups.has(g.key)) {
      g.tests.forEach(t => {
        layout.push({ kind: 'test', t, top, h: H.item });
        top += H.item;
      });
    }
  });
  RAIL.layout = layout;
  RAIL.total = top;
  RAIL.lastRangeKey = null;
}

function groupHeadHTML(g) {
  const open = STATE.openGroups.has(g.key);
  const p = g.tests.filter(t => t.status === 'pass').length;
  const f = g.tests.filter(t => t.status === 'fail').length;
  const s = g.tests.filter(t => t.status === 'skip').length;
  return `
    <div class="group" data-open="${open}" data-key="${esc(g.key)}">
      <div class="group-head">
        <svg class="chev" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/></svg>
        <div class="group-title">${esc(g.title)}${g.ns ? `<span class="ns">${esc(g.ns)}</span>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="group-ratio">
          ${p ? `<i class="pass" style="flex:${p}"></i>` : ''}
          ${f ? `<i class="fail" style="flex:${f}"></i>` : ''}
          ${s ? `<i class="skip" style="flex:${s}"></i>` : ''}
        </div>
        <div class="group-count">${g.tests.length}${f?`<span class="fail"> · ${f}</span>`:''}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderRailWindow() {
  const list = $('#railList');
  if (!list) return;
  let vlist = list.querySelector('.vlist');
  if (!vlist) {
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="vlist"></div>';
    vlist = list.firstElementChild;
  }
  vlist.style.height = RAIL.total + 'px';

  if (RAIL.layout.length === 0) {
    vlist.innerHTML = '';
    const hasFilters = STATE.search || STATE.categories.size > 0 || STATE.properties.size > 0 || STATE.statuses.size !== 4;
    list.innerHTML = hasFilters ? `
      <div class="empty-state">
        <div class="icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg></div>
        <div class="title">No matching tests</div>
        <div class="desc">Try clearing or relaxing your filters.</div>
        <button class="action" id="clearFiltersAction" type="button">Clear filters</button>
      </div>` : `
      <div class="empty-state">
        <div class="icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M14 3v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4"/><path d="M17 21H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h7l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/></svg></div>
        <div class="title">No tests in this run</div>
      </div>`;
    const clearBtn = list.querySelector('#clearFiltersAction');
    if (clearBtn) clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      STATE.search = ''; const si = $('#searchInput'); if (si) si.value = '';
      STATE.statuses = new Set(['pass','fail','skip','cancel']);
      STATE.categories.clear(); STATE.properties.clear();
      renderRail();
    });
    return;
  }

  const scrollTop = list.scrollTop;
  const viewH = list.clientHeight;
  const buffer = 240;
  const top = scrollTop - buffer;
  const bot = scrollTop + viewH + buffer;

  // linear scan to find visible range (fast enough up to ~50k items)
  let start = 0;
  while (start < RAIL.layout.length && RAIL.layout[start].top + RAIL.layout[start].h < top) start++;
  let end = start;
  while (end < RAIL.layout.length && RAIL.layout[end].top < bot) end++;

  const rangeKey = `${start},${end},${STATE.selectedId}`;
  if (RAIL.lastRangeKey === rangeKey) return;
  RAIL.lastRangeKey = rangeKey;

  const html = [];
  for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
    const e = RAIL.layout[i];
    const inner = e.kind === 'group' ? groupHeadHTML(e.g) : testItemHTML(e.t);
    html.push(`<div class="virtual-row" style="top:${e.top}px;height:${e.h}px;">${inner}</div>`);
  }
  vlist.innerHTML = html.join('');
}

function renderRail() {
  renderStatusPills();
  renderCategoryDropdown();
  renderActiveChips();
  const list = filteredTests();
  $('#railCount').textContent = list.length;
  const groups = groupTests(list);

  // Auto-open the group containing the selected test, plus single-group case
  groups.forEach(g => {
    if (STATE.selectedId && g.tests.some(t => t.id === STATE.selectedId) && !STATE.openGroups.has(g.key)) {
      STATE.openGroups.add(g.key);
    }
    if (groups.length === 1 && !STATE.openGroups.has(g.key)) STATE.openGroups.add(g.key);
  });

  RAIL.groups = groups;
  buildLayout(groups);

  // make sure the inner container exists with current total height
  const rl = $('#railList');
  let vlist = rl.querySelector('.vlist');
  if (!vlist) {
    rl.innerHTML = '<div class="vlist"></div>';
  }

  renderRailWindow();

  // hook scroll handler once (rAF-throttled)
  if (!RAIL.scrollHooked) {
    let pending = false;
    rl.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (pending) return;
      pending = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { pending = false; renderRailWindow(); });
    }, { passive: true });
    RAIL.scrollHooked = true;
  }

  // hook click delegation once
  if (!RAIL.clickHooked) {
    rl.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const head = e.target.closest('.group-head');
      if (head) {
        const grp = head.parentElement;
        const key = grp.dataset.key;
        if (STATE.openGroups.has(key)) STATE.openGroups.delete(key);
        else STATE.openGroups.add(key);
        buildLayout(RAIL.groups);
        renderRailWindow();
        return;
      }
      const ti = e.target.closest('.test-item');
      if (ti) selectTest(ti.dataset.id);
    });
    RAIL.clickHooked = true;
  }
}

function testItemHTML(t) {
  const sel = STATE.selectedId === t.id ? 'selected' : '';
  const fc = t.status === 'fail' ? 'fail' : '';
  const displayName = t.name.length > 72 ? t.name.slice(0, 72) + '…' : t.name;
  const retries = t.attempts && t.attempts.length > 1 ? t.attempts.length : 0;
  const retryAllFailed = retries > 0 && t.attempts.every(a => a.status === 'fail');
  const retryBadge = retries > 0
    ? `<span class="retry-badge ${retryAllFailed?'fail':''}" title="${retries} attempts${retryAllFailed?'':' — passed on attempt '+retries}">↻${retries}</span>`
    : '';
  return `
    <div class="test-item ${sel} ${fc}" data-id="${t.id}">
      <span class="test-status-dot ${t.status}"></span>
      <span class="test-icon"></span>
      <span class="test-name" title="${esc(t.name)}">${retryBadge}${esc(displayName)}</span>
      <span class="test-dur">${fmtDur(t.duration)}</span>
    </div>
  `;
}

/* ---------- selection / detail ---------- */
function selectTest(id, opts = {}) {
  STATE.selectedId = id;

  // ensure the containing group is open in the layout
  if (RAIL.groups && RAIL.groups.length) {
    let needsRebuild = false;
    for (const g of RAIL.groups) {
      if (g.tests.some(t => t.id === id)) {
        if (!STATE.openGroups.has(g.key)) {
          STATE.openGroups.add(g.key);
          needsRebuild = true;
        }
        break;
      }
    }
    if (needsRebuild) buildLayout(RAIL.groups);
  }

  // scroll the row into view (works even when not yet rendered)
  const list = $('#railList');
  const entry = RAIL.layout && RAIL.layout.find(e => e.kind === 'test' && e.t.id === id);
  if (entry && list) {
    const top = entry.top, bot = top + entry.h;
    if (top < list.scrollTop) list.scrollTop = top - 60;
    else if (bot > list.scrollTop + list.clientHeight) list.scrollTop = bot - list.clientHeight + 60;
  }

  renderRailWindow();
  renderDetail();
  location.hash = '#test=' + id;
  if (!opts.silent && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 899px)').matches) {
    document.body.dataset.pane = 'detail';
  }
}

function renderDetail() {
  const detail = $('#detail');
  const t = tests.find(x => x.id === STATE.selectedId);
  if (!t) return;
  // try to split params for prettier title
  const m = t.name.match(/^([^(]+)\((.*)\)$/);
  const namePart = m ? m[1] : t.name;
  const argsPart = m ? `(${m[2]})` : '';
  const errBlock = t.error ? errorBlockHTML(t.error) : '';
  const cluster = failureClusters.byTestId.get(t.id);
  const siblings = cluster && cluster.tests.length > 1 ? cluster.tests.filter(x => x.id !== t.id) : [];
  const sameFailBanner = siblings.length ? `
    <div class="same-failure-banner">
      <span class="ico"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 9v4"/><path d="M12 17h.01"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/></svg></span>
      <span class="txt">Same root cause as <b>${siblings.length}</b> other test${siblings.length===1?'':'s'} —</span>
      <div class="siblings">${siblings.slice(0, 6).map(s => `<span class="sib" data-id="${s.id}" title="${esc(s.cls + ' → ' + s.name)}">${esc(s.name.length > 32 ? s.name.slice(0,32) + '…' : s.name)}</span>`).join('')}${siblings.length > 6 ? `<span class="sib" style="cursor:default">+${siblings.length - 6}</span>` : ''}</div>
    </div>` : '';
  const stderrLines = t.stderr ? t.stderr.split('\n').filter(Boolean).length : 0;

  detail.innerHTML = `
    <div class="detail-header">
      <button class="detail-back" aria-label="Back to list"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"/></svg><span>Tests</span></button>
      <div class="detail-breadcrumb">${esc(t.ns)}<span class="sep">›</span>${esc(t.cls)}</div>
      <h1 class="detail-title">${esc(namePart)}${argsPart ? `<span class="args">${esc(argsPart)}</span>` : ''}</h1>
      <div class="detail-meta">
        <span class="status-badge ${t.status}"><span class="dot"></span>${t.status==='cancel'?'Cancelled':t.status==='pass'?'Passed':t.status==='fail'?'Failed':'Skipped'}</span>
        <span class="detail-sub"><span class="v">${fmtDur(t.duration)}</span><span class="sep">·</span>started <span class="v">${fmtTime(t.start, REPORT.startMs)}</span><span class="sep">·</span><span class="v">${esc(t.worker)}</span></span>
        ${t.traceId ? `<button class="trace-id-chip" data-copy-text="${esc(t.traceId)}" title="Copy trace ID"><span class="lbl">trace</span><span class="v">${esc(t.traceId.slice(0, 12))}</span></button>` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-body">
      ${sameFailBanner}
      ${attemptsHTML(t.attempts)}
      ${errBlock}
      <div class="tabs">
        <button class="tab active" data-tab="output">Output${stderrLines?` <span class="badge fail">${stderrLines} err</span>`:''}</button>
        <button class="tab" data-tab="trace">Trace</button>
        <button class="tab" data-tab="props">Properties</button>
        <button class="tab" data-tab="source">Source</button>
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel active" data-panel="output">
        ${(() => {
          const lines = (t.stdout || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean).length;
          if (lines === 0 && !t.stderr) {
            return `
              <div class="empty-state">
                <div class="icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="4 17 10 11 4 5"/><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="20" y2="19"/></svg></div>
                <div class="title">No output</div>
                <div class="desc">This test produced no stdout or stderr.</div>
              </div>`;
          }
          return `
            ${t.stderr ? `
              <div class="console-head"><span class="lbl">Standard error</span><button class="copy-btn" data-copy="stderr">Copy</button></div>
              <div class="console stderr">${esc(t.stderr)}</div>
            ` : ''}
            ${lines > 0 ? `
              <div class="console-head"><span class="lbl">Standard output</span><span class="console-meta">${lines} line${lines===1?'':'s'}</span><button class="copy-btn" data-copy="stdout">Copy</button></div>
              <div class="console">${renderLog(t.stdout)}</div>
            ` : ''}
          `;
        })()}
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" data-panel="trace">${traceHTML(t)}</div>

      <div class="tab-panel" data-panel="props">
        <div class="prop-cols">
          <div>
            <div class="prop-title">Categories</div>
            ${t.categories.length ? `<div class="chip-set">${t.categories.map(c => `<span class="chip cat" data-cat="${esc(c)}">${esc(c)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : `<div style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:12px;">No categories</div>`}
          </div>
          <div>
            <div class="prop-title">Properties</div>
            ${Object.keys(t.properties).length ? `<div class="chip-set">${Object.entries(t.properties).map(([k,v]) => `<span class="chip" data-prop-k="${esc(k)}" data-prop-v="${esc(v)}"><span class="k">${esc(k)}=</span>${esc(v)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : `<div style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:12px;">No properties</div>`}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tab-panel" data-panel="source">
        <div class="source-card">
          <div class="source-path">${esc(t.source.path)}<span class="ln">:${t.source.line}</span></div>
          <div class="source-actions">
            ${canLinkSource(t)
              ? `<a class="source-link-btn" href="${esc(sourceJumpUrl(t))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Jump to source ↗</a>`
              : ''}
            <button class="copy-btn" data-copy="path">Copy path</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        ${canShowSnippet(t)
          ? `<div class="source-snippet-container" data-raw-url="${esc(fillSourceTemplate(REPORT.sourceLinks.rawUrl, t))}" data-path="${esc(t.source.relativePath)}" data-line="${t.source.line}" data-end-line="${t.source.endLine || ''}"><div class="source-snippet-placeholder">Loading source…</div></div>`
          : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  // sibling-failure chips
  detail.querySelectorAll('.same-failure-banner .sib[data-id]').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', () => selectTest(el.dataset.id));
  });

  // mobile back button
  const back = detail.querySelector('.detail-back');
  if (back) back.addEventListener('click', () => { document.body.dataset.pane = 'rail'; });

  // tab switching
  detail.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    detail.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('active', x === b));
    const tn = b.dataset.tab;
    detail.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', p.dataset.panel === tn));
    if (tn === 'source') loadSourceSnippet(detail);
  }));

  // copy
  detail.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    let text = '';
    if (b.dataset.copy === 'stdout') text = t.stdout;
    else if (b.dataset.copy === 'stderr') text = t.stderr;
    else if (b.dataset.copy === 'path') text = t.source.path + ':' + t.source.line;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
      const old = b.textContent; b.textContent = 'Copied';
      setTimeout(() => b.textContent = old, 1100);
    });
  }));

  // trace-id chip: copy full trace ID
  const tidChip = detail.querySelector('.trace-id-chip');
  if (tidChip) {
    tidChip.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(tidChip.dataset.copyText).then(() => {
        const orig = tidChip.querySelector('.v').textContent;
        tidChip.querySelector('.v').textContent = 'copied';
        setTimeout(() => { tidChip.querySelector('.v').textContent = orig; }, 1100);
      });
    });
  }

  // chips: click to filter
  detail.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(ch => ch.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (ch.classList.contains('cat')) {
      const c = ch.dataset.cat;
      STATE.categories.has(c) ? STATE.categories.delete(c) : STATE.categories.add(c);
    } else {
      const k = ch.dataset.propK, v = ch.dataset.propV;
      if (!STATE.properties.has(k)) STATE.properties.set(k, new Set());
      const set = STATE.properties.get(k); set.has(v) ? set.delete(v) : set.add(v);
      if (set.size === 0) STATE.properties.delete(k);
    }
    renderRail();
  }));

  // span hover
  detail.querySelectorAll('.span-bar').forEach(el => {
    const span = t.spans.find(s => s.id === el.dataset.id);
    el.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
      const attrLines = Object.entries(span.attrs || {}).map(([k,v]) => `<div class="row"><span>${esc(k)}</span><b>${esc(String(v))}</b></div>`).join('');
      const events = span.events || [];
      const eventsBlock = events.length ? `
        <div class="evt-head">Events <span class="evt-count">${events.length}</span></div>
        ${events.map(ev => `
          <div class="row evt-row"><span>${esc(ev.name)}</span><b>+${fmtDur(Math.max(0, ev.time - span.start))}</b></div>
          ${ev.attrs ? Object.entries(ev.attrs).map(([k,v]) => `<div class="row evt-attr"><span>${esc(k)}</span><b>${esc(String(v))}</b></div>`).join('') : ''}
        `).join('')}` : '';
      showTooltip(e, `
        <div class="title">${esc(span.name)}</div>
        <div class="row"><span>service</span><b style="color:${SERVICE_COLORS[span.service]||'var(--text)'}">${span.service}</b></div>
        <div class="row"><span>duration</span><b>${fmtDur(span.dur)}</b></div>
        <div class="row"><span>start</span><b>+${fmtDur(span.start)}</b></div>
        ${attrLines}
        ${eventsBlock}
      `);
    });
    el.addEventListener('mousemove', moveTooltip);
    el.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);
  });
}

function clusterCardHTML(c) {
  const open = c.tests.length > 1 || failureClusters.all.length <= 2;
  const sample = c.tests[0];
  const classes = [...new Set(c.tests.map(t => t.cls))];
  return `
    <div class="cluster" data-open="${open}" data-key="${esc(c.key)}">
      <div class="cluster-head">
        <svg class="chev" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/></svg>
        <span class="cluster-count">${c.tests.length}<span class="l">×</span></span>
        <div class="cluster-info">
          <div class="cluster-type">${esc(sample.error.type)}</div>
          <div class="cluster-msg">${esc((sample.error.message || '').split('\n')[0])}</div>
        </div>
        <span class="cluster-tag">${classes.slice(0,2).map(cl => `<span class="badge">${esc(cl)}</span>`).join(' ')}${classes.length > 2 ? `<span class="badge">+${classes.length-2}</span>` : ''}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cluster-body">
        ${c.tests.map(t => `
          <div class="cluster-test" data-id="${t.id}">
            <span class="d"></span>
            <span class="nm" title="${esc(t.name)}">${esc(t.name)}</span>
            <span class="cl">${esc(t.cls)}</span>
            <span class="du">${fmtDur(t.duration)}</span>
          </div>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function attemptsHTML(attempts) {
  if (!attempts || attempts.length < 2) return '';
  const failed = attempts.filter(a => a.status === 'fail').length;
  const passed = attempts.filter(a => a.status === 'pass').length;
  const allFailed = passed === 0;
  const totalDur = attempts.reduce((s, a) => s + a.duration, 0);
  const summary = allFailed
    ? `Failed all <b>${attempts.length}</b> attempts · <b>${fmtDur(totalDur)}</b> total`
    : `Failed <b>${failed}×</b> then passed on attempt <b>${attempts.length}</b> · <b>${fmtDur(totalDur)}</b> total`;
  const pills = [];
  attempts.forEach((a, i) => {
    if (i > 0) pills.push(`<span class="attempt-arrow">→</span>`);
    const isFinal = i === attempts.length - 1;
    const ico = a.status === 'pass'
      ? `<svg class="ico" width="9" height="9" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>`
      : `<svg class="ico" width="9" height="9" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg>`;
    const tipParts = [`Attempt ${i+1}: ${a.status}`];
    if (a.error) {
      const head = [a.error.type, a.error.message].filter(Boolean).join(': ');
      if (head) tipParts.push(head);
      if (a.error.stack) tipParts.push(a.error.stack);
    }
    pills.push(`<span class="attempt ${a.status}" title="${esc(tipParts.join('\n\n'))}"><span class="num">${i+1}</span>${ico}<span class="dur">${fmtDur(a.duration)}</span>${isFinal && attempts.length > 1 ? `<span class="final">FINAL</span>` : ''}</span>`);
  });
  return `
    <div class="attempts ${allFailed?'all-failed':''}">
      <div class="attempts-head">
        <span class="attempts-label">${attempts.length} attempts · ${allFailed ? 'all failed' : 'flaky, passed eventually'}</span>
        <span class="attempts-summary">${summary}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="attempts-list">${pills.join('')}</div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function errorBlockHTML(error) {
  const hasDiff = error.expected != null && error.actual != null;
  const inners = [];
  let cur = error.innerException;
  while (cur) { inners.push(cur); cur = cur.innerException; }
  const innerHTML = inners.map((e, i) => `
    <details class="collapsible inner-ex" ${i === 0 ? 'open' : ''}>
      <summary><span class="chev-sm">›</span>Inner exception<span class="meta-tag">${esc(e.type)}</span></summary>
      <div class="inner-ex-body">
        <div class="error-msg">${esc(e.message)}</div>
        ${e.stack ? `<div class="error-stack">${esc(e.stack).replace(/(\/[^\s]+\.cs):line (\d+)/g, '<span class="src">$1:$2</span>')}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
    </details>
  `).join('');
  return `
    <div class="error-block">
      <div class="error-type">${esc(error.type)}</div>
      <div class="error-msg">${esc(error.message)}</div>
      ${hasDiff ? `
        <div class="diff-grid">
          <div class="diff-cell expected">
            <div class="lbl">Expected</div>
            <div class="v">${esc(error.expected)}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="diff-cell actual">
            <div class="lbl">Actual</div>
            <div class="v">${esc(error.actual)}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ` : ''}
      <details class="collapsible stack">
        <summary><span class="chev-sm">›</span>Stack trace<span class="meta-tag">${(error.stack||'').split('\n').filter(l => l.trim().startsWith('at ')).length} frames</span></summary>
        <div class="error-stack">${esc(error.stack).replace(/(\/[^\s]+\.cs):line (\d+)/g, '<span class="src">$1:$2</span>')}</div>
      </details>
      ${innerHTML}
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderLog(text) {
  return esc(text)
    .replace(/\[Information\]/g, '<span class="log-info">[Information]</span>')
    .replace(/\[Warning\]/g, '<span class="log-warn">[Warning]</span>')
    .replace(/\[Error\]/g, '<span class="log-fail">[Error]</span>')
    .replace(/\[(\w[\w\.-]+)\]/g, (m, p) => /Information|Warning|Error/.test(p) ? m : `<span class="log-dim">[${p}]</span>`);
}

function renderInsights() {
  const panel = $('#insightsPanel');
  if (!panel) return;
  const nonTestServices = INSIGHTS.services.filter(s => s.service !== 'test');
  if (nonTestServices.length === 0 || INSIGHTS.cpuSum === 0) {
    panel.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  panel.style.display = '';

  $('#insightsSpans').textContent = INSIGHTS.totalSpans.toLocaleString();
  $('#insightsServices').textContent = INSIGHTS.services.length;
  $('#insightsCpu').textContent = fmtDur(INSIGHTS.cpuSum);

  const stack = $('#serviceStack');
  stack.innerHTML = INSIGHTS.services.map(s =>
    `<span style="flex:${s.self}; background:${SERVICE_COLORS[s.service] || 'var(--text-dim)'}" title="${s.service}: ${fmtDur(s.self)}"></span>`
  ).join('');

  $('#serviceLegend').innerHTML = INSIGHTS.services.map(s => {
    const pct = Math.round((s.self / INSIGHTS.cpuSum) * 100);
    return `<span><span class="sw" style="background:${SERVICE_COLORS[s.service] || 'var(--text-dim)'}"></span>${s.service} <b>${fmtDur(s.self)}</b> <span class="pct">· ${pct}%</span></span>`;
  }).join('');

  const topEp = INSIGHTS.endpoints[0]?.total || 1;
  if (INSIGHTS.endpoints.length === 0) {
    $('#endpointSection').style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    $('#endpointSection').style.display = '';
    $('#endpointRows').innerHTML = INSIGHTS.endpoints.slice(0, 7).map(e => `
      <div class="insight-row">
        <span class="insight-name" title="${esc(e.name)}">${esc(e.name)}</span>
        <span class="insight-count">${e.count}×</span>
        <span class="insight-bar"><i style="width:${(e.total/topEp)*100}%; background:${SERVICE_COLORS['http.server']}"></i></span>
        <span class="insight-val">${fmtDur(e.total)}</span>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  }

  const topDb = INSIGHTS.dbOps[0]?.total || 1;
  if (INSIGHTS.dbOps.length === 0) {
    $('#dbSection').style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    $('#dbSection').style.display = '';
    $('#dbRows').innerHTML = INSIGHTS.dbOps.map(d => `
      <div class="insight-row">
        <span class="insight-name">${esc(d.name)}</span>
        <span class="insight-count">${d.count}×</span>
        <span class="insight-bar"><i style="width:${(d.total/topDb)*100}%; background:${SERVICE_COLORS['npgsql']}"></i></span>
        <span class="insight-val">${fmtDur(d.total)}</span>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  }
}

function renderDetailEmpty() {
  const detail = $('#detail');
  if (!detail) return;
  if (total === 0) {
    detail.innerHTML = `
      <div class="detail-empty">
        <div class="inner">
          <div class="ico"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M14 3v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4"/><path d="M17 21H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h7l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/></svg></div>
          <h3>No tests in this run</h3>
          <p>The report was generated but no tests were discovered.</p>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }
  if (failed.length === 0) {
    detail.innerHTML = `
      <div class="detail-empty success">
        <div class="inner">
          <div class="ico"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg></div>
          <h3>All ${counts.pass} tests passed</h3>
          <p>Completed in ${fmtDur(REPORT.wallMs)}. Pick any test from the rail to inspect its output, OpenTelemetry trace, properties or source.</p>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }
  detail.innerHTML = `
    <div class="detail-empty">
      <div class="inner">
        <div class="ico"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M14 3v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4"/><path d="M17 21H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h7l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Select a test</h3>
        <p>Pick a test from the rail to see its output, OpenTelemetry trace, properties and source location. Press <kbd>j</kbd>&nbsp;/&nbsp;<kbd>k</kbd> to navigate, <kbd>f</kbd> to jump to next failure.</p>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}

function traceHTML(t) {
  const spans = t.spans;
  if (!spans || spans.length === 0) {
    return `
      <div class="empty-state">
        <div class="icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M3 12h4l3-9 4 18 3-9h4"/></svg></div>
        <div class="title">No trace captured</div>
        <div class="desc">Enable OpenTelemetry instrumentation on the test host to see spans here.</div>
      </div>`;
  }
  const byId = new Map(spans.map(s => [s.id, s]));
  spans.forEach(s => { s._children = []; });
  spans.forEach(s => { if (s.parent && byId.has(s.parent)) byId.get(s.parent)._children.push(s); });
  // Span starts are absolute offsets from the run start, so normalise to the
  // earliest span — otherwise the axis begins at 0 and all bars are pushed to
  // the right, leaving the lead-in time before the test empty.
  const minStart = Math.min(...spans.map(s => s.start));
  const totalDur = (Math.max(...spans.map(s => s.start + s.dur)) - minStart) || 1;
  const ticks = 6, axisHtml = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= ticks; i++) axisHtml.push(`<span>${fmtDur((i/ticks)*totalDur)}</span>`);

  const rows = [];
  function walk(span, depth) {
    const color = SERVICE_COLORS[span.service] || 'var(--text-muted)';
    const left = ((span.start - minStart) / totalDur) * 100;
    const width = Math.max(0.2, (span.dur / totalDur) * 100);
    const err = (span.attrs && span.attrs['http.status_code'] >= 500) ? ' err' : '';
    rows.push(`
      <div class="span-row">
        <div class="span-label" title="${esc(span.name)}"><span class="depth">${'&nbsp;&nbsp;'.repeat(depth)}</span><span class="svc" style="background:${color}"></span>${esc(span.name)}</div>
        <div class="span-track"><div class="span-bar${err}" data-id="${span.id}" style="left:${left}%; width:${width}%; background:${color}"></div></div>
        <div class="span-dur">${fmtDur(span.dur)}</div>
      </div>`);
    span._children.sort((a,b)=>a.start-b.start).forEach(c => walk(c, depth+1));
  }
  spans.filter(s => !s.parent).forEach(r => walk(r, 0));
  const svcs = [...new Set(spans.map(s => s.service))];
  const legend = svcs.map(s => `<span class="legend-svc"><span class="sw" style="background:${SERVICE_COLORS[s]||'var(--text-muted)'}"></span>${s}</span>`).join('');

  const linkedCount = spans.filter(s => s.linked).length;
  const linkedTag = linkedCount > 0 ? `<span class="linked-tag" title="Spans from traces linked to this test, e.g. via [LinkedTrace] or background work">${linkedCount} linked</span>` : '';
  return `
    <div class="trace">
      <div class="trace-toolbar">
        <span><b>${spans.length}</b> spans across <b>${svcs.length}</b> services</span>
        ${linkedTag}
        ${legend}
      </div>
      <div class="trace-axis">${axisHtml.join('')}</div>
      ${rows.join('')}
    </div>
  `;
}

/* ---------- run view ---------- */
function renderRun() {

  // hardcoded design-preview values never leak into shipped reports.
  function setMeta(itemId, valueId, raw) {
    const item = document.getElementById(itemId);
    const val = document.getElementById(valueId);
    if (!item || !val) return;
    const v = (raw == null || raw === '') ? '' : String(raw);
    if (v) { val.textContent = v; item.style.display = ''; }
    else { item.style.display = 'none'; }

    off += len;

  $('#ganttCpu').textContent = fmtDur(sum);

  strip.querySelectorAll('.tick').forEach(el => {

  $('#stripStart').textContent = fmtTime(0, REPORT.startMs);
  $('#stripMid').textContent = fmtTime(REPORT.wallMs/2, REPORT.startMs);

        <div class="title">All clear</div>
        <div class="desc"><b>${counts.pass}</b>&nbsp;tests passed in <b>${fmtDur(REPORT.wallMs)}</b></div>

  } else {

    fl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="clusters-summary">
        <span><b>${clusters.length}</b> root cause${clusters.length===1?'':'s'}</span>

    `;
    fl.querySelectorAll('.cluster-head').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target.closest('.cluster-test')) return;
        const c = el.parentElement;
        c.dataset.open = c.dataset.open === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true';
      });
    });
    fl.querySelectorAll('.cluster-test').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); selectTest(el.dataset.id); switchView('tests'); });

  }

  // slowest
  const slow = [...tests].sort((a,b) => b.duration - a.duration).slice(0, 8);
  const maxD = slow[0]?.duration || 1;
  $('#slowestList').innerHTML = slow.map((t, i) => `

      <span class="slow-rank">#${i+1}</span>

        <span class="cl">${esc(t.cls)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slow-bar-cell">
        <span class="slow-bar ${t.duration>1000?'warn':''}"><i style="width:${(t.duration/maxD)*100}%"></i></span>

      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
  $('#slowestList').querySelectorAll('.slow-row').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', () => { selectTest(el.dataset.id); switchView('tests'); });
  });

  // gantt
  const workers = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= REPORT.workers; i++) workers.push('worker-' + i);
  const ticks = 6, tickHtml = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= ticks; i++) tickHtml.push(`<span>${fmtDur((i/ticks)*wall)}</span>`);
  $('#ganttCanvas').innerHTML = `

      }).join('');
      return `<div class="gantt-row"><div class="gantt-label">${w}</div><div class="gantt-track">${blocks}</div></div>`;

  `;
  $('#ganttCanvas').querySelectorAll('.gantt-block').forEach(el => {
    const t = tests.find(x => x.id === el.dataset.id);
    el.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => showTooltip(e, `
      <div class="title">${esc(t.name)}</div>
      <div class="row"><span>worker</span><b>${t.worker}</b></div>
      <div class="row"><span>started</span><b>${fmtTime(t.start, REPORT.startMs)}</b></div>
      <div class="row"><span>duration</span><b>${fmtDur(t.duration)}</b></div>
    `));
    el.addEventListener('mousemove', moveTooltip);
    el.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);
    el.addEventListener('click', () => { selectTest(t.id); switchView('tests'); });
  });

  // global and per-class timelines
  renderGlobalTimeline();
  renderClassTimelines();

  // flaky-in-this-run
  renderInsights();
  const flaky = tests.filter(t => t.attempts && t.attempts.length > 1 && t.status === 'pass');
  const flakyPanel = $('#flakyPanel');
  if (flaky.length === 0) {
    if (flakyPanel) flakyPanel.style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    if (flakyPanel) flakyPanel.style.display = '';
    $('#flakyCount').textContent = flaky.length;
    $('#flakyList').innerHTML = flaky.map(t => {
      const f = t.attempts.filter(a => a.status === 'fail').length;
      const p = t.attempts.filter(a => a.status === 'pass').length;
      return `

          <div>
            <div class="flake-name">${esc(t.name)}</div>
            <div class="flake-class">${esc(t.cls)} · passed on attempt ${t.attempts.length}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="flake-tally">
            ${Array.from({length: f}, () => `<span class="a fail">✗</span>`).join('')}
            ${Array.from({length: p}, () => `<span class="a pass">✓</span>`).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
    $('#flakyList').querySelectorAll('.flake-item').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', () => { selectTest(el.dataset.id); switchView('tests'); });
    });
  }

  // categories
  const catPanel = $('#catPanel');
  if (allCategories.length === 0) {
    if (catPanel) catPanel.style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    if (catPanel) catPanel.style.display = '';
    $('#catCount').textContent = allCategories.length;
    $('#catGrid').innerHTML = allCategories.map(([name, count]) => {
    let p=0,f=0,s=0;
    tests.forEach(t => { if (t.categories.includes(name)) { if (t.status==='pass') p++; else if (t.status==='fail') f++; else if (t.status==='skip') s++; } });
    return `
      <div class="cat-tile" data-cat="${esc(name)}">
        <div class="cat-name">${esc(name)}</div>
        <div class="cat-meta"><span>${count} tests</span><span>${pctOf(p, count)}% pass</span></div>
        <div class="cat-bar">
          <i style="flex:${p}; background:var(--pass)"></i>
          ${f?`<i style="flex:${f}; background:var(--fail)"></i>`:''}
          ${s?`<i style="flex:${s}; background:var(--skip)"></i>`:''}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
  $('#catGrid').querySelectorAll('.cat-tile').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const cat = el.dataset.cat;
      STATE.categories.has(cat) ? STATE.categories.delete(cat) : STATE.categories.add(cat);
      switchView('tests'); renderRail();
    });
  });
  }
}

/* ---------- timelines (run view) ---------- */
function timelineWaterfall(spans) {
  if (!spans || !spans.length) return '<div class="empty-state"><div class="title">No spans captured</div></div>';
  const byId = new Map(spans.map(s => [s.id, s]));
  const depthCache = new Map();
  // Iterative parent-walk: collect the chain from leaf upward until we hit either
  // a cached ancestor or a root, then assign depths counting back down. This
  // avoids the O(n²) blow-up of allocating a fresh visited-Set per recursive call.
  function depth(startId) {
    if (depthCache.has(startId)) return depthCache.get(startId);
    const path = [];
    const onPath = new Set();
    let cur = startId;
    let baseDepth = -1; // -1 means "path ends at a real root"; otherwise = cached parent's depth.
    while (true) {
      if (depthCache.has(cur)) { baseDepth = depthCache.get(cur); break; }
      if (onPath.has(cur)) { break; } // cycle guard; treat as root.
      const s = byId.get(cur);
      onPath.add(cur);
      path.push(cur);
      if (!s || !s.parent || !byId.has(s.parent)) break;
      cur = s.parent;
    }
    let d = baseDepth + 1;
    for (let i = path.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      depthCache.set(path[i], d);
      d++;
    }
    return depthCache.get(startId);
  }
  const mn = Math.min(...spans.map(s => s.start));
  const mx = Math.max(...spans.map(s => s.start + s.dur));
  const tot = mx - mn || 1;
  const sorted = [...spans].sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
  return '<div class="trace">' + sorted.map(s => {
    const d = depth(s.id);
    const left = ((s.start - mn) / tot) * 100;
    const width = Math.max(0.2, (s.dur / tot) * 100);
    const color = SERVICE_COLORS[s.service] || 'var(--text-muted)';
    return `<div class="span-row">
      <div class="span-label" title="${esc(s.name)}"><span class="depth">${'&nbsp;&nbsp;'.repeat(d)}</span><span class="svc" style="background:${color}"></span>${esc(s.name)}</div>
      <div class="span-track"><div class="span-bar" data-id="${s.id}" style="left:${left}%; width:${width}%; background:${color}"></div></div>
      <div class="span-dur">${fmtDur(s.dur)}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('') + '</div>';
}

function renderGlobalTimeline() {
  const panel = $('#globalTimelinePanel');
  if (!panel) return;
  const spans = REPORT.globalSpans || [];
  if (!spans.length) { panel.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  panel.style.display = '';
  $('#globalTimelineCount').textContent = spans.length + ' spans';
  $('#globalTimelineBody').innerHTML = timelineWaterfall(spans);
}

function renderClassTimelines() {
  const panel = $('#classTimelinesPanel');
  if (!panel) return;
  const ct = REPORT.classTimelines || {};
  const entries = Object.entries(ct).filter(([, v]) => v && v.spans && v.spans.length);
  if (!entries.length) { panel.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  panel.style.display = '';
  $('#classTimelinesCount').textContent = entries.length + ' classes';
  $('#classTimelinesBody').innerHTML = entries.map(([cls, data]) => `
    <details class="collapsible class-timeline">
      <summary><span class="chev-sm">›</span>${esc(cls)}<span class="meta-tag">${esc(data.mode)}</span><span class="span-count">${data.spans.length} spans</span></summary>
      <div class="class-timeline-body">${timelineWaterfall(data.spans)}</div>
    </details>
  `).join('');
}

/* ---------- tooltip ---------- */
const tt = $('#tooltip');
function showTooltip(e, html) { tt.innerHTML = html; tt.dataset.show = 'true'; moveTooltip(e); }
function moveTooltip(e) {
  const pad = 14, w = tt.offsetWidth, h = tt.offsetHeight;
  let x = e.clientX + pad, y = e.clientY + pad;
  if (x + w > window.innerWidth - 8) x = e.clientX - w - pad;
  if (y + h > window.innerHeight - 8) y = e.clientY - h - pad;
  tt.style.left = x + 'px'; tt.style.top = y + 'px';
}
function hideTooltip() { tt.dataset.show = 'false'; }

/* ---------- view switching ---------- */
function switchView(v) {
  STATE.view = v;
  $$('.view').forEach(el => el.classList.toggle('active', el.id === 'view-' + v));
  $$('.view-toggle button').forEach(b => {
    const on = b.dataset.view === v;
    b.classList.toggle('active', on);
    b.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
  // When the tests view becomes visible the rail list finally has a non-zero clientHeight,
  // so any earlier renderRailWindow() that ran while hidden (e.g. from a Run-view click
  // calling selectTest before switchView) computed an empty visible range. Re-render now.
  if (v === 'tests') {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const list = $('#railList');
      if (STATE.selectedId && RAIL.layout) {
        const entry = RAIL.layout.find(e => e.kind === 'test' && e.t.id === STATE.selectedId);
        if (entry && list) {
          const top = entry.top, bot = top + entry.h;
          if (top < list.scrollTop || bot > list.scrollTop + list.clientHeight) {
            list.scrollTop = Math.max(0, top - 60);
          }
        }
      }
      renderRailWindow();
    });
  }
}

/* ---------- keyboard ---------- */
function moveSelection(dir) {
  const items = $$('.test-item');
  if (items.length === 0) return;
  const idx = items.findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('selected'));
  const next = idx < 0 ? 0 : clamp(idx + dir, 0, items.length - 1);
  selectTest(items[next].dataset.id);
}

/* ---------- init ---------- */
function init() {
  renderBanner();
  renderRail();
  renderRun();

  // search
  const search = $('#searchInput');
  let timer;
  search.addEventListener('input', () => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => { STATE.search = search.value; renderRail(); }, 120);
  });

  // category dropdown open/close
  const dropdown = $('#catDropdown');
  if (dropdown) {
    dropdown.querySelector('.dropdown-trigger').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const open = dropdown.dataset.open === 'true';
      dropdown.dataset.open = open ? 'false' : 'true';
    });
    $('#catClear').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      STATE.categories.clear();
      renderRail();
    });
  }
  // outside-click closes any open dropdowns
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    $$('.dropdown[data-open="true"]').forEach(d => {
      if (!d.contains(e.target)) d.dataset.open = 'false';
    });
  });

  // group seg
  document.querySelectorAll('.seg-group[data-role="group"] button').forEach(b => {
    if (b.classList.contains('lbl')) return;
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.seg-group[data-role="group"] button').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('active', x === b));
      STATE.group = b.dataset.val;
      STATE.openGroups.clear();
      renderRail();
    });
  });

  // sort seg
  document.querySelectorAll('.seg-group[data-role="sort"] button').forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.seg-group[data-role="sort"] button').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('active', x === b));
      STATE.sort = b.dataset.val;
      renderRail();
    });
  });

  // view toggle
  $$('.view-toggle button').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => switchView(b.dataset.view)));

  // theme
  const apply = (name) => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = name;
    localStorage.setItem('tunit-report-theme', name);
    renderRun(); // re-render donut for var changes
  };
  $('#themeToggle').addEventListener('click', () => {
    apply(document.documentElement.dataset.theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
  });
  const saved = localStorage.getItem('tunit-report-theme');
  if (saved) apply(saved);

  document.body.dataset.pane = 'rail';

  // hash
  if (location.hash.startsWith('#test=')) {
    selectTest(location.hash.slice(6), { silent: true });
  } else if (failed.length > 0) {
    // failure-first auto-select on first load (silent: don't pop the detail on narrow)
    selectTest(failed[0].id, { silent: true });
  } else {
    renderDetailEmpty();
  }

  // keyboard
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.target.matches('input, textarea')) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') e.target.blur();
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === '/') { e.preventDefault(); search.focus(); search.select(); }
    else if (e.key === 'j') { e.preventDefault(); moveSelection(1); }
    else if (e.key === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); moveSelection(-1); }
    else if (e.key === 'f') {
      const ids = failed.map(t => t.id);
      if (!ids.length) return;
      const cur = ids.indexOf(STATE.selectedId);
      selectTest(ids[(cur + 1) % ids.length]);
    }
    else if (e.key === 'v') {
      switchView(STATE.view === 'tests' ? 'run' : 'tests');
    }
  });
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script id="report-data" type="application/octet-stream"></script>

<script type="module">
/* ====================================================================
   TUnit HTML Report — split-pane renderer
   Self-contained. Reads gzipped+base64 JSON from #report-data
   (kept small for large suites); generates sample data when not present
   (e.g. previewing this template).
   ==================================================================== */



/* ---------- bootstrap ---------- */
async function loadReportData() {
  const el = document.getElementById('report-data');
  const raw = el ? el.textContent.trim() : '';
  if (!raw || raw.startsWith('__REPORT')) return { kind: 'preview' };
  if (raw.charAt(0) === '{') {
    try { return { kind: 'ok', report: JSON.parse(raw) }; }
    catch (e) { return { kind: 'error', message: 'Embedded JSON data is corrupt and could not be parsed.' }; }
  }
  if (typeof DecompressionStream === 'undefined') {
    return { kind: 'error', message: 'This browser does not support DecompressionStream, which is required to read the embedded report data. Please open this report in Chrome 80+, Edge 80+, Firefox 113+, or Safari 16.4+.' };
  }
  try {
    const bin = Uint8Array.from(atob(raw), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
    const ds = new DecompressionStream('gzip');
    const text = await new Response(new Blob([bin]).stream().pipeThrough(ds)).text();
    return { kind: 'ok', report: JSON.parse(text) };
  } catch (e) {
    return { kind: 'error', message: 'Failed to decode the embedded report data: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)) };
  }
}
const loaded = await loadReportData();
if (loaded.kind === 'error') {
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.style.cssText = 'max-width:560px;margin:80px auto;padding:24px 28px;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#1c1917;background:#fafaf9;border:1px solid #d6d3d1;border-radius:12px;';
  const h = document.createElement('h1');
  h.style.cssText = 'margin:0 0 10px;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;';
  h.textContent = 'Report could not be loaded';
  const p = document.createElement('p');
  p.style.cssText = 'margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#57534e;';
  p.textContent = loaded.message;
  card.append(h, p);
  document.body.replaceChildren(card);
  throw new Error(loaded.message);
}
let REPORT = loaded.kind === 'ok' ? loaded.report : null;
if (!REPORT) {
  // generateSampleData() is only present when previewing this template standalone;
  // the C# generator strips it from shipped reports. Fall back to an empty run.
  REPORT = (typeof generateSampleData === 'function')
    ? generateSampleData()
    : { project: '', when: '', startMs: 0, wallMs: 0, workers: 1, tests: [] };
}

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const STATE = {
  search: '',
  statuses: new Set(['pass', 'fail', 'skip', 'cancel']),
  categories: new Set(),
  properties: new Map(),
  group: 'class',
  sort: 'default',
  failuresOnly: false,
  selectedId: null,
  view: 'tests',
  openGroups: new Set(),
};

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const $ = sel => document.querySelector(sel);
const $$ = sel => [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)];
function fmtDur(ms) {
  if (ms == null) return '—';
  if (ms < 1) return '<1ms';
  if (ms < 1000) return Math.round(ms) + 'ms';
  return (ms/1000).toFixed(ms < 10000 ? 2 : 1) + 's';
}
function fmtTime(ms, base) { return new Date(base + ms).toISOString().slice(11, 23); }
function pctOf(n, total) { return total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((n / total) * 100); }
function esc(s) { return String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c])); }
function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }

/* ---------- source links & snippet lazy loading ---------- */
// REPORT.sourceLinks holds pre-built URL templates for the detected provider (GitHub/GitLab/
// Bitbucket/...). Server, repo and commit are already baked in; we only fill {path}/{line}/
// {start}/{end} here, so there is zero provider-specific logic in this report.
function canLinkSource(t)  { return !!(t.source && t.source.relativePath && REPORT.sourceLinks && REPORT.sourceLinks.lineUrl); }
function canShowSnippet(t) { return !!(t.source && t.source.relativePath && REPORT.sourceLinks && REPORT.sourceLinks.rawUrl); }
function fillSourceTemplate(tmpl, t) {
  const end = (t.source.endLine && t.source.endLine > t.source.line) ? t.source.endLine : t.source.line;
  // encodeURI keeps '/' as a path separator but escapes spaces and other unsafe chars.
  return tmpl
    .replace('{path}', encodeURI(t.source.relativePath))
    .replace('{line}', t.source.line)
    .replace('{start}', t.source.line)
    .replace('{end}', end);
}
function sourceJumpUrl(t) {
  const sl = REPORT.sourceLinks;
  const tmpl = (t.source.endLine && t.source.endLine > t.source.line && sl.rangeUrl) ? sl.rangeUrl : sl.lineUrl;
  return fillSourceTemplate(tmpl, t);
}
// ── Baked-in "good enough" C# syntax highlighter ──────────────────────────
// A small hand-rolled tokenizer. Not a full C# parser — it deliberately trades
// edge-case accuracy for zero dependencies and a tiny footprint. Output token
// classes map to theme-aware --syn-* colors so highlighting follows the toggle.
const CS_KEYWORDS = new Set((
  'abstract as async await base bool break byte case catch char checked class const ' +
  'continue decimal default delegate do double else enum event explicit extern false ' +
  'finally fixed float for foreach goto if implicit in int interface internal is lock ' +
  'long namespace new null object operator out override params private protected public ' +
  'readonly ref return sbyte sealed short sizeof stackalloc static string struct switch ' +
  'this throw true try typeof uint ulong unchecked unsafe ushort using virtual void ' +
  'volatile while ' +
  // Contextual keywords — limited to ones that are nearly always keywords, so we
  // don't miscolor common identifiers like `value`, `from`, `select`, `on`, `by`.
  'and dynamic file get global init nameof nint not notnull nuint or ' +
  'partial record required scoped set unmanaged var when where with yield'
).split(' '));

function highlightCSharpLines(code) {
  // Tokenize the whole snippet (so multi-line comments / verbatim strings are
  // handled), then split tokens across newlines into one HTML string per line.
  const lines = [[]];
  const push = (cls, text) => {
    const parts = text.split('\n');
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0) lines.push([]);
      if (parts[i] === '') continue;
      const safe = esc(parts[i]);
      lines[lines.length - 1].push(cls ? `<span class="${cls}">${safe}</span>` : safe);
    }
  };
  const n = code.length;
  let i = 0;
  while (i < n) {
    const c = code[i];
    const c2 = code[i + 1];
    // line comment / xml-doc comment
    if (c === '/' && c2 === '/') {
      let j = i + 2; while (j < n && code[j] !== '\n') j++;
      push('tok-comment', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // block comment
    if (c === '/' && c2 === '*') {
      let j = i + 2; while (j < n && !(code[j] === '*' && code[j + 1] === '/')) j++;
      j = Math.min(n, j + 2);
      push('tok-comment', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // raw string literal: """ ... """ (optionally interpolated: $"""), 3+ quotes
    if (c === '"' && c2 === '"' && code[i + 2] === '"') {
      let q = 0; while (code[i + q] === '"') q++;
      const fence = '"'.repeat(q);
      let j = code.indexOf(fence, i + q);
      j = j === -1 ? n : j + q;
      push('tok-string', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // verbatim / interpolated-verbatim string: @"...", $@"...", @$"..."
    if (c === '@' && c2 === '"') { i = readVerbatim(code, i, 1, push); continue; }
    if ((c === '$' && c2 === '@') || (c === '@' && c2 === '$')) {
      if (code[i + 2] === '"') { i = readVerbatim(code, i, 2, push); continue; }
    }
    // regular or interpolated string: "..." / $"..."
    if (c === '"' || (c === '$' && c2 === '"')) {
      const start = c === '$' ? i + 1 : i;
      let j = start + 1;
      while (j < n && code[j] !== '"' && code[j] !== '\n') {
        if (code[j] === '\\') j++;
        j++;
      }
      j = Math.min(n, j + 1);
      push('tok-string', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // char literal
    if (c === "'") {
      let j = i + 1;
      while (j < n && code[j] !== "'" && code[j] !== '\n') {
        if (code[j] === '\\') j++;
        j++;
      }
      j = Math.min(n, j + 1);
      push('tok-string', code.slice(i, j)); i = j; continue;
    }
    // number
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
      const m = /^(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F_]+|0[bB][01_]+|[0-9][0-9_]*(?:\.[0-9_]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?)[fFdDmMuUlL]*/.exec(code.slice(i));
      const tok = m ? m[0] : c;
      push('tok-number', tok); i += tok.length; continue;
    }
    // identifier / keyword (allow leading @ verbatim identifier)
    if (/[A-Za-z_@]/.test(c)) {
      const m = /^@?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*/.exec(code.slice(i));
      const word = m[0];
      const bare = word[0] === '@' ? word.slice(1) : word;
      let k = i + word.length; while (k < n && /\s/.test(code[k])) k++;
      let cls = '';
      if (CS_KEYWORDS.has(bare)) cls = 'tok-keyword';
      else if (code[k] === '(') cls = 'tok-func';             // call / declaration
      else if (/^[A-Z]/.test(bare)) cls = 'tok-type';         // PascalCase ⇒ type
      push(cls, word); i += word.length; continue;
    }
    // anything else (punctuation, operators, whitespace) → plain
    push('', c); i++;
  }
  return lines.map(parts => parts.join(''));
}
function readVerbatim(code, i, prefix, push) {
  // prefix = number of chars before the opening quote (@ ⇒ 1, $@/@$ ⇒ 2).
  // In verbatim strings a quote is escaped by doubling it ("").
  const n = code.length;
  let j = i + prefix + 1;
  while (j < n) {
    if (code[j] === '"') {
      if (code[j + 1] === '"') { j += 2; continue; }
      j++; break;
    }
    j++;
  }
  push('tok-string', code.slice(i, Math.min(n, j)));
  return Math.min(n, j);
}
const _snippetCache = new Map();
const SNIPPET_FALLBACK_LINES = 40;
function loadSourceSnippet(detail) {
  const container = detail.querySelector('.source-snippet-container');
  if (!container || container.dataset.loaded) return;
  container.dataset.loaded = '1';

  const rawUrl = container.dataset.rawUrl;
  const path = container.dataset.path;
  const startLine = parseInt(container.dataset.line, 10) || 1;
  const endLine = parseInt(container.dataset.endLine, 10) || 0;

  const render = (text) => {
    // Strip a UTF-8 BOM (renders as a stray glyph on line 1) and split on both
    // LF and CRLF so Windows-authored files don't keep a trailing \r per line.
    const lines = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').split(/\r?\n/);
    // from: convert 1-based startLine to 0-based index.
    const from = Math.max(0, startLine - 1);
    // Source-gen mode supplies an end line (full method). Reflection mode does not,
    // so fall back to a fixed window starting at the declaration line.
    // endLine is 1-based; slice()'s upper bound is exclusive, so a 1-based endLine
    // is already the correct exclusive index.
    const to = endLine > startLine
      ? Math.min(lines.length, endLine)
      : Math.min(lines.length, from + SNIPPET_FALLBACK_LINES);
    const snippet = lines.slice(from, to);
    const fileName = path.split('/').pop();
    const rangeLabel = `lines ${startLine}–${from + snippet.length}`;
    // Highlight C# files; fall back to plain (escaped) text for anything else.
    const htmlLines = /\.cs$/i.test(fileName)
      ? highlightCSharpLines(snippet.join('\n'))
      : snippet.map(esc);
    container.innerHTML =
      `<div class="source-snippet-header"><span>${esc(fileName)} (${rangeLabel})</span></div>` +
      `<div class="source-snippet-code">${snippet.map((l, i) =>
        `<div class="line"><span class="line-num">${from + i + 1}</span><span class="line-content">${htmlLines[i] || ''}</span></div>`
      ).join('')}</div>`;
  };

  if (_snippetCache.has(rawUrl)) { render(_snippetCache.get(rawUrl)); return; }

  fetch(rawUrl)
    .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.text(); })
    .then(text => { _snippetCache.set(rawUrl, text); render(text); })
    .catch(() => {
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="source-snippet-placeholder">Source unavailable — could not fetch from repository.</div>';
    });
}

const tests = REPORT.tests;
const counts = { pass: 0, fail: 0, skip: 0, cancel: 0 };
tests.forEach(t => counts[t.status] = (counts[t.status]||0) + 1);
